rows.english: Release the mouse button and the Peasants will be selected.
rows.rawText: 松开鼠标键，农民就会被选中。
rows.current: 松开鼠标键，农民就会被选中。

rows.english: You can select any of your people in this manner.
rows.rawText: 您也可以用这种方法选中其他人。
rows.current: 您也可以用这种方法选中其他人。

rows.english: This will be crucial to commanding your army effectively, so learn it well.
rows.rawText: 掌握这个操作，才能有效指挥军队，务必学会。
rows.current: 掌握这个操作，才能有效指挥军队，务必学会。

rows.english: Now, scroll to the rice field and Right-click on one of the rice plants in the field.
rows.rawText: 现在把画面移到稻田，右键点击田里的一株稻苗。
rows.current: 现在把画面移到稻田，右键点击田里的一株稻苗。

rows.english: This will tell the Peasants to start harvesting, and they will continue to do so until told differently.
rows.rawText: 农民就会开始收割；除非收到别的命令，否则他们会一直收下去。
rows.current: 农民就会开始收割；除非收到别的命令，否则他们会一直收下去。

rows.english: Rice is important, but our people will also need fresh water to drink.
rows.rawText: 稻米很重要，但我们的人民还需要清水饮用。
rows.current: 稻米很重要，但我们的人民还需要清水饮用。

rows.english: A pond or stream like this one should do nicely.
rows.rawText: 这样的池塘或溪流就很合适。
rows.current: 这样的池塘或溪流就很合适。

rows.english: Select our Peasants, then scroll to the pond and Right-click it.
rows.rawText: 选中农民，把画面移到池塘，再右键点击池塘。
rows.current: 选中农民，把画面移到池塘，再右键点击池塘。

rows.english: We're almost ready to start building our army!
rows.rawText: 我们很快就能开始组建军队了！
rows.current: 我们很快就能开始组建军队了！

rows.english: To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
rows.rawText: 训练战士需要一座道场。
rows.current: 训练战士需要一座道场。

rows.english: Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
rows.rawText: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。
rows.current: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。

rows.english: We'll find a good spot and build the Dojo just like we built the Peasant Hut.
rows.rawText: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。
rows.current: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。

rows.english: The more peasants we have selected the faster our new Dojo will be completed.
rows.rawText: 选中的农民越多，道场建成得就越快。
rows.current: 选中的农民越多，道场建成得就越快。

rows.english: Also, if you hold the right mouse button down and drag left and right we can rotate the building.
rows.rawText: 按住右键左右拖动，还能旋转建筑。
rows.current: 按住右键左右拖动，还能旋转建筑。

rows.english: When you let go of the button, the building will be placed.
rows.rawText: 松开右键，就能放置建筑。
rows.current: 松开右键，就能放置建筑。

rows.english: My lord, we must complete our Dojo.
rows.rawText: 大人，我们得把道场建好。
rows.current: 大人，我们得把道场建好。

rows.english: Select some Peasants and Right-click on the Dojo you started to complete it.
rows.rawText: 选中数名农民，右键点击未完工的道场，完成建造。
rows.current: 选中数名农民，右键点击未完工的道场，完成建造。

rows.english: Now we'll train our first warrior, a Spearman.
rows.rawText: 现在来训练第一名战士：长矛兵。
rows.current: 现在来训练第一名战士：长矛兵。

rows.english: Training a Spearman will cost you rice and water.
rows.rawText: 训练长矛兵需要稻米和水。
rows.current: 训练长矛兵需要稻米和水。

rows.english: Uh oh! We're out of rice!
And look, the fields are dry!
Don't worry, my lord - we can harvest more rice if we water the field.
rows.rawText: 别担心，大人。给稻田灌水，就能收获更多稻米。
rows.current: 别担心，大人。给稻田灌水，就能收获更多稻米。

rows.english: Select some peasants like we did before.
rows.rawText: 像刚才那样选中几名农民。
rows.current: 像刚才那样选中几名农民。

rows.english: In the lower right corner of the build interface you'll see the blue Water Rice icon.
rows.rawText: 建造界面的右下角有一个蓝色的灌溉稻田图标。
rows.current: 建造界面的右下角有一个蓝色的灌溉稻田图标。

rows.english: Left-click the Water Rice icon, and Right-click one of the depleted rice plants.
rows.rawText: 左键点击灌溉稻田图标，再右键点击一株已经枯竭的稻苗。
rows.current: 左键点击灌溉稻田图标，再右键点击一株已经枯竭的稻苗。

rows.english: In no time the field will be ready for harvesting again - go ahead and tell a Peasant to harvest rice.
rows.rawText: 稻田很快就能再次收割。现在让农民去收稻米吧。
rows.current: 稻田很快就能再次收割。现在让农民去收稻米吧。

rows.english: Well done! The fields are fertile again and our rice stores have been replenished.
rows.rawText: 做得好！田地恢复肥沃，稻米储备也补上了。
rows.current: 做得好！田地恢复肥沃，稻米储备也补上了。

rows.english: Looks like we'll need some more water, though.
rows.rawText: 不过看来我们还需要更多水。
rows.current: 不过看来我们还需要更多水。

rows.english: Select a Peasant and order him to harvest some water for us, my lord.
rows.rawText: 大人，请选中一名农民，命令他去取水。
rows.current: 大人，请选中一名农民，命令他去取水。

rows.english: Now, back to training that Spearman…
rows.rawText: 现在继续训练那名长矛兵……
rows.current: 现在继续训练那名长矛兵……

rows.english: Select a peasant and Right-click on the Dojo.
rows.rawText: 选中一名农民，再右键点击道场。
rows.current: 选中一名农民，再右键点击道场。

rows.english: This will command the Peasant to enter and train in that building.
rows.rawText: 农民就会进入道场，在那里接受训练。
rows.current: 农民就会进入道场，在那里接受训练。

rows.english: Your first soldier will be ready soon, my Lord.
rows.rawText: 大人，您的第一名士兵很快就能训练完成。
rows.current: 大人，您的第一名士兵很快就能训练完成。

rows.english: You can see how long the training will take by Left-clicking the building and looking at the growing blue line.
rows.rawText: 左键点击建筑，观察逐渐变长的蓝线，就能知道训练还要多久。
rows.current: 左键点击建筑，观察逐渐变长的蓝线，就能知道训练还要多久。

rows.english: Having learned the economic basics, it's time to learn more about building our army.
rows.rawText: 您已经学会发展经济的基本方法，接下来要学习如何组建军队。
rows.current: 您已经学会发展经济的基本方法，接下来要学习如何组建军队。

rows.english: Rest up and we'll continue tomorrow.
rows.rawText: 先休息吧，我们明天继续。
rows.current: 先休息吧，我们明天继续。

rows.english: As you can see, New Issen is coming along nicely.
rows.rawText: 如您所见，New Issen 建设得很顺利。
rows.current: 如您所见，New Issen 建设得很顺利。

rows.english: If we're to protect our new town, we'll need more than one Spearman.
rows.rawText: 要保护新城镇，只靠一名长矛兵可不够。
rows.current: 要保护新城镇，只靠一名长矛兵可不够。

rows.english: While you were away the townspeople built a new training building, the Target Range.
rows.rawText: 您离开时，镇民建了一座新训练建筑：靶场。
rows.current: 您离开时，镇民建了一座新训练建筑：靶场。

rows.english: Like the Dojo, the Target Range can train Peasants into new fighters.
rows.rawText: 和道场一样，靶场也能把农民训练成战士。
rows.current: 和道场一样，靶场也能把农民训练成战士。

rows.english: Instead of Spearman, however, Peasants will become skilled Archers.
rows.rawText: 不过农民在这里不会成为长矛兵，而会成为出色的弓箭手。
rows.current: 不过农民在这里不会成为长矛兵，而会成为出色的弓箭手。

rows.english: ...But what would happen if a Spearman were to train on the Target Range?
rows.rawText: 但如果让长矛兵到靶场训练，会发生什么呢？
rows.current: 但如果让长矛兵到靶场训练，会发生什么呢？

rows.english: Select the Spearman and order him to train in the Target Range and let's see what happens.
rows.rawText: 选中长矛兵，命令他去靶场训练，看看结果如何。
rows.current: 选中长矛兵，命令他去靶场训练，看看结果如何。

rows.english: This is a Dragon Warrior, a soldier trained in both hand-to-hand and missile combat.
rows.rawText: 这是龙战士，既受过近身战训练，也会远程攻击。
rows.current: 这是龙战士，既受过近身战训练，也会远程攻击。

rows.english: While he prefers to fight with his sword, he can fire magical bolts as well, making him a most versatile ally.
rows.rawText: 他更爱用剑，但也能射出魔法弹，是个多面手。
rows.current: 他更爱用剑，但也能射出魔法弹，是个多面手。

rows.english: We call the process of training in multiple buildings 'Unit Alchemy.'
rows.rawText: 我们把在多个建筑中接受训练的过程称为“兵种训练”。
rows.current: 我们把在多个建筑中接受训练的过程称为“兵种训练”。

rows.english: There are certain to be other buildings to train in, so experiment with different training combinations.
rows.rawText: 肯定还有其他建筑可供训练，试试不同的组合吧。
rows.current: 肯定还有其他建筑可供训练，试试不同的组合吧。

rows.english: In theory you could train the fiercest of all warriors by training one peasant in three different buildings…!
rows.rawText: 理论上，让同一名农民在三种建筑中受训，就能练出最强的战士！
rows.current: 理论上，让同一名农民在三种建筑中受训，就能练出最强的战士！

rows.english: It's important to have a good mix of warriors in our ranks because each type has different strengths and weaknesses.
rows.rawText: 各类战士都有长处和短处，军中要搭配不同兵种。
rows.current: 各类战士都有长处和短处，军中要搭配不同兵种。

rows.english: We'll need to train different soldiers to adapt to our army to a variety of battle conditions.
rows.rawText: 训练不同士兵，军队才能适应各种战况。
rows.current: 训练不同士兵，军队才能适应各种战况。

rows.english: This is Sparrow's Song, the bathhouse I trained in.
rows.rawText: 这里是 Sparrow's Song，我就是在这座澡堂受训的。
rows.current: 这里是 Sparrow's Song，我就是在这座澡堂受训的。

rows.english: We Geisha are skilled in many arts, but our healing abilities are the most important to you.
rows.rawText: 我们艺伎通晓多种技艺，但治愈能力对您最重要。
rows.current: 我们艺伎通晓多种技艺，但治愈能力对您最重要。

rows.english: To produce another Geisha, send this Peasant into the Bathhouse.
rows.rawText: 要培养另一名艺伎，就把这名农民送进澡堂。
rows.current: 要培养另一名艺伎，就把这名农民送进澡堂。

rows.english: Don't be silly, of course not!
That Peasant will take over the duties of one of the Geisha trainees inside, allowing her to emerge and aid you on the battlefield.
rows.rawText: 他会接替澡堂里一名艺伎学徒的工作，让她出来上战场帮您。
rows.current: 他会接替澡堂里一名艺伎学徒的工作，让她出来上战场帮您。

rows.english: Unlike other clansmen, healers cannot enter other training buildings.
rows.rawText: 医者和其他族人不同，不能进入其他训练建筑。
rows.current: 医者和其他族人不同，不能进入其他训练建筑。

rows.english: Likewise, our troops cannot enter the Bathhouse.
rows.rawText: 同样，我们的士兵也不能进入澡堂。
rows.current: 同样，我们的士兵也不能进入澡堂。

rows.english: Let's rest until morning, my Lord - today's been easy enough, but tomorrow…
rows.rawText: 大人，先休息到早上吧。今天还算轻松，但明天……
rows.current: 大人，先休息到早上吧。今天还算轻松，但明天……

rows.english: ...Tomorrow you'll learn about combat, my most exciting lecture.
rows.rawText: 明天您要学的是战斗，我最爱讲的一课。
rows.current: 明天您要学的是战斗，我最爱讲的一课。

rows.english: We're under attack, but where are they?
rows.rawText: 我们遭到攻击，可敌人在哪里？
rows.current: 我们遭到攻击，可敌人在哪里？

rows.english: Do you see the small crossed swords icon in the center of the interface?
rows.rawText: 您看到界面中央交叉双剑的小图标了吗？
rows.current: 您看到界面中央交叉双剑的小图标了吗？

rows.english: If you Left-click that you will be moved to any active battles that involve our forces.
rows.rawText: 左键点击它，画面就会移到我军正在交战的地方。
rows.current: 左键点击它，画面就会移到我军正在交战的地方。

rows.english: And that fellow with the torch…it's a Raider!
rows.rawText: 那个拿火把的家伙……是突袭者！
rows.current: 那个拿火把的家伙……是突袭者！

rows.english: We trained some new Dragon Warriors overnight, and they await your orders!
rows.rawText: 我们昨夜训练了一些龙战士，正等您下令！
rows.current: 我们昨夜训练了一些龙战士，正等您下令！

rows.english: Do you see the small map in the bottom right corner of the screen?
rows.rawText: 您看到屏幕右下角的小地图了吗？
rows.current: 您看到屏幕右下角的小地图了吗？

rows.english: If you Left-click on that our view will instantly be moved to any location on the map.
rows.rawText: 左键点击地图，就能立刻把画面移到地图上的任何位置。
rows.current: 左键点击地图，就能立刻把画面移到地图上的任何位置。

rows.english: The small orange dots represent our clansmen and the small red dots represent the enemy.
rows.rawText: 橙色小点代表我们的族人，红色小点代表敌人。
rows.current: 橙色小点代表我们的族人，红色小点代表敌人。

rows.english: Left-click on the orange dots on the minimap to move back to our forces.
rows.rawText: 左键点击小地图上的橙色点，回到我军所在位置。
rows.current: 左键点击小地图上的橙色点，回到我军所在位置。

rows.english: You can tell your soldiers to run by double Right-clicking on the enemy.
rows.rawText: 连续右键点击敌人两次，就能命令士兵奔跑。
rows.current: 连续右键点击敌人两次，就能命令士兵奔跑。

rows.english: You can also hold down the Alt key when you Right-click to command soldiers to run.
rows.rawText: 按住 Alt 键再右键点击，也能让士兵奔跑。
rows.current: 按住 Alt 键再右键点击，也能让士兵奔跑。

rows.english: Did you notice the Cannoneer couldn't fire his cannon when our warriors engaged him?
rows.rawText: 您注意到了吗？我军战士贴近炮手后，他就开不了炮了。
rows.current: 您注意到了吗？我军战士贴近炮手后，他就开不了炮了。

rows.english: Most ranged attackers are much less effective in hand-to-hand combat.
rows.rawText: 多数远程攻击者在近身战中实力会大减。
rows.current: 多数远程攻击者在近身战中实力会大减。

rows.english: This means that engaging them in melee combat is a good way to disable them.
rows.rawText: 所以贴身攻击，是压制他们的好办法。
rows.current: 所以贴身攻击，是压制他们的好办法。

rows.english: Likewise, you should keep your own missile-using soldiers from engaging in melee combat.
rows.rawText: 同样，也要避免让自己的远程士兵卷入近身战。
rows.current: 同样，也要避免让自己的远程士兵卷入近身战。

rows.english: Our Dragon Warriors have fought hard protecting us tonight, so I'll retire them for the evening.
rows.rawText: 龙战士今晚奋力保护我们，我先让他们休息。
rows.current: 龙战士今晚奋力保护我们，我先让他们休息。

rows.english: Hopefully we won't need them any more tonight.
rows.rawText: 希望今晚不再需要他们了。
rows.current: 希望今晚不再需要他们了。

rows.english: It would seem that I spoke too soon - Fire!
Quick, we must douse the fire!
That damned raider must have done this.
rows.rawText: 一定是那个该死的突袭者干的。
rows.current: 一定是那个该死的突袭者干的。

rows.english: A burning building gradually breaks down.
rows.rawText: 着火的建筑会慢慢损坏。
rows.current: 着火的建筑会慢慢损坏。

rows.english: The fiercer the flames, the faster it will burn down.
rows.rawText: 火势越猛，建筑烧毁得就越快。
rows.current: 火势越猛，建筑烧毁得就越快。

rows.english: Do you see the small fire icon in the center of the interface?
rows.rawText: 看到界面中央那个小火焰图标了吗？
rows.current: 看到界面中央那个小火焰图标了吗？

rows.english: Left-click it to instantly focus on the the burning building!
rows.rawText: 左键点击它，就能立刻把画面移到着火的建筑！
rows.current: 左键点击它，就能立刻把画面移到着火的建筑！

rows.english: Oh no! Sparrow's Song is burning!
Don't worry sisters, we'll save you!
rows.rawText: 姐妹们别怕，我们会救你们！
rows.current: 姐妹们别怕，我们会救你们！

rows.english: Select the Peasant and move the cursor over the burning building - notice the cursor changes to the 'Extinguish' cursor.
rows.rawText: 选中农民，把光标移到着火的建筑上；注意光标变成了“灭火”形状。
rows.current: 选中农民，把光标移到着火的建筑上；注意光标变成了“灭火”形状。

rows.english: Right-click to confirm the order and your Peasant will move to extinguish these buildings.
rows.rawText: 右键确认命令，农民就会过去灭火。
rows.current: 右键确认命令，农民就会过去灭火。

rows.english: The Peasant firefighter will gather from the nearest source of water and automatically return to douse the flames.
rows.rawText: 农民会从最近的水源取水，再自动回来扑火。
rows.current: 农民会从最近的水源取水，再自动回来扑火。

rows.english: Even the hottest infernos can be quelled with only a few buckets of water.
rows.rawText: 就算火势再猛，几桶水也能扑灭。
rows.current: 就算火势再猛，几桶水也能扑灭。

rows.english: We were lucky there was a pond nearby.
To deal with fires more effectively, build towns near ponds or other sources of water.
rows.rawText: 要更快灭火，城镇最好建在池塘或其他水源附近。
rows.current: 要更快灭火，城镇最好建在池塘或其他水源附近。

rows.english: My lord, may I humbly ask you to repair Sparrow's Song?
rows.rawText: 大人，能请您修好 Sparrow's Song 吗？
rows.current: 大人，能请您修好 Sparrow's Song 吗？

rows.english: Please select the heroic Peasant that saved my home.
rows.rawText: 请选中救了我们家的那名农民。
rows.current: 请选中救了我们家的那名农民。

rows.english: At the bottom of the interface you'll see a blue icon with a hammer icon on it.
rows.rawText: 界面下方有一个蓝色的锤子图标。
rows.current: 界面下方有一个蓝色的锤子图标。

rows.english: Please select the Repair command and Right-click on the bathhouse.
rows.rawText: 请选择“修复”，再右键点击澡堂。
rows.current: 请选择“修复”，再右键点击澡堂。

rows.english: I don’t think my sisters and I can ever thank you enough for your generosity.
rows.rawText: 我和姐妹们怎么谢您都不够。
rows.current: 我和姐妹们怎么谢您都不够。

rows.english: Now we should think about New Issen's future…
rows.rawText: 现在该想想 New Issen 的未来了……
rows.current: 现在该想想 New Issen 的未来了……

rows.english: My lord, I apologize for asking such an unreasonable request - please forgive me and we'll move on.
rows.rawText: 大人，抱歉提出这么过分的请求。请原谅我，我们继续吧。
rows.current: 大人，抱歉提出这么过分的请求。请原谅我，我们继续吧。

rows.english: Oh dear, we didn't put it out in time…
rows.rawText: 哎呀，我们没来得及灭火……
rows.current: 哎呀，我们没来得及灭火……

rows.english: Fortunately, all of my sisters got away safely.
rows.rawText: 幸好姐妹们都平安逃出来了。
rows.current: 幸好姐妹们都平安逃出来了。

rows.english: Nothing in this life is permanent - there will always be other bathhouses, I suppose.
rows.rawText: 世上没有长久不变的东西。以后还能建别的澡堂吧。
rows.current: 世上没有长久不变的东西。以后还能建别的澡堂吧。

rows.english: It's time we built some town defenses to prevent raids like that from happening again.
rows.rawText: 该建些城镇防御工事，免得再受这种袭击。
rows.current: 该建些城镇防御工事，免得再受这种袭击。

rows.english: If you look at the interface you'll see that we can now build Watchtowers.
rows.rawText: 看界面，现在我们可以建造哨塔了。
rows.current: 看界面，现在我们可以建造哨塔了。

rows.english: Watchtowers are formidable defenses, but we can only support so many.
rows.rawText: 哨塔防御力强，但能建的数量有限。
rows.current: 哨塔防御力强，但能建的数量有限。

rows.english: As our town grows and gains certain structures we will be able to support additional Watchtowers.
rows.rawText: 城镇发展并建成特定建筑后，我们才能支持更多哨塔。
rows.current: 城镇发展并建成特定建筑后，我们才能支持更多哨塔。

rows.english: While we wait for the Watchtower to be completed, we should use the time to train an Archer.
rows.rawText: 等哨塔建好时，正好训练一名弓箭手。
rows.current: 等哨塔建好时，正好训练一名弓箭手。

rows.english: You see, Watchtowers must be manned by soldiers to be effective.
rows.rawText: 哨塔必须派士兵驻守，才能发挥作用。
rows.current: 哨塔必须派士兵驻守，才能发挥作用。

rows.english: Also, they're most useful to missile units, such as the Archer.
rows.rawText: 对弓箭手这样的远程兵种，哨塔特别有用。
rows.current: 对弓箭手这样的远程兵种，哨塔特别有用。

rows.english: Select the new Archer and Right-click on our new Watchtower.
rows.rawText: 选中新训练的弓箭手，右键点击新哨塔。
rows.current: 选中新训练的弓箭手，右键点击新哨塔。

rows.english: Once in the Watchtower, the Archer will not only be defended but also gain increased attack strength, range and sight.
rows.rawText: 进入哨塔后，弓箭手不仅更安全，攻击力、射程和视野也会提高。
rows.current: 进入哨塔后，弓箭手不仅更安全，攻击力、射程和视野也会提高。

rows.english: In addition to their other strengths, each Watchtower has a special ability of its own.
rows.rawText: 此外，每座哨塔都有一种自己的特殊能力。
rows.current: 此外，每座哨塔都有一种自己的特殊能力。

rows.english: Left-click our new Watchtower to select it.
rows.rawText: 左键点击新哨塔，选中它。
rows.current: 左键点击新哨塔，选中它。

rows.english: Look in the bottom left corner of the interface.
Dragon Watchtowers use the Daze ability, but our intelligence shows that other clans' are different.
rows.rawText: 神龙族哨塔能使用“眩晕”，其他族的能力则不同。
rows.current: 神龙族哨塔能使用“眩晕”，其他族的能力则不同。

rows.english: The ability can only be used when the Watchtower is charged with enough spiritual power.
rows.rawText: 只有积累足够灵力，哨塔才能使用特殊能力。
rows.current: 只有积累足够灵力，哨塔才能使用特殊能力。

rows.english: This power is indicated by the Charge meter in next to the ability's activation button.
rows.rawText: 能力按钮旁的充能槽会显示当前灵力。
rows.current: 能力按钮旁的充能槽会显示当前灵力。

rows.english: With your base defenses in order, we should strike against the enemy now.
rows.rawText: 基地防御安排好了，现在该主动攻击敌人。
rows.current: 基地防御安排好了，现在该主动攻击敌人。

rows.english: Our scouts report that the enemies are attacking from this location.
rows.rawText: 探子回报，敌人正从这里发动进攻。
rows.current: 探子回报，敌人正从这里发动进攻。

rows.rawText: 他们犯了一个战术错误！
rows.current: 他们犯了一个战术错误！

rows.english: They built their town at the base of a cliff, something we can use to our advantage.
rows.rawText: 他们把城镇建在悬崖下，这正好能为我军所用。
rows.current: 他们把城镇建在悬崖下，这正好能为我军所用。

rows.english: If we attack from higher ground we will surely win!
rows.rawText: 只要从高处进攻，我们一定能赢！
rows.current: 只要从高处进攻，我们一定能赢！

rows.english: From higher ground our attacks are stronger and we'll be defended from the enemy's assaults, just like in our Watchtowers.
rows.rawText: 站在高地，攻击更强，也更能抵挡敌人，就像待在哨塔里一样。
rows.current: 站在高地，攻击更强，也更能抵挡敌人，就像待在哨塔里一样。

rows.english: Train three Archers and we'll run these scoundrels out of this province for good!
rows.rawText: 训练三名弓箭手，把这群恶徒彻底赶出这一带！
rows.current: 训练三名弓箭手，把这群恶徒彻底赶出这一带！

rows.english: Excellent Lord, our assault team is ready!
rows.rawText: 太好了，大人，进攻部队准备好了！
rows.current: 太好了，大人，进攻部队准备好了！

rows.english: Move our troops to the location indicated on the minimap and attack!
rows.rawText: 把军队移到小地图标出的地方，发动攻击！
rows.current: 把军队移到小地图标出的地方，发动攻击！

rows.english: Excellent, the enemy has been routed!
Their hut still remains, though, and our arrows aren't very effective against buildings…
rows.rawText: 但他们的农舍还在，箭矢对建筑可不太管用……
rows.current: 但他们的农舍还在，箭矢对建筑可不太管用……

rows.english: Perhaps we can crush it with these boulders on the hill?
rows.rawText: 也许能用山上的巨石把它砸毁？
rows.current: 也许能用山上的巨石把它砸毁？

rows.english: Select one of your Archers and Right-click a boulder to push it.
rows.rawText: 选中一名弓箭手，右键点击巨石推动它。
rows.current: 选中一名弓箭手，右键点击巨石推动它。

rows.english: The boulder will roll in the direction it is pushed, so line the Archer up with the building to push it in the right direction.
rows.rawText: 巨石会沿推动方向滚动。让弓箭手对准建筑，再把石头推过去。
rows.current: 巨石会沿推动方向滚动。让弓箭手对准建筑，再把石头推过去。

rows.english: This province is finally free of those enemy scum!
rows.rawText: 这一带终于摆脱了那群敌人！
rows.current: 这一带终于摆脱了那群敌人！

rows.english: I guess we have no other choice - we will have to use our arrows.
rows.rawText: 看来别无选择，只能用箭射。
rows.current: 看来别无选择，只能用箭射。

rows.english: This will take longer, but ultimately we will prevail.
rows.rawText: 这会久一些，但最后我们一定会赢。
rows.current: 这会久一些，但最后我们一定会赢。

rows.english: So much happened today, and the town is still in shambles.
rows.rawText: 今天发生了这么多事，镇子还是一片混乱。
rows.current: 今天发生了这么多事，镇子还是一片混乱。

rows.english: Please rest for tomorrow's training, my lord.
rows.rawText: 大人，请先休息，明天再继续训练。
rows.current: 大人，请先休息，明天再继续训练。

rows.english: You did well and we must rebuild the town.
rows.rawText: 您做得很好，我们还得重建城镇。
rows.current: 您做得很好，我们还得重建城镇。

rows.english: Ah, much better - the town is repaired and the people can return to their daily lives.
rows.rawText: 啊，好多了。城镇已修好，大家又能过平常的日子。
rows.current: 啊，好多了。城镇已修好，大家又能过平常的日子。

rows.english: With New Issen secure, it's time we started freeing other provinces from our enemies.
rows.rawText: New Issen 安全了，该去解放其他地方了。
rows.current: New Issen 安全了，该去解放其他地方了。

rows.english: ...but we're not ready for such an assault.
rows.rawText: ……但我们还没准备好发动这种进攻。
rows.current: ……但我们还没准备好发动这种进攻。

rows.english: Let me help you prepare your forces for the coming battles.
rows.rawText: 让我帮您为接下来的战斗做好准备。
rows.current: 让我帮您为接下来的战斗做好准备。

rows.english: There's much you can do to modify and improve your army's effectiveness in battle.
rows.rawText: 您有很多办法调整军队，让他们打得更好。
rows.current: 您有很多办法调整军队，让他们打得更好。

rows.english: Most soldiers can ride horses into battle and get considerable advantages in battle when they do so.
rows.rawText: 多数士兵可以骑马作战，这样会得到不少好处。
rows.current: 多数士兵可以骑马作战，这样会得到不少好处。

rows.english: Let's try giving a horse to a soldier, shall we?
rows.rawText: 来试着给一名士兵配匹马吧。
rows.current: 来试着给一名士兵配匹马吧。

rows.english: This building will domesticate wild horses and make them battle-ready.
rows.rawText: 马厩能驯服野马，让它们上战场。
rows.current: 马厩能驯服野马，让它们上战场。

rows.english: But where do we get wild horses?
Ah, it looks like this peasant has found some.
rows.rawText: 啊，看来这名农民找到了一些。
rows.current: 啊，看来这名农民找到了一些。

rows.english: Wild horses will always be visible on the minimap as brown dots, so keep an eye out for them.
rows.rawText: 小地图上的棕色点就是野马，留心寻找。
rows.current: 小地图上的棕色点就是野马，留心寻找。

rows.english: Select him and Right-click on a horse to begin the herding process.
rows.rawText: 选中农民，再右键点击一匹马，开始牵它回来。
rows.current: 选中农民，再右键点击一匹马，开始牵它回来。

rows.english: Befriending wild horses is not an easy task.
rows.rawText: 要和野马建立信任，可不是件容易事。
rows.current: 要和野马建立信任，可不是件容易事。

rows.english: Once befriended, the horse will follow your peasant back to the stables.
rows.rawText: 野马愿意跟随以后，就会跟着农民回马厩。
rows.current: 野马愿意跟随以后，就会跟着农民回马厩。

rows.english: Now that the horse has been domesticated, let's mount it.
rows.rawText: 马已经驯服，来让士兵骑上去。
rows.current: 马已经驯服，来让士兵骑上去。

rows.english: Select this Spearman and Right-click on the Stables.
rows.rawText: 选中这名长矛兵，右键点击马厩。
rows.current: 选中这名长矛兵，右键点击马厩。

rows.english: From atop a horse units are more resilient to melee attacks and inflict more damage in battle.
rows.rawText: 骑上马后，士兵更能抵挡近身攻击，造成的伤害也更大。
rows.current: 骑上马后，士兵更能抵挡近身攻击，造成的伤害也更大。

rows.english: In addition, horse-using clans train these steeds with an additional attack of their own.
rows.rawText: 有马的各族还会训练坐骑，让它们自己也能发动攻击。
rows.current: 有马的各族还会训练坐骑，让它们自己也能发动攻击。

rows.english: Select the Spearman you just mounted.
rows.rawText: 选中刚骑上马的长矛兵。
rows.current: 选中刚骑上马的长矛兵。

rows.english: See the button underneath his portrait?
rows.rawText: 看到头像下方的按钮了吗？
rows.current: 看到头像下方的按钮了吗？

rows.english: When this button is pressed, it will initiate the horse's Trample ability.
rows.rawText: 按下按钮，马就会发动“践踏”。
rows.current: 按下按钮，马就会发动“践踏”。

rows.english: Trample deals considerable damage to any enemies that surround the horse, but will deplete some of its stamina.
rows.rawText: 践踏会重伤马周围的敌人，但也会消耗马的体力。
rows.current: 践踏会重伤马周围的敌人，但也会消耗马的体力。

rows.english: Stamina is represented by the blue bar underneath each soldier's green health bar
rows.rawText: 每名士兵绿色生命条下的蓝条显示体力。
rows.current: 每名士兵绿色生命条下的蓝条显示体力。

rows.english: When any soldier runs or uses an ability he will consume stamina.
rows.rawText: 士兵奔跑或使用能力时，都会消耗体力。
rows.current: 士兵奔跑或使用能力时，都会消耗体力。

rows.english: Trample is effective both offensively and defensively, but your horse won't be able to run as long afterwards, so use it carefully.
rows.rawText: 践踏攻守皆宜，但用后马就跑不远了，要谨慎使用。
rows.current: 践踏攻守皆宜，但用后马就跑不远了，要谨慎使用。

rows.english: While they don't mount them, they can use them as packhorses to efficiently carry more resources to the Peasant Huts.
rows.rawText: 他们不骑马，而是让马驮运更多资源，更高效地送回农舍。
rows.current: 他们不骑马，而是让马驮运更多资源，更高效地送回农舍。

rows.english: Finally, a soldier can dismount by selecting it and Left-clicking the ""Dismount"" button in the lower right portion of the interface.
rows.rawText: 要下马，选中士兵，再左键点击界面右下方的“下马”按钮。
rows.current: 要下马，选中士兵，再左键点击界面右下方的“下马”按钮。

rows.english: That's about all there is to know about horses, my lord.
rows.rawText: 大人，关于马，您要知道的差不多就是这些。
rows.current: 大人，关于马，您要知道的差不多就是这些。

rows.english: The second type of enhancement is called 'BattleGear.'
rows.rawText: 第二种强化方式叫“战技”。
rows.current: 第二种强化方式叫“战技”。

rows.english: Please give me a moment to catch my breath…
BattleGear enhance soldiers by giving them additional powers.
rows.rawText: 战技能赋予士兵额外的能力。
rows.current: 战技能赋予士兵额外的能力。

rows.english: For example, an Archer is typically an effective anti-infantry soldier…
rows.rawText: 比如弓箭手通常很擅长对付步兵……
rows.current: 比如弓箭手通常很擅长对付步兵……

rows.english: …But a certain BattleGear will allow him to shoot fiery arrows to destroy buildings.
rows.rawText: ……但有一种战技能让他射出火箭，摧毁建筑。
rows.current: ……但有一种战技能让他射出火箭，摧毁建筑。

rows.english: The Dragon Clan gains BattleGear by training in certain buildings, but other clans may have entirely different approaches.
rows.rawText: 神龙族在特定建筑中训练后能获得战技，其他族也许另有办法。
rows.current: 神龙族在特定建筑中训练后能获得战技，其他族也许另有办法。

rows.english: Select the Dragon Warrior and order him to enter the Shrine.
rows.rawText: 选中龙战士，命令他进入神殿。
rows.current: 选中龙战士，命令他进入神殿。

rows.english: The Dragon Warrior is meditating inside the shrine, unlocking a power deep within himself to use in battle.
rows.rawText: 龙战士正在殿内冥想，唤醒内在力量，用于战斗。
rows.current: 龙战士正在殿内冥想，唤醒内在力量，用于战斗。

rows.english: Excellent - your Dragon Warrior has gained the ability to use the 'Chi Shield.'
rows.rawText: 很好，龙战士学会了“气盾”。
rows.current: 很好，龙战士学会了“气盾”。

rows.english: Now let's try using it - select the Dragon Warrior.
Do you see the  new button underneath the Dragon Warrior's portrait?
rows.rawText: 看到他头像下方的新按钮了吗？
rows.current: 看到他头像下方的新按钮了吗？

rows.english: Left-click it and see what happens.
rows.rawText: 左键点击，看看会发生什么。
rows.current: 左键点击，看看会发生什么。

rows.english: While active, the Dragon Warrior outwardly focuses his life force to protect himself.
rows.rawText: 气盾生效时，龙战士把生命力量向外凝聚，保护自己。
rows.current: 气盾生效时，龙战士把生命力量向外凝聚，保护自己。

rows.english: The concentration needed to maintain the Chi Shield renders him immobile, but he is completely impervious to damage.
rows.rawText: 维持气盾需要全神贯注，他无法移动，但任何攻击都伤不到他。
rows.current: 维持气盾需要全神贯注，他无法移动，但任何攻击都伤不到他。

rows.english: As a diversionary measure, the Chi Shield is unparalleled.
rows.rawText: 用气盾吸引敌人注意，效果无人能及。
rows.current: 用气盾吸引敌人注意，效果无人能及。

rows.english: Notice that his stamina is steadily depleting.
rows.rawText: 看，他的体力正在慢慢减少。
rows.current: 看，他的体力正在慢慢减少。

rows.english: The Chi Shield can be turned off whenever you wish, but will automatically dissipate when the Dragon Warrior's stamina is depleted.
rows.rawText: 您随时可以关闭气盾；体力耗尽时，它也会自动消失。
rows.current: 您随时可以关闭气盾；体力耗尽时，它也会自动消失。

rows.rawText: 并非所有战技都消耗体力。
rows.current: 并非所有战技都消耗体力。

rows.english: Some have unlimited use, some have strict limitations and some even consume the user's health.
rows.rawText: 有些能无限使用，有些限制严格，还有些会消耗使用者的生命。
rows.current: 有些能无限使用，有些限制严格，还有些会消耗使用者的生命。

rows.english: For more information a BattleGear's function, place your cursor over the button and check the tooltip on the left side of the screen.
rows.rawText: 想了解战技的效果，把光标放在按钮上，看屏幕左侧的提示。
rows.current: 想了解战技的效果，把光标放在按钮上，看屏幕左侧的提示。

rows.english: Each warrior type gets different abilities from the BattleGear buildings, so experiment and try training a variety of units.
rows.rawText: 不同战士在战技建筑里会得到不同能力，多试试各种兵种。
rows.current: 不同战士在战技建筑里会得到不同能力，多试试各种兵种。

rows.english: On to the final improvement type.
rows.rawText: 接下来是最后一种强化方式。
rows.current: 接下来是最后一种强化方式。

rows.english: During the previous battles, you were blessed with some points of Yang.
rows.rawText: 之前的战斗让您得到了一些阳之力。
rows.current: 之前的战斗让您得到了一些阳之力。

rows.english: These tokens of spiritual power are earned through battle.
rows.rawText: 这种灵力会在战斗中获得。
rows.current: 这种灵力会在战斗中获得。

rows.english: The better our forces fight the faster we'll earn them.
rows.rawText: 我军打得越好，得到得就越快。
rows.current: 我军打得越好，得到得就越快。

rows.english: As a noble and enlightened clan, we received points of Yang.
rows.rawText: 我们是崇高明理的一族，因此获得的是阳之力。
rows.current: 我们是崇高明理的一族，因此获得的是阳之力。

rows.english: These are denoted by the white tokens to the left of the interface's central Yin Yang icon.
rows.rawText: 界面中央阴阳图标左侧的白色点数就是阳之力。
rows.current: 界面中央阴阳图标左侧的白色点数就是阳之力。

rows.english: Darker clans, like our Serpent attackers, accrue black tokens of Yin.
rows.rawText: 像来犯的灵蛇族这样较黑暗的族群，积累的是黑色的阴之力。
rows.current: 像来犯的灵蛇族这样较黑暗的族群，积累的是黑色的阴之力。

rows.english: Once acquired, we can focus Yang to improve our forces' battle prowess.
rows.rawText: 有了阳之力，就能集中它来提高我军战力。
rows.current: 有了阳之力，就能集中它来提高我军战力。

rows.english: Select the Dojo by Left-clicking it.
My lord, this is the Target Range.
The Dojo is the building on the left.
Please select the Dojo so you can continue to learn about techniques.
rows.rawText: 请选中道场，继续学习技法。
rows.current: 请选中道场，继续学习技法。

rows.english: You'll notice on the right side of the interface two icons.
rows.rawText: 看界面右侧，有两个图标。
rows.current: 看界面右侧，有两个图标。

rows.english: Each of these is a 'Technique,' an enhancement purchased with Yin or Yang.
rows.rawText: 每个图标代表一种技法，可以用阴或阳之力购买。
rows.current: 每个图标代表一种技法，可以用阴或阳之力购买。

rows.english: Unlike BattleGear, which only improves an individual, Techniques upgrade entire ranks of soldiers!
rows.rawText: 战技只强化个别士兵，技法却能强化整类士兵！
rows.current: 战技只强化个别士兵，技法却能强化整类士兵！

rows.english: By moving your mouse over these icons you can read the effects of the technique in the tooltip on the left side of the screen.
rows.rawText: 把鼠标移到图标上，屏幕左侧提示会说明技法效果。
rows.current: 把鼠标移到图标上，屏幕左侧提示会说明技法效果。

rows.english: Begin learning one of these techniques by Left-clicking its icon.
rows.rawText: 左键点击一个技法图标，开始学习。
rows.current: 左键点击一个技法图标，开始学习。

rows.english: I suppose there's no harm in learning one of the Target Range's techniques, my lord.
rows.rawText: 大人，先学靶场的一项技法也无妨。
rows.current: 大人，先学靶场的一项技法也无妨。

rows.english: While a training building's masters meditate on the chosen technique they will be unable to admit new trainees, so plan ahead.
rows.rawText: 训练建筑的师傅冥想技法期间，无法接收新学员，得事先安排好。
rows.current: 训练建筑的师傅冥想技法期间，无法接收新学员，得事先安排好。

rows.english: All existing Spearmen have become stronger and all future Spearmen will benefit, as well.
rows.rawText: 现有长矛兵都变强了，以后训练的长矛兵也会受益。
rows.current: 现有长矛兵都变强了，以后训练的长矛兵也会受益。

rows.english: Effective use of Techniques can give you the edge over your opponent.
rows.rawText: 善用技法，就能在战斗中占上风。
rows.current: 善用技法，就能在战斗中占上风。

rows.english: Use them wisely to complement your existing strategy.
rows.rawText: 要让技法配合既定战术，谨慎使用。
rows.current: 要让技法配合既定战术，谨慎使用。

rows.english: With upgrades out of the way, we've completed your training.
rows.rawText: 强化也讲完了，您的训练到此结束。
rows.current: 强化也讲完了，您的训练到此结束。

rows.english: Reflect on what you've learned today.
rows.rawText: 回想一下今天学到的东西。
rows.current: 回想一下今天学到的东西。

rows.english: If you forget something and would like to go through these lessons again, I'd be honored to review them with you.
rows.rawText: 如果忘了什么，想重新上一遍课，我很乐意再陪您回顾。
rows.current: 如果忘了什么，想重新上一遍课，我很乐意再陪您回顾。

rows.english: Let's continue with your training, my lord.
I'll repeat what I said, in case you forgot.
My lord, we should act quickly.
My lord, the unit is needed over here.
rows.rawText: 大人，这里需要那名单位。
rows.current: 大人，这里需要那名单位。

rows.english: How did they get past Serpentholm?
rows.rawText: 他们怎么穿过 灵蛇城 的？
rows.current: 他们怎么穿过 灵蛇城 的？

rows.english: If we circle around, we can avoid them.
I was hoping you'd say that.
If I squint just right, I can already see Shinja's head on a pike.
rows.rawText: 我仿佛已经看见信蛇的头插在长矛上。
rows.current: 我仿佛已经看见信蛇的头插在长矛上。

rows.rawText: 可那是灵蛇族祖先的王城……
rows.current: 可那是灵蛇族祖先的王城……

rows.english: They're finished.  The Lotus has beaten them.
rows.rawText: 他们完了。莲花族打败了他们。
rows.current: 他们完了。莲花族打败了他们。

rows.english: There's still the Lotus to fight.  Look here.
rows.rawText: 还得对付莲花族。看这里。
rows.current: 还得对付莲花族。看这里。

rows.english: The Lotus crushed the last Wolf resistance in the mountains.
rows.rawText: 莲花族击溃了山里最后的恶狼族抵抗力量。
rows.current: 莲花族击溃了山里最后的恶狼族抵抗力量。

rows.english: They now control all the high ground and the richest mining regions.
rows.rawText: 他们现在控制了所有高地和最富饶的矿区。
rows.current: 他们现在控制了所有高地和最富饶的矿区。

rows.english: They haven't moved on these provinces yet.
rows.rawText: 他们还没向这些地方进军。
rows.current: 他们还没向这些地方进军。

rows.english: The Lotus clan's victory over the Wolf has made them bold.
rows.rawText: 战胜恶狼族，让莲花族更加大胆。
rows.current: 战胜恶狼族，让莲花族更加大胆。

rows.english: It's only a matter of time before they attack the monasteries.
rows.rawText: 他们攻打禅院只是迟早的事。
rows.current: 他们攻打禅院只是迟早的事。

rows.english: The holy brothers would be valuable allies.
rows.rawText: 那些圣兄弟会是可靠的盟友。
rows.current: 那些圣兄弟会是可靠的盟友。

rows.english: Hmph!  I've never trusted those assassins.
rows.rawText: 哼！我从来不信任那些刺客。
rows.current: 哼！我从来不信任那些刺客。

rows.english: They'd betray us as soon as the gold ran out.
rows.rawText: 金子一用完，他们就会背叛我们。
rows.current: 金子一用完，他们就会背叛我们。

rows.english: We'll have to take the bridges if we want to cross the river.
rows.rawText: 要过河，就必须拿下那些桥。
rows.current: 要过河，就必须拿下那些桥。

rows.english: The river's low.  We can get the men across.
rows.rawText: 河水不深，可以带人过去。
rows.current: 河水不深，可以带人过去。

rows.english: But you said the Orb doesn't matter.
Did your dragon do all this?
rows.rawText: 这一切都是你的神龙做的？
rows.current: 这一切都是你的神龙做的？

rows.english: Cut the other bridge - we'll seal them on the High Plateau!
rows.rawText: 毁掉另一座桥，把他们困在 High Plateau！
rows.current: 毁掉另一座桥，把他们困在 High Plateau！

rows.english: If we hadn't cut the bridges, the Lotus would have taken the monastery.
rows.rawText: 要不是我们毁了那些桥，莲花族早就夺下禅院了。
rows.current: 要不是我们毁了那些桥，莲花族早就夺下禅院了。

rows.english: I am Kenji of the Serpent clan, and my ancestor broke the world.
rows.rawText: 我是灵蛇族的健治。我的祖先曾令世界分崩离析。
rows.current: 我是灵蛇族的健治。我的祖先曾令世界分崩离析。

rows.english: The Horde was destroying everything in its path, so he gathered the clan and fled south, saving what little he could.
rows.rawText: 魔潮所到之处尽成荒地，他便率领族人南逃，尽力保住仅存的一切。
rows.current: 魔潮所到之处尽成荒地，他便率领族人南逃，尽力保住仅存的一切。

rows.english: But when they got to the High Plateau, there was nowhere left to run.
rows.rawText: 可当他们抵达高原时，前方已无路可逃。
rows.current: 可当他们抵达高原时，前方已无路可逃。

rows.english: Tarrant died without knowing what his choice to stay behind truly meant.
rows.rawText: 塔兰特 至死也不知道，留下来究竟意味着什么。
rows.current: 塔兰特 至死也不知道，留下来究竟意味着什么。

rows.english: He didn't know that the Horde would be only the first of many enemies to plague the Serpent clan.
rows.rawText: 他还不知道，魔潮不过是灵蛇族日后接连遭遇的灾厄之始。
rows.current: 他还不知道，魔潮不过是灵蛇族日后接连遭遇的灾厄之始。

rows.english: He couldn't know that without the Orb's power to guide them, his descendents would be weak and wicked.
rows.rawText: 他更不可能知道，失去宝珠的指引，后代会变得软弱而邪恶。
rows.current: 他更不可能知道，失去宝珠的指引，后代会变得软弱而邪恶。

rows.english: Did he ever truly have a choice?
It's been a long time, Otomo.
That blade has been my burden for seven years.
rows.rawText: 这把刀，我已背负了七年。
rows.current: 这把刀，我已背负了七年。

rows.english: If you're so eager to avenge the Serpent, pick it up.
rows.rawText: 若你真想替巨蛇雪恨，就拿起它。
rows.current: 若你真想替巨蛇雪恨，就拿起它。

rows.rawText: 那些匪徒是替信蛇办事的？
rows.current: 那些匪徒是替信蛇办事的？

rows.english: Shinja served my father loyally for years.
rows.rawText: 信蛇多年来一直忠心侍奉我父亲。
rows.current: 信蛇多年来一直忠心侍奉我父亲。

rows.english: I didn't come back to repeat my father's mistakes.
rows.rawText: 我回来不是要重犯父亲的错误。
rows.current: 我回来不是要重犯父亲的错误。

rows.english: You were charged with protecting the Orb.
How has the Swan's Pool survived?
rows.rawText: 天鹅池是怎么幸存下来的？
rows.current: 天鹅池是怎么幸存下来的？

rows.english: They've had a lot of practice.
rows.rawText: 他们已经做过很多次了。
rows.current: 他们已经做过很多次了。

rows.english: If it's not us driving them into the ground, it's their warlock masters.
rows.rawText: 不是我们把他们逼入绝境，就是他们的术士主人。
rows.current: 不是我们把他们逼入绝境，就是他们的术士主人。

rows.rawText: 你的意思是，你要统治他们。
rows.current: 你的意思是，你要统治他们。

rows.english: Not the way father fights it.
rows.rawText: 但不能用父亲那套办法。
rows.current: 但不能用父亲那套办法。

rows.english: There must be a better way.
If we push on, we can reach the Swan's Pool by dusk.
rows.rawText: 继续赶路的话，天黑前就能到天鹅池。
rows.current: 继续赶路的话，天黑前就能到天鹅池。

rows.rawText: 那个贼……他为什么会来这里？
rows.current: 那个贼……他为什么会来这里？

rows.english: Did he get the Serpent's Orb?
I've no time for riddles, woman.
I've no quarrel with the other clans.
rows.rawText: 我不想与其他氏族交战。
rows.current: 我不想与其他氏族交战。

rows.english: You've seen the Orb.  It's real.
If it's to be done, let's do it quickly.
Let's teach this upstart clan a lesson.
rows.rawText: 给这个新起的氏族一点教训。
rows.current: 给这个新起的氏族一点教训。

rows.english: When the Orb wakes, so does the Dragon.
rows.rawText: 宝珠醒来，神龙也会醒来。
rows.current: 宝珠醒来，神龙也会醒来。

rows.english: It's not called the Dragon's Spire for nothing.
rows.rawText: 龙之尖塔可不是白叫这个名字的。
rows.current: 龙之尖塔可不是白叫这个名字的。

rows.english: It's the Orb they're after, not me.
rows.rawText: 他们要的是宝珠，不是我。
rows.current: 他们要的是宝珠，不是我。

rows.rawText: 通往 灵蛇城 的关键。
rows.current: 通往 灵蛇城 的关键。

rows.english: I made new friends while I was away.
rows.rawText: 我离开时结识了新朋友。
rows.current: 我离开时结识了新朋友。

rows.english: You'll not hide behind your geisha tonight!
rows.rawText: 今夜你别想躲在艺伎身后！
rows.current: 今夜你别想躲在艺伎身后！

rows.english: Whether I'm second son or tenth, I'll make you hear me!
rows.rawText: 不管我是次子还是第十子，你都得听我说！
rows.current: 不管我是次子还是第十子，你都得听我说！

rows.english: And the one who stole the Orb?
The Dragon and the Orb are one.
The Orb was only half of Tarrant's power.
rows.rawText: 宝珠只承载了 塔兰特 一半的力量。
rows.current: 宝珠只承载了 塔兰特 一半的力量。

rows.english: I have to go to the Dragon's Spire.
Let Shinja contain the Lotus and Wolf if he can.
rows.rawText: 信蛇若有本事，就让他拖住莲花族和恶狼族。
rows.current: 信蛇若有本事，就让他拖住莲花族和恶狼族。

rows.english: The thief was not of the Lotus.
rows.rawText: 偷走它的人不是莲花族。
rows.current: 偷走它的人不是莲花族。

rows.english: Tarrant used the Orb to break the world.
rows.rawText: 塔兰特 曾用宝珠让世界破碎。
rows.current: 塔兰特 曾用宝珠让世界破碎。

rows.rawText: 这片土地必须恢复生机。
rows.current: 这片土地必须恢复生机。

rows.english: Without the Orb, how do I repair the damage my clan has done?
rows.rawText: 没有宝珠，我该怎么修复本族造成的伤害？
rows.current: 没有宝珠，我该怎么修复本族造成的伤害？

rows.rawText: 神龙的时代已经过去了。
rows.current: 神龙的时代已经过去了。

rows.english: We shouldn't have gone to him.
No.  The village nearby will help us.
rows.rawText: 不。附近的村子会帮我们。
rows.current: 不。附近的村子会帮我们。

rows.english: The Lotus will find no friends here.
rows.rawText: 莲花族在这里找不到帮手。
rows.current: 莲花族在这里找不到帮手。

rows.english: Burn Serpentholm.  Burn it to the ground.
rows.rawText: 烧掉 灵蛇城。把它烧成平地。
rows.current: 烧掉 灵蛇城。把它烧成平地。

rows.english: Give them food and house them in the supply tents.
rows.rawText: 给他们食物，让他们住进补给营地。
rows.current: 给他们食物，让他们住进补给营地。

rows.english: The Wolf clan isn't the enemy any more.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族已经不是敌人了。
rows.current: 恶狼族已经不是敌人了。

rows.english: Even in my father's time, those lands were independent.
rows.rawText: 即使在我父亲的时代，那些土地也保持独立。
rows.current: 即使在我父亲的时代，那些土地也保持独立。

rows.english: The plateaus to the east are holy ground and the western province was granted to the ninja.
rows.rawText: 东边的高原是圣地，西边的行省则赐给了忍者。
rows.current: 东边的高原是圣地，西边的行省则赐给了忍者。

rows.english: The monks and ninja were always fighting, and my father sought to separate them.
rows.rawText: 僧侣和忍者向来争斗，父亲想把他们隔开。
rows.current: 僧侣和忍者向来争斗，父亲想把他们隔开。

rows.english: If we align ourselves with the monks, the ninja will turn on us.
rows.rawText: 若我们与僧侣结盟，忍者就会与我们为敌。
rows.current: 若我们与僧侣结盟，忍者就会与我们为敌。

rows.english: The ninja once served the Lotus, and might know their secrets.
rows.rawText: 忍者曾为莲花族效力，也许知道他们的秘密。
rows.current: 忍者曾为莲花族效力，也许知道他们的秘密。

rows.english: True...and if we enlist the ninja, we can be certain the monks will join the Lotus.
rows.rawText: 没错……若我们拉拢忍者，僧侣肯定会加入莲花族。
rows.current: 没错……若我们拉拢忍者，僧侣肯定会加入莲花族。

rows.english: Where is my father's most trusted advisor?
rows.rawText: 我父亲最信任的顾问在哪里？
rows.current: 我父亲最信任的顾问在哪里？

rows.english: I know that if he doesn't kill you, I will.
rows.rawText: 我知道：他若不杀你，我也会杀你。
rows.current: 我知道：他若不杀你，我也会杀你。

rows.english: The Lotus are using the Orb to rid themselves of corruption.
rows.rawText: 莲花族正用宝珠清除自身的腐化。
rows.current: 莲花族正用宝珠清除自身的腐化。

rows.rawText: 他们的信念给了它力量。
rows.current: 他们的信念给了它力量。

rows.english: I am Kenji, Lord of the Dragon clan.
For years, his descendants cowered behind their stone walls, hating each other and fearing the dark.
rows.rawText: 多年来，他的后代躲在石壁后，互相憎恨，又惧怕黑暗。
rows.current: 多年来，他的后代躲在石壁后，互相憎恨，又惧怕黑暗。

rows.english: They never understood that even in the very heart of Serpentholm, shadows lurked in every corner.
rows.rawText: 他们不明白，即使在 灵蛇城 的中心，阴影也潜伏在每个角落。
rows.current: 他们不明白，即使在 灵蛇城 的中心，阴影也潜伏在每个角落。

rows.english: The darkness will always be out there, trying to make us afraid.
rows.rawText: 黑暗永远都在外面，想让我们感到恐惧。
rows.current: 黑暗永远都在外面，想让我们感到恐惧。

rows.english: We face the future a united land.
rows.rawText: 这片土地将团结一心，迎接未来。
rows.current: 这片土地将团结一心，迎接未来。

rows.english: It's time to make the shadows afraid.
Would you betray your lord so casually?
rows.rawText: 你就这样轻易背叛你的领主？
rows.current: 你就这样轻易背叛你的领主？

rows.english: Shinja and Otomo fight each other?
rows.rawText: 信蛇和大友在互相争斗？
rows.current: 信蛇和大友在互相争斗？

rows.english: Why do my father's lap dogs tear at the scraps of his empire?
rows.rawText: 我父亲的手下为何要争抢他帝国剩下的东西？
rows.current: 我父亲的手下为何要争抢他帝国剩下的东西？

rows.english: True...the peasants are an ill-mannered bunch, in need of schooling.
rows.rawText: 没错……农民这群人没规矩，得好好教训。
rows.current: 没错……农民这群人没规矩，得好好教训。

rows.english: And Shinja and Otomo are weaklings, not fit to rule.
rows.rawText: 信蛇和大友都是弱者，不配统治。
rows.current: 信蛇和大友都是弱者，不配统治。

rows.english: Submit or I'll take your head.
rows.rawText: 臣服，否则我砍下你的头。
rows.current: 臣服，否则我砍下你的头。

rows.rawText: 你们为什么一直打下去？
rows.current: 你们为什么一直打下去？

rows.rawText: 你们以前都是灵蛇族的人。
rows.current: 你们以前都是灵蛇族的人。

rows.english: Now you're both mine, or you're both dead.
rows.rawText: 现在你们要么归我，要么都得死。
rows.current: 现在你们要么归我，要么都得死。

rows.english: You were charged with protecting Tarrant's Orb.
rows.rawText: 你们奉命守护 塔兰特 的宝珠。
rows.current: 你们奉命守护 塔兰特 的宝珠。

rows.english: You gave the sacred orb to the geisha?
rows.rawText: 你们把神圣的宝珠交给了艺伎？
rows.current: 你们把神圣的宝珠交给了艺伎？

rows.english: The Lotus were always jealous of the Orb's power.
rows.rawText: 莲花族一直眼红宝珠的力量。
rows.current: 莲花族一直眼红宝珠的力量。

rows.english: The old taboos won't last much longer.
The Swan's Pool is here, to the north.
The most direct route is straight through Riverside.
rows.rawText: 最近的路直穿 河畔镇。
rows.current: 最近的路直穿 河畔镇。

rows.english: We should have killed them all when we had the chance.
rows.rawText: 当初就该趁机把他们全杀了。
rows.current: 当初就该趁机把他们全杀了。

rows.english: My homes.  Their fields, their livestock, their daughters, their sons - all mine.
rows.rawText: 我的家园。他们的田地、牲口、女儿和儿子——全都属于我。
rows.current: 我的家园。他们的田地、牲口、女儿和儿子——全都属于我。

rows.english: There are worse men to be.
If we push on, we can reach the Swan's Pool by dusk.
rows.rawText: 继续赶路，黄昏前就能到天鹅池。
rows.current: 继续赶路，黄昏前就能到天鹅池。

rows.rawText: 把 塔兰特 的宝珠交给我。
rows.current: 把 塔兰特 的宝珠交给我。

rows.english: It will be safer in my hands.
Don't they understand who I am?
rows.rawText: 他们难道不明白我是谁？
rows.current: 他们难道不明白我是谁？

rows.english: We hit them, hard and fast.
Execute the loudmouthed one and bring the rest.
rows.rawText: 处决话最多的那个，把其他人带来。
rows.current: 处决话最多的那个，把其他人带来。

rows.english: Let them fight each other while we take what is ours.
rows.rawText: 我们取回本该属于我们的东西，让他们互相残杀。
rows.current: 我们取回本该属于我们的东西，让他们互相残杀。

rows.english: I made some new friends while I was away.
rows.rawText: 我离开期间结识了不少新朋友。
rows.current: 我离开期间结识了不少新朋友。

rows.english: That creature killed my father, and you let him escape.
rows.rawText: 那怪物杀了我父亲，你却让它逃了。
rows.current: 那怪物杀了我父亲，你却让它逃了。

rows.english: I've no more time to waste.
I must have the Orb if I am to rule.
rows.rawText: 要成为统治者，我必须得到宝珠。
rows.current: 要成为统治者，我必须得到宝珠。

rows.english: We'll leave a garrison at Serpentholm.
rows.rawText: 我们会在 灵蛇城 留下一支守军。
rows.current: 我们会在 灵蛇城 留下一支守军。

rows.english: No doubt he seeks an alliance with the Lotus or Wolf.
rows.rawText: 他肯定是想与莲花族或恶狼族结盟。
rows.current: 他肯定是想与莲花族或恶狼族结盟。

rows.english: I will take the main army north into these provinces and make sure he finds only corpses to befriend.
rows.rawText: 我会率主力北上，让他一路上只能与死人为伴。
rows.current: 我会率主力北上，让他一路上只能与死人为伴。

rows.english: These lands were once loyal to the Serpent.
rows.rawText: 这些地方曾效忠灵蛇族。
rows.current: 这些地方曾效忠灵蛇族。

rows.english: They must be brought back under control.
Shinja, take your men south toward the Dragon's Spire and pacify the villages along the way.
rows.rawText: 信蛇，带你的人向南前往龙之尖塔，一路平定各村庄。
rows.current: 信蛇，带你的人向南前往龙之尖塔，一路平定各村庄。

rows.english: Burn them to the ground if they resist.
rows.rawText: 他们要是反抗，就把村子烧光。
rows.current: 他们要是反抗，就把村子烧光。

rows.english: Otomo will follow behind and clean up the surviving rabble.
rows.rawText: 大友会跟在后面，清理剩下的乌合之众。
rows.current: 大友会跟在后面，清理剩下的乌合之众。

rows.english: If they're loyal, they have nothing to fear from me.
rows.rawText: 只要他们忠诚，就不必怕我。
rows.current: 只要他们忠诚，就不必怕我。

rows.english: I kill to make the clan stronger.
rows.rawText: 我杀人是为了让族人更强大。
rows.current: 我杀人是为了让族人更强大。

rows.english: I carve away the fat and save the lean.
rows.rawText: 我除掉无用之人，留下精兵。
rows.current: 我除掉无用之人，留下精兵。

rows.english: I won't tolerate cowards or shirkers.
rows.rawText: 我不会容忍胆小鬼和不肯出力的人。
rows.current: 我不会容忍胆小鬼和不肯出力的人。

rows.english: Since the Lotus were beaten at the Swan's Pool, they have lost every battle.
rows.rawText: 自从莲花族在天鹅池战败，他们就一战接一战地输。
rows.current: 自从莲花族在天鹅池战败，他们就一战接一战地输。

rows.english: Finishing them here, before they retreat to their keep, would put an end to them once and for all.
rows.rawText: 趁他们还没退回要塞，在这里彻底打败他们。
rows.current: 趁他们还没退回要塞，在这里彻底打败他们。

rows.english: The barbarous Wolf clan is still strong here, around the mines.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族的主力还在矿区一带。
rows.current: 恶狼族的主力还在矿区一带。

rows.english: A head-on assault would be costly, but would deprive the Wolf of their armories.
rows.rawText: 正面强攻代价不小，但能夺走他们的兵器库。
rows.current: 正面强攻代价不小，但能夺走他们的兵器库。

rows.english: On the other hand, if I take the men through the swamps here, we might outflank the Wolf.
rows.rawText: 但要是带人穿过沼泽，也许能绕到恶狼族侧翼。
rows.current: 但要是带人穿过沼泽，也许能绕到恶狼族侧翼。

rows.english: They would be forced to shift troops to counter, weakening them on other fronts.
rows.rawText: 他们就得派兵应对，其他地方的防线也会变弱。
rows.current: 他们就得派兵应对，其他地方的防线也会变弱。

rows.english: Why are you so eager to die?
I would have let you live another year, perhaps even two.
rows.rawText: 我本来还会让你多活一两年。
rows.current: 我本来还会让你多活一两年。

rows.english: This necromancer you found...can he be trusted?
rows.rawText: 你找到的那个死灵法师……能信吗？
rows.current: 你找到的那个死灵法师……能信吗？

rows.english: Then he'll be loyal for a while yet.
The scouts report that the Wolf have burned the Lotus keep to the ground.
rows.rawText: 探子回报，恶狼族把莲花族要塞烧光了。
rows.current: 探子回报，恶狼族把莲花族要塞烧光了。

rows.english: They still control all the high ground and the mining regions.
rows.rawText: 他们仍控制着所有高地和矿区。
rows.current: 他们仍控制着所有高地和矿区。

rows.english: The monks have held the eastern plateaus for years.
rows.rawText: 那些僧人在东边高地待了多年。
rows.current: 那些僧人在东边高地待了多年。

rows.english: And my father gave the western swamps to the ninja to keep them far away from holy ground.
rows.rawText: 我父亲把西边沼泽交给忍者，就是为了让他们远离圣地。
rows.current: 我父亲把西边沼泽交给忍者，就是为了让他们远离圣地。

rows.english: The ninja once served the Lotus, and the Wolf have not forgotten it.
rows.rawText: 忍者曾效力于莲花族，恶狼族一直记着这事。
rows.current: 忍者曾效力于莲花族，恶狼族一直记着这事。

rows.english: Their peasants are superstitious and are deathly afraid of the assassins.
rows.rawText: 他们的农民很迷信，怕那些刺客怕得要命。
rows.current: 他们的农民很迷信，怕那些刺客怕得要命。

rows.english: If the ninja joined our cause, we would be unstoppable.
rows.rawText: 如果忍者加入我们，谁也挡不住我们。
rows.current: 如果忍者加入我们，谁也挡不住我们。

rows.english: They keep to themselves and never much cared for my father.
rows.rawText: 他们一向独来独往，也不怎么喜欢我父亲。
rows.current: 他们一向独来独往，也不怎么喜欢我父亲。

rows.english: The Wolf protect my father's killer.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族在保护杀我父亲的人。
rows.current: 恶狼族在保护杀我父亲的人。

rows.english: They're trying to use the Orb.
If they remake the world, they can escape to the continent.
rows.rawText: 如果他们重造这个世界，就能逃往大陆。
rows.current: 如果他们重造这个世界，就能逃往大陆。

rows.english: You'll have your fill tonight, Dead One.
I am Kenji, Lord of the Serpent clan, and my ancestor broke the world.
rows.rawText: 我是灵蛇族领主健治；我的祖先让这个世界分崩离析。
rows.current: 我是灵蛇族领主健治；我的祖先让这个世界分崩离析。

rows.english: For two centuries, my people hid, praying for the Dragon's protection.
rows.rawText: 两个世纪以来，我的族人一直藏身，求神龙保护。
rows.current: 两个世纪以来，我的族人一直藏身，求神龙保护。

rows.english: But the Dragon was only a myth.
The meek and useless are all gone now.
rows.rawText: 软弱无用的人都不在了。
rows.current: 软弱无用的人都不在了。

rows.english: The last of the cowards died with the traitor Otomo.
rows.rawText: 最后的胆小鬼和叛徒大友一同死了。
rows.current: 最后的胆小鬼和叛徒大友一同死了。

rows.english: It's time to make the shadows afraid.
After I am selected, right-click on the ground and I will move.
rows.rawText: 选中我后，右键点击地面，我就会移动。
rows.current: 选中我后，右键点击地面，我就会移动。

rows.english: Alternatively, right-click on an enemy and I will attack.
rows.rawText: 或者，右键点击敌人，我就会攻击。
rows.current: 或者，右键点击敌人，我就会攻击。

rows.english: Left-click something else if you want to deselect me.
rows.rawText: 想取消选中我，就左键点击别处。
rows.current: 想取消选中我，就左键点击别处。

rows.english: It's either you or Shinja - your choice.
rows.rawText: 你和信蛇，二选一。你自己决定。
rows.current: 你和信蛇，二选一。你自己决定。

rows.english: Do you really value his life over yours?
rows.rawText: 你真认为他的命比你自己的更重要？
rows.current: 你真认为他的命比你自己的更重要？

rows.rawText: 把他们尸体上的装束取下来。
rows.current: 把他们尸体上的装束取下来。

rows.english: Would Shinja kill his own men?

rows.rawText: 奥贾 大人是我父亲。
rows.current: 奥贾 大人是我父亲。

rows.english: How did you know where I was?
We need to pass through town.

rows.rawText: 啊……加林 将军。他还好吗？
rows.current: 啊……加林 将军。他还好吗？

rows.english: We were told to stay away while the Lotus clan's in town.
rows.rawText: 他们说莲花族进城时，我们得躲远点。
rows.current: 他们说莲花族进城时，我们得躲远点。

rows.english: That doesn't sound like the Garrin I know.
rows.rawText: 这不像我认识的 加林。
rows.current: 这不像我认识的 加林。

rows.english: Then the Lotus has an enemy.
rows.rawText: 那莲花族可多了一个敌人。
rows.current: 那莲花族可多了一个敌人。

rows.english: The Lotus knew what it meant to build a village this close to the Spire.
rows.rawText: 莲花族知道，在离尖塔这么近的地方建村意味着什么。
rows.current: 莲花族知道，在离尖塔这么近的地方建村意味着什么。

rows.english: I seek your wisdom, ancient one.
I want to heal the damage my family has done to the land.
rows.rawText: 我想修复家族对这片土地造成的伤害。
rows.current: 我想修复家族对这片土地造成的伤害。

rows.english: I want to end this war.
I can do it if you'll help me.
rows.rawText: 只要你帮我，我就能做到。
rows.current: 只要你帮我，我就能做到。

rows.english: You knew there was a ninja there?
Will you take us to this Soul Flame?
rows.rawText: 你能带我们 去找 魂焰 吗？
rows.current: 你能带我们 去找 魂焰 吗？

rows.english: The Lotus have something that belongs to my family.
rows.rawText: 莲花族手里有我家的东西。
rows.current: 莲花族手里有我家的东西。

rows.english: You're going to help me get it back.
It's been too long, good brother.
Gather the rest of the monks and be ready to fight.
rows.rawText: 召集其他僧人，做好战斗准备。
rows.current: 召集其他僧人，做好战斗准备。

rows.english: Is there another way to cross to the High Plateau from here?
rows.rawText: 从这里到 High Plateau，还有别的路吗？
rows.current: 从这里到 High Plateau，还有别的路吗？

rows.english: They'll be ready for us now.
rows.rawText: 他们现在肯定有了防备。
rows.current: 他们现在肯定有了防备。

rows.english: You and your kind died centuries ago!
rows.rawText: 你和你的同类早在数个世纪前就死了！
rows.current: 你和你的同类早在数个世纪前就死了！

rows.english: It's been a long time, Otomo.
Why are you attacking Shinja's men?
rows.rawText: 你为什么攻击信蛇的人？
rows.current: 你为什么攻击信蛇的人？

rows.english: The peasants of the southern provinces should obey him.
rows.rawText: 南方各地的农民本该听他的。
rows.current: 南方各地的农民本该听他的。

rows.english: He is captain of the Serpent guard.
rows.rawText: 他是灵蛇族卫队的队长。
rows.current: 他是灵蛇族卫队的队长。

rows.english: Lead me to Shinja, and I will try to forget this nauseating conversation.
rows.rawText: 带我去找信蛇，我会尽量忘掉这场令人作呕的谈话。
rows.current: 带我去找信蛇，我会尽量忘掉这场令人作呕的谈话。

rows.english: He's still able to pay his other mercenaries.
rows.rawText: 他还能付得起其他雇佣兵。
rows.current: 他还能付得起其他雇佣兵。

rows.english: I found this box of jewels in the camp of the raiders to the northwest.
rows.rawText: 我在西北方那群劫匪的营地里找到了一箱珠宝。
rows.current: 我在西北方那群劫匪的营地里找到了一箱珠宝。

rows.english: If you'll work for me, they're yours.
rows.rawText: 只要替我做事，这些就是你的。
rows.current: 只要替我做事，这些就是你的。

rows.english: Then you can be twice as loyal to me as you were to Shinja.
rows.rawText: 那么，你得对我比对信蛇更加忠心。
rows.current: 那么，你得对我比对信蛇更加忠心。

rows.english: You may as well talk.  If I don't kill you, Shinja will.
rows.rawText: 你最好开口。我不杀你，信蛇也会杀你。
rows.current: 你最好开口。我不杀你，信蛇也会杀你。

rows.english: Does Shinja pay you enough to die for him?
rows.rawText: 信蛇给你的好处，值得你替他送命吗？
rows.current: 信蛇给你的好处，值得你替他送命吗？

rows.english: No, Arah - I won't have you following me again.
rows.rawText: 不，阿拉，我不会再让你跟着我。
rows.current: 不，阿拉，我不会再让你跟着我。

rows.english: I thought I'd shaken you for good.
rows.rawText: 我还以为终于甩掉你了。
rows.current: 我还以为终于甩掉你了。

rows.english: Who owns the house on the hill?
He calls himself a Lord now?
But money...ah, money is what truly makes a man.
rows.rawText: 可金子……啊，有了金子才算个人物。
rows.current: 可金子……啊，有了金子才算个人物。

rows.rawText: 说不定，还能买来几个人的忠心。
rows.current: 说不定，还能买来几个人的忠心。

rows.english: Men who might refuse to fight for Garrin if anything were to...happen.
rows.rawText: 要是 加林 出了什么事，他们或许就不肯再替他作战。
rows.current: 要是 加林 出了什么事，他们或许就不肯再替他作战。

rows.english: The Serpent walks where he likes.
rows.rawText: 灵蛇想去哪里就去哪里。
rows.current: 灵蛇想去哪里就去哪里。

rows.rawText: 这里曾是灵蛇族的土地。
rows.current: 这里曾是灵蛇族的土地。

rows.english: Or you could fight for me instead.
rows.rawText: 或者你也可以替我作战。
rows.current: 或者你也可以替我作战。

rows.english: When I sit on the Serpent's throne, the faithful will be well rewarded.
rows.rawText: 等我坐上灵蛇的王座，忠诚的人必得厚礼。
rows.current: 等我坐上灵蛇的王座，忠诚的人必得厚礼。

rows.rawText: 大友，今天就是你的死期！
rows.current: 大友，今天就是你的死期！

rows.english: I want to talk to you!
Good, because I have a task for you.
rows.rawText: 很好，因为我有事要你办。
rows.current: 很好，因为我有事要你办。

rows.english: Come - let's skin the rest of these scruffy wolves.
rows.rawText: 来，把剩下那群脏兮兮的狼也剥了皮。
rows.current: 来，把剩下那群脏兮兮的狼也剥了皮。

rows.english: Or have you forgotten the Serpent clan already?
rows.rawText: 还是说，你已经忘了灵蛇族？
rows.current: 还是说，你已经忘了灵蛇族？

rows.rawText: 你们这些僧人现在为我效力。
rows.current: 你们这些僧人现在为我效力。

rows.rawText: 你们的圣地现在在哪里？
rows.current: 你们的圣地现在在哪里？

rows.english: Your holy ground is where I walk and where I sleep.
rows.rawText: 我走过、睡过的地方，就是你们的圣地。
rows.current: 我走过、睡过的地方，就是你们的圣地。

rows.english: I am your holy ground, and you will hold me as dear as you did that pile of rubble over there.
rows.rawText: 我就是你们的圣地！从今往后，你们敬奉我，就得像敬奉那堆废墟一样！
rows.current: 我就是你们的圣地！从今往后，你们敬奉我，就得像敬奉那堆废墟一样！

rows.rawText: 那就把你的兄弟们召集起来。
rows.current: 那就把你的兄弟们召集起来。

rows.english: Get to the Orb at all costs!
rows.rawText: 不惜一切代价夺下宝珠！
rows.current: 不惜一切代价夺下宝珠！

rows.english: You fool - you don't know what you've done!
rows.rawText: 你这傻子，根本不知道自己做了什么！
rows.current: 你这傻子，根本不知道自己做了什么！

rows.english: I'm not afraid of the dark.
The sands of time flow at our whim.
Why do you still resist us?
You too will come to this in time...
I am Zymeth's second, and you'll do as I say!
rows.rawText: 我是 齐梅斯 的副手，你得听我的！
rows.current: 我是 齐梅斯 的副手，你得听我的！

rows.english: I won't, but I'm afraid I can't speak for my friends.
rows.rawText: 我不会，但我的朋友们可不一定。
rows.current: 我不会，但我的朋友们可不一定。

rows.english: Sweep this rabble aside and find the Orb!
rows.rawText: 扫清这群乌合之众，找到宝珠！
rows.current: 扫清这群乌合之众，找到宝珠！

rows.english: This is madness - the Lotus clan is worthless.
rows.rawText: 这太疯狂了，莲花族一无是处。
rows.current: 这太疯狂了，莲花族一无是处。

rows.english: It's clear you're destined to rule.
rows.rawText: 看来你注定要成为统治者。
rows.current: 看来你注定要成为统治者。

rows.english: Let me serve the Serpent clan!
The Wolf clan has retreated to their keep.

rows.rawText: 带领那支军队的是一位 奥贾 家族的人。
rows.current: 带领那支军队的是一位 奥贾 家族的人。

rows.english: The one they called the Dragon.
rows.rawText: 就是那个被称为“神龙”的人。
rows.current: 就是那个被称为“神龙”的人。

rows.english: The scroll!  I have the scroll!
Begone - your clan's time is over!
rows.rawText: 滚开，你们族的时代已经结束了！
rows.current: 滚开，你们族的时代已经结束了！

rows.english: No, no, a thousand times no!
I'll not sacrifice my little ones to Zymeth's mad schemes!
rows.rawText: 我绝不会为了 齐梅斯 的疯狂计划牺牲我的小宝贝们！
rows.current: 我绝不会为了 齐梅斯 的疯狂计划牺牲我的小宝贝们！

rows.english: I'm through with you and your wretched clan!
rows.rawText: 我跟你和你那可悲的族群一刀两断！
rows.current: 我跟你和你那可悲的族群一刀两断！

rows.english: It won't be so pretty once the Diseased Ones are through with it.
rows.rawText: 等恶疾者把这里糟蹋完，就没这么美了。
rows.current: 等恶疾者把这里糟蹋完，就没这么美了。

rows.english: It's only a matter of time before they serve us again.
rows.rawText: 他们重新效忠我们只是迟早的事。
rows.current: 他们重新效忠我们只是迟早的事。

rows.english: And what is this I hear of peasants marching under the Serpent banner?
rows.rawText: 还有，我怎么听说农民打着灵蛇族的旗号行军？
rows.current: 还有，我怎么听说农民打着灵蛇族的旗号行军？

rows.rawText: 我亲眼看见他们的尸体被烧掉了。
rows.current: 我亲眼看见他们的尸体被烧掉了。

rows.english: You didn't tell me you'd left one of Oja's sons alive.
rows.rawText: 你可没告诉我，你让 奥贾 的一个儿子活了下来。
rows.current: 你可没告诉我，你让 奥贾 的一个儿子活了下来。

rows.english: Some of my people don't care for you.
rows.rawText: 我的一些族人并不喜欢你。
rows.current: 我的一些族人并不喜欢你。

rows.english: Just the same, I like you.
You brought me the Serpent's Orb.
rows.rawText: 你把灵蛇族宝珠带给了我。
rows.current: 你把灵蛇族宝珠带给了我。

rows.english: Where's the young pup I once caught sulking behind the curtains in the Serpent's throne room?
rows.rawText: 当年那个躲在灵蛇族王座厅帷幕后生闷气的小家伙去哪儿了？
rows.current: 当年那个躲在灵蛇族王座厅帷幕后生闷气的小家伙去哪儿了？

rows.english: Perhaps we've both grown up, Kenji.
rows.rawText: 或许我们都长大了，健治。
rows.current: 或许我们都长大了，健治。

rows.english: If you want to live, the war ends here.
rows.rawText: 想活命的话，这场战争就到此为止。
rows.current: 想活命的话，这场战争就到此为止。

rows.english: I'm giving you a chance to walk away, boy.
rows.rawText: 小子，我给你一个离开的机会。
rows.current: 小子，我给你一个离开的机会。

rows.english: Your clan died with your father.
rows.rawText: 你的族群已随你父亲一同消亡。
rows.current: 你的族群已随你父亲一同消亡。

rows.rawText: 这里现在是莲花族的土地。
rows.current: 这里现在是莲花族的土地。

rows.english: The Lotus would die rather than bow to your kind again!
rows.rawText: 莲花族宁死也不会再向你们臣服！
rows.current: 莲花族宁死也不会再向你们臣服！

rows.english: I've waited seven years to serve you, Lord Oja.
rows.rawText: 奥贾 大人，我等了七年，只希望能为你效力。
rows.current: 奥贾 大人，我等了七年，只希望能为你效力。

rows.english: He doesn't speak for the village.
rows.rawText: 他的话不代表全村人的意思。
rows.current: 他的话不代表全村人的意思。

rows.english: The Serpent's Son will take tea in my house.
rows.rawText: 灵蛇之子，请到我家坐坐。
rows.current: 灵蛇之子，请到我家坐坐。

rows.english: He rules the provinces to the north, and would rule this one too if he could.
rows.rawText: 他统治着北方的行省；若有机会，也会统治这里。
rows.current: 他统治着北方的行省；若有机会，也会统治这里。

rows.english: He seeks to rebuild the clan, but his methods are...questionable.
rows.rawText: 他想重建氏族，但他的方法……令人质疑。
rows.current: 他想重建氏族，但他的方法……令人质疑。

rows.english: He's tasted power, and won't give it up easily.
rows.rawText: 他已经尝到权力的好处，不会轻易放手。
rows.current: 他已经尝到权力的好处，不会轻易放手。

rows.english: But Shinja only rules because no one else will stand against the other clans.
rows.rawText: 可信蛇能掌权，只因无人敢站出来对抗其他氏族。
rows.current: 可信蛇能掌权，只因无人敢站出来对抗其他氏族。

rows.english: Wolf and Lotus are tearing what's left of your father's empire apart.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族和莲花族正在瓜分你父亲残存的帝国。
rows.current: 恶狼族和莲花族正在瓜分你父亲残存的帝国。

rows.english: The people need a leader with Oja blood.
rows.rawText: 人民需要一位拥有 奥贾 家族血统的领袖。
rows.current: 人民需要一位拥有 奥贾 家族血统的领袖。

rows.english: Then you'll have to beat him.
Shinja rules two provinces from an old Serpent fort, here.
rows.rawText: 信蛇从这里的一座灵蛇族旧堡垒统治着两个行省。
rows.current: 信蛇从这里的一座灵蛇族旧堡垒统治着两个行省。

rows.english: His tax collectors take most of what this village has...
rows.rawText: 他派人收走了这个村子的大部分东西……
rows.current: 他派人收走了这个村子的大部分东西……

rows.english: ...while his hired archers haunt the eastern road, stealing what little remains.
rows.rawText: ……雇来的弓箭手又盘踞在东边道路，抢走仅剩的一点。
rows.current: ……雇来的弓箭手又盘踞在东边道路，抢走仅剩的一点。

rows.english: Break Shinja's forces and he'll lose his will to fight.
rows.rawText: 击溃信蛇的部队，他就会失去斗志。
rows.current: 击溃信蛇的部队，他就会失去斗志。

rows.english: We have no soldiers, but the villagers stand ready to serve.
rows.rawText: 我们没有士兵，但村民们愿意效力。
rows.current: 我们没有士兵，但村民们愿意效力。

rows.english: Lord Oja would never have given the Orb to geisha!
rows.rawText: 奥贾 大人绝不会把宝珠交给艺伎！
rows.current: 奥贾 大人绝不会把宝珠交给艺伎！

rows.english: Every death here today saved two.
rows.rawText: 今天这里每牺牲一人，就救下了两人。
rows.current: 今天这里每牺牲一人，就救下了两人。

rows.english: No one could ask for more.
rows.rawText: 他们已经尽力了，不能再苛求什么。
rows.current: 他们已经尽力了，不能再苛求什么。

rows.english: They fight because they fear the Serpent clan.
rows.rawText: 他们作战，是因为惧怕灵蛇族。
rows.current: 他们作战，是因为惧怕灵蛇族。

rows.english: There are worse men you could be.
I've never seen anyone move like that.
rows.rawText: 我还从没见过这么厉害的身手。
rows.current: 我还从没见过这么厉害的身手。

rows.english: Impossible!  The Lotus clan tore Serpentholm apart stone by stone searching for the Orb!
rows.rawText: 不可能！莲花族为了寻找宝珠，把 灵蛇城 一砖一石都拆了！
rows.current: 不可能！莲花族为了寻找宝珠，把 灵蛇城 一砖一石都拆了！

rows.english: If we abandon the villagers, they'll die.
rows.rawText: 如果抛下村民，他们会死。
rows.current: 如果抛下村民，他们会死。

rows.english: The Orb has been safe for seven years.
rows.rawText: 宝珠已经安然无恙地藏了七年。
rows.current: 宝珠已经安然无恙地藏了七年。

rows.english: Only the geisha know where it is.
rows.rawText: 只有艺伎知道它在哪里。
rows.current: 只有艺伎知道它在哪里。

rows.english: Bring them with us, and the Orb stays safe.
rows.rawText: 带上她们，宝珠就能继续安全地藏着。
rows.current: 带上她们，宝珠就能继续安全地藏着。

rows.english: If the Lotus soldiers are pillaging that far south, they've already got Serpentholm.
rows.rawText: 莲花族竟然一路劫掠到了南方？那看来灵蛇城 已经失守了。
rows.current: 莲花族竟然一路劫掠到了南方？那看来灵蛇城 已经失守了。

rows.english: The dragon is telling us to hurry.
A week ago these men were peasant farmers.
rows.rawText: 一周前，这些人还只是种田的农民。
rows.current: 一周前，这些人还只是种田的农民。

rows.english: You've made warriors out of them, but the Lotus and Wolf soldiers are veterans.
rows.rawText: 你把他们练成了战士，可莲花族和恶狼族的兵都是老手。
rows.current: 你把他们练成了战士，可莲花族和恶狼族的兵都是老手。

rows.english: Better that than seven years spent stealing from the very peasants who trusted us to protect them!
rows.rawText: 总好过七年来一直劫掠那些指望我们保护的农民！
rows.current: 总好过七年来一直劫掠那些指望我们保护的农民！

rows.english: Why does he want the Orb?
Why did I never see that before?
He'll come to his senses, Lord.
The Lotus wizards are the real enemy.
rows.rawText: 莲花族的术士才是真正的敌人。
rows.current: 莲花族的术士才是真正的敌人。

rows.english: We must not let their army escape back to the high plateau.
rows.rawText: 不能让他们的军队逃回高原。
rows.current: 不能让他们的军队逃回高原。

rows.english: Strike them while their backs are to the sea, and we'll finish them once and for all.
rows.rawText: 趁他们背靠大海时进攻，一举解决他们。
rows.current: 趁他们背靠大海时进攻，一举解决他们。

rows.english: If you have something to say...
Kenji will kill you for this.
Even after your father's death, the geisha were thought untouchable...
rows.rawText: 即使在你父亲死后，艺伎仍被视为不可侵犯……
rows.current: 即使在你父亲死后，艺伎仍被视为不可侵犯……

rows.english: The Orb may still be safe.
Don't listen to him, lord - this way is the safest.
rows.rawText: 大人，别听他的。这条路最安全。
rows.current: 大人，别听他的。这条路最安全。

rows.english: Even though the Lotus have built an outpost there, the dense woods should mask our passage.
rows.rawText: 虽然莲花族在那里建了前哨，但密林能掩护我们通过。
rows.current: 虽然莲花族在那里建了前哨，但密林能掩护我们通过。

rows.english: We've driven these people from their homes.
rows.rawText: 我们把这些人赶出了家园。
rows.current: 我们把这些人赶出了家园。

rows.rawText: 你说话越来越像你父亲了。
rows.current: 你说话越来越像你父亲了。

rows.rawText: 灵蛇城 已成一片荒地。
rows.current: 灵蛇城 已成一片荒地。

rows.english: The Lotus wizards tore it down when the Serpent died.
rows.rawText: 巨蛇死时，莲花族术士拆毁了那里。
rows.current: 巨蛇死时，莲花族术士拆毁了那里。

rows.english: Our enemies thought it was here.
rows.rawText: 我们的敌人以为它在这里。
rows.current: 我们的敌人以为它在这里。

rows.english: We could push on to Serpentholm.
rows.rawText: 我们可以继续前往 灵蛇城。
rows.current: 我们可以继续前往 灵蛇城。

rows.english: But lord...they are many and we are few.
rows.rawText: 可是大人……他们人多，我们人少。
rows.current: 可是大人……他们人多，我们人少。

rows.english: He's turned on his own people!
rows.rawText: 他反过来攻击自己人了！
rows.current: 他反过来攻击自己人了！

rows.english: How many more can you kill before the clan is destroyed?
rows.rawText: 氏族毁灭之前，你还要杀多少人？
rows.current: 氏族毁灭之前，你还要杀多少人？

rows.english: Please...let me help you start a village.
rows.rawText: 请……让我帮你建起一个村子。
rows.current: 请……让我帮你建起一个村子。

rows.english: This is Sperri, one of the peasants you saved in the last province.
rows.rawText: 这是 Sperri，你在上一个行省救下的农民之一。
rows.current: 这是 Sperri，你在上一个行省救下的农民之一。

rows.english: What you now see at the bottom of the screen are the available buildings.
rows.rawText: 屏幕下方显示的是可建造的建筑。
rows.current: 屏幕下方显示的是可建造的建筑。

rows.english: You can only build a peasant hut right now.
Left-click on the peasant hut icon, then place the hut by right-clicking somewhere on the ground.
rows.rawText: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。
rows.current: 左键点击农舍图标，再在地面上选一处位置点击右键，建造农舍。

rows.english: If you decide you don't want to build the hut right now, left-click to cancel or to select something else.
rows.rawText: 若暂时不想建农舍，左键点击即可取消，也可选中别的东西。
rows.current: 若暂时不想建农舍，左键点击即可取消，也可选中别的东西。

rows.english: You can only build on relatively flat terrain, so plan carefully.
rows.rawText: 只能在较平的地面上建造，所以要好好规划。
rows.current: 只能在较平的地面上建造，所以要好好规划。

rows.english: Remember, left-click is always cancel or select, and right-click always performs actions.
rows.rawText: 记住，左键用于取消或选中，右键用于执行动作。
rows.current: 记住，左键用于取消或选中，右键用于执行动作。

rows.english: Look!  A new peasant has emerged from the hut we built.
rows.rawText: 看！我们建的农舍里走出了一名新农民。
rows.current: 看！我们建的农舍里走出了一名新农民。

rows.rawText: 现在你的人民需要食物。
rows.current: 现在你的人民需要食物。

rows.english: Let's harvest some rice from that rice field over there.
rows.rawText: 让我们从那边的稻田收些稻米。
rows.current: 让我们从那边的稻田收些稻米。

rows.english: Rice is the currency of this land and is used in all construction and training efforts.
rows.rawText: 稻米在这里可作交换，也用于一切建造和训练。
rows.current: 稻米在这里可作交换，也用于一切建造和训练。

rows.english: Left-click one of the peasants, scroll to the rice field and right-click the rice field.
rows.rawText: 左键选中一名农民，把画面移到稻田，再右键点击稻田。
rows.current: 左键选中一名农民，把画面移到稻田，再右键点击稻田。

rows.english: Rice is important indeed, but you’ll also need water.
rows.rawText: 稻米固然重要，但你还需要水。
rows.current: 稻米固然重要，但你还需要水。

rows.english: A pond or stream like that one would do nicely.
rows.rawText: 那边的水池或河流就很好。
rows.current: 那边的水池或河流就很好。

rows.english: Select a peasant, then scroll to the pond and right-click it.
rows.rawText: 选中一名农民，把画面移到水池，再右键点击。
rows.current: 选中一名农民，把画面移到水池，再右键点击。

rows.english: Excellent!  We're almost ready to start building our army!
rows.rawText: 很好！我们就快能组建军队了！
rows.current: 很好！我们就快能组建军队了！

rows.english: To train warriors, we'll need a Dojo.
rows.rawText: 要训练战士，我们需要一座道场。
rows.current: 要训练战士，我们需要一座道场。

rows.english: Notice the Dojo is now available in the build menu.
rows.rawText: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。
rows.current: 看，建造菜单中已经可以选择道场了。

rows.english: Find a good spot and build the Dojo just like you built the peasant hut.
rows.rawText: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。
rows.current: 找个合适的位置，像建农舍那样建起道场。

rows.english: Now to train your first Spearman.
rows.rawText: 现在来训练你的第一名长矛兵。
rows.current: 现在来训练你的第一名长矛兵。

rows.english: Select a peasant and right-click the Dojo.
rows.rawText: 选中一名农民，右键点击道场。
rows.current: 选中一名农民，右键点击道场。

rows.english: Training Spearmen will cost you rice and water, so make sure some peasants keep harvesting.
rows.rawText: 训练长矛兵要消耗稻米和水，记得让一些农民继续采集。
rows.current: 训练长矛兵要消耗稻米和水，记得让一些农民继续采集。

rows.english: Well done - we're on our way!
rows.rawText: 干得好，我们已经迈出第一步了！
rows.current: 干得好，我们已经迈出第一步了！

rows.english: The bandits must have driven these people out.
rows.rawText: 匪徒一定赶走了这些人。
rows.current: 匪徒一定赶走了这些人。

rows.english: But look - there's a peasant hut still standing!
We should rebuild this village and make it our own.
rows.rawText: 我们应该重建这个村子，让它成为我们的家。
rows.current: 我们应该重建这个村子，让它成为我们的家。

rows.english: My uncle lived in this village.
rows.rawText: 我有亲人住在这个村子。
rows.current: 我有亲人住在这个村子。

rows.english: His tax collectors take everything that's not nailed down, and...
rows.rawText: 他派来征收的人把能拿走的都拿走了，而且……
rows.current: 他派来征收的人把能拿走的都拿走了，而且……

rows.english: Since your father's death, the clan has fallen apart.
rows.rawText: 你父亲死后，氏族就分崩离析了。
rows.current: 你父亲死后，氏族就分崩离析了。

rows.english: Only to save the peasants from...
Shinja's bandits drove these people out.
rows.rawText: 信蛇的匪徒赶走了这些人。
rows.current: 信蛇的匪徒赶走了这些人。

rows.english: But look - there's still one peasant hut intact!
rows.rawText: 但你看，还有一间农舍完好无损！
rows.current: 但你看，还有一间农舍完好无损！

rows.english: With your permission, I will claim it for the clan.
rows.rawText: 如果你允许，我会替族人接管它。
rows.current: 如果你允许，我会替族人接管它。

rows.english: A new peasant has just emerged from the peasant hut.
rows.rawText: 一名新农民从农舍里出来了。
rows.current: 一名新农民从农舍里出来了。

rows.english: Now you see the buildings the peasant can construct for you.
rows.rawText: 现在可以看到农民能为你建造的建筑。
rows.current: 现在可以看到农民能为你建造的建筑。

rows.english: At the moment, you can only build another peasant hut or a target range.
rows.rawText: 目前你只能再建一间农舍，或建一座靶场。
rows.current: 目前你只能再建一间农舍，或建一座靶场。

rows.english: Left-click the target range icon, then right-click on the ground to place the new building.
rows.rawText: 左键点击靶场图标，再右键点击地面放置新建筑。
rows.current: 左键点击靶场图标，再右键点击地面放置新建筑。

rows.english: You'll need additional rice and water to construct more buildings and train an army.
rows.rawText: 要建更多建筑、训练军队，还需要更多稻米和水。
rows.current: 要建更多建筑、训练军队，还需要更多稻米和水。

rows.english: Select one peasant, then right-click on that rice field west of the village to begin harvesting rice.
rows.rawText: 选中一名农民，再右键点击村西的稻田，让他开始收割。
rows.current: 选中一名农民，再右键点击村西的稻田，让他开始收割。

rows.english: There's also a stream to the north where we can obtain fresh water.
rows.rawText: 北边还有一条小河，可以取到清水。
rows.current: 北边还有一条小河，可以取到清水。

rows.english: Send a peasant there as well.
Now that we have a stockpile of rice and water, we should begin training some archers.
rows.rawText: 现在稻米和水都有了，该开始训练弓箭手了。
rows.current: 现在稻米和水都有了，该开始训练弓箭手了。

rows.english: Select a peasant, then right-click the target range.
rows.rawText: 选中农民，再右键点击靶场。
rows.current: 选中农民，再右键点击靶场。

rows.english: The high road is easier travelling, but we're sure to be spotted.
rows.rawText: 大路好走，但难以藏匿踪迹。
rows.current: 大路好走，但难以藏匿踪迹。

rows.english: The forest would mask our movements until we're ready to attack.
rows.rawText: 穿过树林就能掩护我们的行动，直到准备进攻。
rows.current: 穿过树林就能掩护我们的行动，直到准备进攻。

rows.english: I'll give the Wolf miners this much - they know how to run.
rows.rawText: 那帮恶狼族矿工，逃起命来倒真有一套。
rows.current: 那帮恶狼族矿工，逃起命来倒真有一套。

rows.english: Mm.  We have Father to thank for that.
They serve the Lotus, and the Lotus serve us.
rows.rawText: 他们为莲花族效力，莲花族为我们效力。
rows.current: 他们为莲花族效力，莲花族为我们效力。

rows.english: The Oja are the only family fit to serve as lords of this land.
rows.rawText: 只有 奥贾 家族有资格做这片土地的领主。
rows.current: 只有 奥贾 家族有资格做这片土地的领主。

rows.english: The Serpent clan will rule long after father's gone.
rows.rawText: 父亲走后很久，灵蛇族仍会统治。
rows.current: 父亲走后很久，灵蛇族仍会统治。

rows.english: Of course - I'm the first-born son!
Besides, you spend every free moment carousing with commoners in back-alley wine shops.
rows.rawText: 何况你一有空就在后巷酒馆和下等人寻欢。
rows.current: 何况你一有空就在后巷酒馆和下等人寻欢。

rows.rawText: 你根本没有打仗的胆量。
rows.current: 你根本没有打仗的胆量。

rows.english: Yes, always winning is such a burden.
rows.rawText: 是啊，总赢可真是沉重的负担。
rows.current: 是啊，总赢可真是沉重的负担。

rows.english: I bought this plantation from the Wolf clan!
rows.rawText: 这座农庄是我从恶狼族手里买来的！
rows.current: 这座农庄是我从恶狼族手里买来的！

rows.english: I bought this plantation from the Wolf clan.
rows.rawText: 这座农庄是我从恶狼族手里买来的。
rows.current: 这座农庄是我从恶狼族手里买来的。

rows.english: I'd like to...sample...one of your geisha.
rows.rawText: 我想……尝尝……你的一位艺伎。
rows.current: 我想……尝尝……你的一位艺伎。

rows.english: Ah...get inside, my pretty, get inside.
I was sure Kenji would come looking for his clan's precious dragon.
rows.rawText: 我就知道健治会来寻找他族里那条珍贵的龙。
rows.current: 我就知道健治会来寻找他族里那条珍贵的龙。

rows.english: Don't preach to me, snake man.
Did you enjoy the geisha's screams when you ran her through?
rows.rawText: 你刺穿那名艺伎时，喜欢听她的惨叫吗？
rows.current: 你刺穿那名艺伎时，喜欢听她的惨叫吗？

rows.english: Already the Wolf have the Orb.

rows.rawText: 这么说，他回 灵蛇城 了。
rows.current: 这么说，他回 灵蛇城 了。

rows.english: Where Kenji goes, fresh corpses litter the ground.
rows.rawText: 健治所到之处，总有新添的尸体。
rows.current: 健治所到之处，总有新添的尸体。

rows.rawText: 又有朋友可以陪我玩了……
rows.current: 又有朋友可以陪我玩了……

rows.english: Kill your share of peasants and I'll find you a place in Shinja's band.
rows.rawText: 你也杀几个农民，我就让你加入信蛇的队伍。
rows.current: 你也杀几个农民，我就让你加入信蛇的队伍。

rows.english: But you carry the dark blade.
If you say the word, we're yours.
rows.rawText: 只要你一声令下，我们就是你的人。
rows.current: 只要你一声令下，我们就是你的人。

rows.english: He squanders my men against Otomo's peasant rebels.
rows.rawText: 他把我的人浪费在对付大友的农民叛军上。
rows.current: 他把我的人浪费在对付大友的农民叛军上。

rows.english: The clan has fallen far since the Serpent's time.
rows.rawText: 灵蛇在世时，族人可没落到这种地步。
rows.current: 灵蛇在世时，族人可没落到这种地步。

rows.english: They need a firm hand to guide them.
rows.rawText: 他们需要强硬的人带领。
rows.current: 他们需要强硬的人带领。

rows.english: Please, lord...let me show you how easy it would be to take it back.
rows.rawText: 大人，请让我出手。您就知道夺回来有多容易了。
rows.current: 大人，请让我出手。您就知道夺回来有多容易了。

rows.english: Shinja has ruled these three provinces since your father's death.
rows.rawText: 你父亲死后，信蛇一直统治着这三个行省。
rows.current: 你父亲死后，信蛇一直统治着这三个行省。

rows.english: With his army of horsemen, he controls Hilltop Village.
rows.rawText: 信蛇手下有一支骑兵，控制着 Hilltop Village。
rows.current: 信蛇手下有一支骑兵，控制着 Hilltop Village。

rows.english: Otomo and his band of hired archers have set up camp here.
rows.rawText: 大友和他雇来的弓箭手在这里扎营。
rows.current: 大友和他雇来的弓箭手在这里扎营。

rows.english: He cowers deep in the forest, afraid to attack.
rows.rawText: 他躲在密林深处，不敢进攻。
rows.current: 他躲在密林深处，不敢进攻。

rows.english: Strike now, and let the people know the Serpent has returned!
rows.rawText: 现在出手，让大家知道灵蛇回来了！
rows.current: 现在出手，让大家知道灵蛇回来了！

rows.english: D-Don’t kill me...He’s t-to the southeast!
rows.rawText: 别、别杀我……他、他在东南边！
rows.current: 别、别杀我……他、他在东南边！

rows.english: Even now, he comes for you...
rows.rawText: 他现在就在来找您的路上……
rows.current: 他现在就在来找您的路上……

rows.english: The Wolf...he has joined with the Wolf...
rows.rawText: 恶狼族……他跟恶狼族联手了……
rows.current: 恶狼族……他跟恶狼族联手了……

rows.english: Looks like the bandits Lord Shinja hired.
rows.rawText: 看着像信蛇大人雇来的匪徒。
rows.current: 看着像信蛇大人雇来的匪徒。

rows.english: Let 'em be - they're a harmless lot.
rows.rawText: 别管他们，他们没什么威胁。
rows.current: 别管他们，他们没什么威胁。

rows.english: I’ll talk!  He's to the south!
I'm gonna tell you how to start building your empire.
rows.rawText: 我来告诉你怎么着手建立自己的帝国。
rows.current: 我来告诉你怎么着手建立自己的帝国。

rows.english: This is Sperri, one of those puny peasants we snagged on the way here.
rows.rawText: 这是 Sperri，我们在路上抓来的一个弱小农民。
rows.current: 这是 Sperri，我们在路上抓来的一个弱小农民。

rows.english: The icons at the bottom of the screen show you what you can build.
rows.rawText: 画面底部的图标显示你能建造的东西。
rows.current: 画面底部的图标显示你能建造的东西。

rows.english: You can only build a peasant hut right now - the others can't be built yet.
rows.rawText: 现在你只能建农舍，其他建筑还不能建造。
rows.current: 现在你只能建农舍，其他建筑还不能建造。

rows.english: Also, keep in mind that you can only build on flat terrain.
rows.rawText: 还要记住，只有平坦的地形才能建造。
rows.current: 还要记住，只有平坦的地形才能建造。

rows.english: Select the peasant hut, then right-click where you want the peasant to build it.
rows.rawText: 选中农舍，再在想让农民建造的地点点击右键。
rows.current: 选中农舍，再在想让农民建造的地点点击右键。

rows.english: Remember, left click selects, and right click performs actions.
rows.rawText: 记住，左键选取，右键执行操作。
rows.current: 记住，左键选取，右键执行操作。

rows.english: Let's have this one get us some food.
rows.rawText: 让这个农民去给我们弄些粮食。
rows.current: 让这个农民去给我们弄些粮食。

rows.english: Rice is the currency of the land.
rows.rawText: 稻米是这片土地上的通货。
rows.current: 稻米是这片土地上的通货。

rows.english: You spend it whenever you build something or train someone.
rows.rawText: 建造建筑或训练单位都要消耗稻米。
rows.current: 建造建筑或训练单位都要消耗稻米。

rows.english: Select the peasant, move the view to the rice field, and right-click the field.
rows.rawText: 选中农民，把画面移到稻田，再右键点击稻田。
rows.current: 选中农民，把画面移到稻田，再右键点击稻田。

rows.english: This will put him to work.
Rice is good, but we're going to need water too!
rows.rawText: 稻米有了，可我们还需要水！
rows.current: 稻米有了，可我们还需要水！

rows.english: Go back to the peasant, select him, then right-click the pond.
rows.rawText: 回到农民那里，选中他，再右键点击池塘。
rows.current: 回到农民那里，选中他，再右键点击池塘。

rows.english: Excellent - this land will be yours in no time!
rows.rawText: 很好，这片土地很快就是你的了！
rows.current: 很好，这片土地很快就是你的了！

rows.english: I could really use a drink...and we're gonna need some more soldiers, too.
rows.rawText: 我真想喝一杯……而且我们还需要更多士兵。
rows.current: 我真想喝一杯……而且我们还需要更多士兵。

rows.english: Looks like we need a tavern.
You can build a tavern now.
Select the tavern, then place it.
rows.rawText: 选择酒馆，然后把它放到地图上。
rows.current: 选择酒馆，然后把它放到地图上。

rows.english: Select a peasant and right-click on the tavern - this will send him inside to train.
rows.rawText: 选中一名农民，右键点击酒馆，就能让他进去训练。
rows.current: 选中一名农民，右键点击酒馆，就能让他进去训练。

rows.english: Remember that training costs rice and water.
rows.rawText: 记住，训练要消耗稻米和水。
rows.current: 记住，训练要消耗稻米和水。

rows.english: He's not here, and we've left his service.
rows.rawText: 他不在这里，我们也不再替他效力了。
rows.current: 他不在这里，我们也不再替他效力了。

rows.english: His keep has fallen and he's on the run.
rows.rawText: 他的要塞失守了，他正在逃命。
rows.current: 他的要塞失守了，他正在逃命。

rows.english: Besides, he hasn't paid us in a week.
rows.rawText: 再说，他已经一周没付我们钱了。
rows.current: 再说，他已经一周没付我们钱了。

rows.english: This is twice what he was paying us!
rows.rawText: 这比他付的酬劳多一倍！
rows.current: 这比他付的酬劳多一倍！

rows.english: Look - he still carries the black knife!
His men watch us all the time from the dojo and watchtower.
rows.rawText: 他的人一直从道场和哨塔监视我们。
rows.current: 他的人一直从道场和哨塔监视我们。

rows.english: We are loyal to the Serpent!
Otomo drove us from our homes!
rows.rawText: 大友把我们赶出了家园！
rows.current: 大友把我们赶出了家园！

rows.english: The Butcher is more deserving of my talents than you'll ever be!
rows.rawText: 屠夫比你们更配得上我的本事！
rows.current: 屠夫比你们更配得上我的本事！

rows.rawText: 我唾弃你们这可悲的氏族！
rows.current: 我唾弃你们这可悲的氏族！

rows.english: What have you done to Lord Garrin's town?
rows.rawText: 你把 加林 大人的城镇怎么了？
rows.current: 你把 加林 大人的城镇怎么了？

rows.english: You're in over your head, stranger.
rows.rawText: 外乡人，你惹上大麻烦了。
rows.current: 外乡人，你惹上大麻烦了。

rows.english: I'll see you dead for this.
Joyous day!  The Serpent has returned!
rows.rawText: 大喜的日子！灵蛇族回来了！
rows.current: 大喜的日子！灵蛇族回来了！

rows.rawText: 我是 维特金，加林 的辅佐官。
rows.current: 我是 维特金，加林 的辅佐官。

rows.english: Master Garrin rides from the hill as we speak, and will be upon us shortly.
rows.rawText: 我们说话的时候，加林 大人正从山上骑马赶来，很快就到。
rows.current: 我们说话的时候，加林 大人正从山上骑马赶来，很快就到。

rows.english: Protect me, and I'll lend my sword to your cause.
rows.rawText: 保护我，我就为你的事业效力。
rows.current: 保护我，我就为你的事业效力。

rows.rawText: 老糊涂，现在谁才是主人？
rows.current: 老糊涂，现在谁才是主人？

rows.english: Once I knew a scared boy who ran from his accusers.
rows.rawText: 我曾认识一个受人质问就吓得逃跑的男孩。
rows.current: 我曾认识一个受人质问就吓得逃跑的男孩。

rows.english: I had to know if he was still that boy.
rows.rawText: 我得知道他是否还是当年的那个男孩。
rows.current: 我得知道他是否还是当年的那个男孩。

rows.english: Are you back to rule the Serpent clan?
Going to break the world, then?
rows.rawText: 那么，你要毁掉这个世界吗？
rows.current: 那么，你要毁掉这个世界吗？

rows.english: The old man was more perceptive than we thought.
rows.rawText: 那老头比我们想的更有远见。
rows.current: 那老头比我们想的更有远见。

rows.rawText: 他知道 灵蛇城 会陷落。
rows.current: 他知道 灵蛇城 会陷落。

rows.english: The geisha are still considered untouchable.
rows.rawText: 艺伎仍被视为不可侵犯。
rows.current: 艺伎仍被视为不可侵犯。

rows.english: Seven years in the grave have weakened your father's grip, but the Wolf and Lotus still fear his name.
rows.rawText: 你父亲死了七年，他的威势已衰，但恶狼族和莲花族仍怕他的名字。
rows.current: 你父亲死了七年，他的威势已衰，但恶狼族和莲花族仍怕他的名字。

rows.english: As I served the father, so I'll serve the son.
rows.rawText: 我怎样服侍父亲，就怎样服侍儿子。
rows.current: 我怎样服侍父亲，就怎样服侍儿子。

rows.english: The Swan's Pool is here, along the northern road.
rows.rawText: 天鹅池就在这里，走北边的路。
rows.current: 天鹅池就在这里，走北边的路。

rows.english: The Wolf clan has moved in here, driving the original farmers out.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族已经来到这里，赶走了原本的农民。
rows.current: 恶狼族已经来到这里，赶走了原本的农民。

rows.english: The stench of their shanties wafts south when the weather's clear.
rows.rawText: 天气好时，他们破屋的臭味会传到南边。
rows.current: 天气好时，他们破屋的臭味会传到南边。

rows.english: As in your father's time, the Wolf barbarians are woefully unprepared to face a battle-ready foe.
rows.rawText: 和你父亲在世时一样，恶狼族根本挡不住有备而来的军队。
rows.current: 和你父亲在世时一样，恶狼族根本挡不住有备而来的军队。

rows.english: Still, the Wolf are always spoiling for a fight.
rows.rawText: 不过，恶狼族总想找人打一架。
rows.current: 不过，恶狼族总想找人打一架。
