rows.english: The Lotus clan's lands are far to the east, but they have built an outpost here.
rows.rawText: 莲花族的领地远在东边，却在这里建了前哨。
rows.current: 莲花族的领地远在东边，却在这里建了前哨。

rows.english: One of their vile wizards has enslaved the local peasants with his dark magics.
rows.rawText: 他们一名邪恶术士用黑暗法术奴役了当地农民。
rows.current: 他们一名邪恶术士用黑暗法术奴役了当地农民。

rows.english: The villagers know the land well, and would be valuable allies.
rows.rawText: 村民熟悉土地，会是有用的盟友。
rows.current: 村民熟悉土地，会是有用的盟友。

rows.english: The most direct route leads through the center of Riverside Town.
rows.rawText: 最近的路 穿过 河畔镇 中心。
rows.current: 最近的路 穿过 河畔镇 中心。

rows.english: The locals survive by trading with both Lotus and Wolf, so we're sure to be noticed.
rows.rawText: 本地人靠与莲花族、恶狼族交易过活，我们肯定会被发现。
rows.current: 本地人靠与莲花族、恶狼族交易过活，我们肯定会被发现。

rows.english: Hah!   All of us fighting together - it's just like old times, eh?
rows.rawText: 哈！大家又并肩作战，真像从前，不是吗？
rows.current: 哈！大家又并肩作战，真像从前，不是吗？

rows.english: Our scouts report the Wolf clan squatters have abandoned their shanties and fled rather than face you.
rows.rawText: 探子报告，恶狼族那些占地者弃屋逃跑，不敢面对你。
rows.current: 探子报告，恶狼族那些占地者弃屋逃跑，不敢面对你。

rows.english: Our scouts report that the traders have abandoned Riverside rather than face you.
rows.rawText: 探子报告，商人也从 河畔镇 逃走，不敢面对你。
rows.current: 探子报告，商人也从 河畔镇 逃走，不敢面对你。

rows.english: I've taken the liberty of sending some men to occupy the town.
rows.rawText: 我已经自作主张，派人占了镇子。
rows.current: 我已经自作主张，派人占了镇子。

rows.english: Our scouts report that the Lotus clan have abandoned their outpost rather than face you.
rows.rawText: 探子报告，莲花族也弃掉前哨，不敢面对你。
rows.current: 探子报告，莲花族也弃掉前哨，不敢面对你。

rows.english: The Wolf squatters to the west are staying put, but a little steel and fire should put an end to...
rows.rawText: 西边的恶狼族占地者还没走，但一点刀剑与火焰就能让他们……
rows.current: 西边的恶狼族占地者还没走，但一点刀剑与火焰就能让他们……

rows.english: The Lotus wizards to the east haven't moved yet, but if we put that tower of theirs to the torch....
rows.rawText: 东边的莲花族术士还没动，但若烧了他们的塔……
rows.current: 东边的莲花族术士还没动，但若烧了他们的塔……

rows.english: But we have them by the throat.
rows.rawText: 可我们已拿住他们的要害。
rows.current: 可我们已拿住他们的要害。

rows.english: Curse him!  With the army he's mustered, we could secure the lowlands and rebuild the Serpent clan!
rows.rawText: 该死！有他集结的那支大军，我们本可守住低地，重建灵蛇族！
rows.current: 该死！有他集结的那支大军，我们本可守住低地，重建灵蛇族！

rows.english: What does he want with the Orb, anyway?
I used to stare at that thing for hours, searching for some spark of power.
rows.rawText: 以前我常对着那东西看上数个小时，想找出一点力量的迹象。
rows.current: 以前我常对着那东西看上数个小时，想找出一点力量的迹象。

rows.rawText: 它不过是块好看的石头。
rows.current: 它不过是块好看的石头。

rows.english: The Wolf clan is amassing their army to the southwest!
rows.rawText: 恶狼族正在西南方集结大军！
rows.current: 恶狼族正在西南方集结大军！

rows.english: We must attack, or they'll sweep through the lowlands!
rows.rawText: 我们必须进攻，否则他们会一路打过低地！
rows.current: 我们必须进攻，否则他们会一路打过低地！

rows.english: The Lotus clan are slaughtering the villagers to the east!
rows.rawText: 莲花族正在东边屠杀村民！
rows.current: 莲花族正在东边屠杀村民！

rows.english: A large army of bladesmen is camped on the hillside below the warlock's tower.
rows.rawText: 一支刀兵大军驻在术士塔下的山坡上。
rows.current: 一支刀兵大军驻在术士塔下的山坡上。

rows.english: We must attack before they move south!
rows.rawText: 必须在他们南下前进攻！
rows.current: 必须在他们南下前进攻！

rows.english: If the enemy can't hurt you, they'll hurt your people.
rows.rawText: 敌人伤不了你，就会去伤你的人民。
rows.current: 敌人伤不了你，就会去伤你的人民。

rows.english: The peasants fought for you, not the Orb!
rows.rawText: 农民为你而战，不是为了宝珠！
rows.current: 农民为你而战，不是为了宝珠！

rows.english: About time they decided to stand and fight.
rows.rawText: 他们总算决定留下战斗了。
rows.current: 他们总算决定留下战斗了。

rows.english: Cower for another seven years in a falling-down hut, sipping tea and waiting to die?
rows.rawText: 再躲在破屋里七年，天天闲坐等死吗？
rows.current: 再躲在破屋里七年，天天闲坐等死吗？

rows.english: Wretch!  I'll gut you like a fish...
It isn't human.  You saw how it moved.
rows.rawText: 那不是人。你看见它怎么动的了。
rows.current: 那不是人。你看见它怎么动的了。

rows.rawText: 那不过是块没用的石头！
rows.current: 那不过是块没用的石头！

rows.english: We've taken Serpentholm - doesn't that matter?
rows.rawText: 我们已经夺下 灵蛇城，这还不够吗？
rows.current: 我们已经夺下 灵蛇城，这还不够吗？

rows.english: We've no time for these fantasies about magic and dragons!
rows.rawText: 没时间再幻想什么魔法和龙了！
rows.current: 没时间再幻想什么魔法和龙了！

rows.english: You must restore the Serpent clan!
rows.rawText: 你必须让灵蛇族再次强大！
rows.current: 你必须让灵蛇族再次强大！

rows.english: We have to move quickly, while the other clans are weak.
rows.rawText: 趁其他族还弱，我们必须快点行动。
rows.current: 趁其他族还弱，我们必须快点行动。

rows.english: Kenji's gone, and I have an empire to build.
rows.rawText: 健治已不在了，我得建立自己的帝国。
rows.current: 健治已不在了，我得建立自己的帝国。

rows.english: Serpentholm is safe for the moment.
We'll set the engineers to rebuilding the walls in case our enemies return.
rows.rawText: 得派人重修城防，以防敌人回来。
rows.current: 得派人重修城防，以防敌人回来。

rows.english: The Wolf clan's army has retreated to the hills.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族的军队退进了山里。
rows.current: 恶狼族的军队退进了山里。

rows.english: By now, they're preparing to make a stand at the mines.
rows.rawText: 这会儿他们应该正准备在矿区坚守。
rows.current: 这会儿他们应该正准备在矿区坚守。

rows.english: If we hurry, we might take them unprepared.
rows.rawText: 动作够快，也许能打他们一个措手不及。
rows.current: 动作够快，也许能打他们一个措手不及。

rows.english: Perhaps rather than attempting a frontal assault, we should press them on the flank.
rows.rawText: 与其正面强攻，不如从侧翼逼近。
rows.current: 与其正面强攻，不如从侧翼逼近。

rows.english: The valleys and swamps in this province could hide our army until we're ready to strike.
rows.rawText: 这一带的山谷和沼泽能掩护军队，直到我们发动进攻。
rows.current: 这一带的山谷和沼泽能掩护军队，直到我们发动进攻。

rows.english: Not too much pain for you, I hope.
Our enemies understand pain and sacrifice.
rows.rawText: 我们的敌人懂得痛苦，也懂得牺牲。
rows.current: 我们的敌人懂得痛苦，也懂得牺牲。

rows.english: They're doomed, of course, but at least they don't cower in their villages.
rows.rawText: 他们注定失败，但至少没有躲在村里不敢出来。
rows.current: 他们注定失败，但至少没有躲在村里不敢出来。

rows.english: I don't have anything to say.
The Serpent clan needs strong leaders, not weaklings.
rows.rawText: 灵蛇族需要强者领导，不能交给软弱的人。
rows.current: 灵蛇族需要强者领导，不能交给软弱的人。

rows.english: You take weaklings under your wing.
rows.rawText: 你竟然把软弱的人收在身边。
rows.current: 你竟然把软弱的人收在身边。

rows.english: As I served the father, so shall I serve the son.
rows.rawText: 我怎样侍奉父亲，就怎样侍奉儿子。
rows.current: 我怎样侍奉父亲，就怎样侍奉儿子。

rows.english: They're mercenary scum who serve the highest bidder.
rows.rawText: 那群唯利是图的家伙，谁出价高就为谁效力。
rows.current: 那群唯利是图的家伙，谁出价高就为谁效力。

rows.english: We'd be better off going west, crossing the river here.
rows.rawText: 最好往西走，从这里过河。
rows.current: 最好往西走，从这里过河。

rows.english: There's a Wolf clan shanty town on the other side, but a few well-trained soldiers could easily clear away that rabble.
rows.rawText: 对岸有个恶狼族的棚户区，派出训练有素的士兵就能轻易清掉那群人。
rows.current: 对岸有个恶狼族的棚户区，派出训练有素的士兵就能轻易清掉那群人。

rows.english: It's like old times - the Serpent clan fighting as one again.
rows.rawText: 仿佛回到了从前，灵蛇族又能并肩作战了。
rows.current: 仿佛回到了从前，灵蛇族又能并肩作战了。

rows.rawText: 河畔镇 送来了消息！
rows.current: 河畔镇 送来了消息！

rows.english: The Wolf clan is preparing to counterattack.
We must head them off, or they'll sweep through the lowlands!
rows.rawText: 必须挡住他们，不然他们会一路打到低地！
rows.current: 必须挡住他们，不然他们会一路打到低地！

rows.english: A large army of Lotus warriors is camped on the hillside below the warlock's tower.
rows.rawText: 一支莲花族大军驻扎在术士塔下的山坡上。
rows.current: 一支莲花族大军驻扎在术士塔下的山坡上。

rows.english: We must attack, or they'll raid the southern coast!
rows.rawText: 必须主动出击，否则他们会袭扰南部海岸！
rows.current: 必须主动出击，否则他们会袭扰南部海岸！

rows.english: Our enemies are on the run.

rows.rawText: 有什么东西带走了他们。
rows.current: 有什么东西带走了他们。

rows.english: We have no need of your death magics.
rows.rawText: 我们不需要你的死灵法术。
rows.current: 我们不需要你的死灵法术。

rows.english: What do you want with Kenji?
If you're right about the Orb, Kenji will need every soldier he can get - even the dead ones.
rows.rawText: 如果你关于宝珠的消息属实，健治就需要尽可能多的士兵，连死人也不例外。
rows.current: 如果你关于宝珠的消息属实，健治就需要尽可能多的士兵，连死人也不例外。

rows.english: Otomo was supposed to be here by now.
He left you here to die.
rows.rawText: 他把你们留在这里等死。
rows.current: 他把你们留在这里等死。

rows.rawText: 就让他们的尸体烂在那里。
rows.current: 就让他们的尸体烂在那里。

rows.english: Hanging over the gate, as ordered.
rows.rawText: 照命令，把它挂在大门上方。
rows.current: 照命令，把它挂在大门上方。

rows.english: As long as we keep killing.
Yet these provinces are still unclaimed.
rows.rawText: 可这些地方仍然无人占领。
rows.current: 可这些地方仍然无人占领。

rows.english: Still...the holy brothers would be good fodder for the front lines.
rows.rawText: 不过……那些圣兄弟倒很适合派去前线送死。
rows.current: 不过……那些圣兄弟倒很适合派去前线送死。

rows.english: If we allow them to remain free, they might side with the Wolf.
rows.rawText: 如果放任他们自由，他们可能会投靠恶狼族。
rows.current: 如果放任他们自由，他们可能会投靠恶狼族。

rows.english: Look - the avalanche dammed up the river.
We can cross there and get behind them.
rows.rawText: 可以从那里过河，绕到他们背后。
rows.current: 可以从那里过河，绕到他们背后。

rows.english: The bridges and fords are well-guarded.
rows.rawText: 河上的通道和浅水处都有重兵把守。
rows.current: 河上的通道和浅水处都有重兵把守。

rows.rawText: 他们干活真勤快，不是吗？
rows.current: 他们干活真勤快，不是吗？

rows.english: The Wolf miners burned the forest to clear trails for their carts.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族的矿工烧掉树林，给车子开出道路。
rows.current: 恶狼族的矿工烧掉树林，给车子开出道路。

rows.english: If you have a quarrel with me, send your leader.
rows.rawText: 如果你要找我算账，就派你的首领来。
rows.current: 如果你要找我算账，就派你的首领来。

rows.english: A prize for the man who takes Otomo's head!
rows.rawText: 谁取下大友的头，我就给他重金！
rows.current: 谁取下大友的头，我就给他重金！

rows.rawText: 你做得很好，灵蛇族之子。
rows.current: 你做得很好，灵蛇族之子。

rows.english: It rests with the Lotus clan.
Only the Lotus believe in its power.
rows.rawText: 只有莲花族还相信它有力量。
rows.current: 只有莲花族还相信它有力量。

rows.rawText: 他们的信念赋予了它生命。
rows.current: 他们的信念赋予了它生命。

rows.english: Tarrant used the Orb to focus what was already within him.
rows.rawText: 宝珠不过是将塔兰特 体内原有的力量汇聚起来。
rows.current: 宝珠不过是将塔兰特 体内原有的力量汇聚起来。

rows.english: Tarrant believed in its power, and his faith gave it life.
rows.rawText: 塔兰特 相信宝珠的力量，他的信念赋予了它生命。
rows.current: 塔兰特 相信宝珠的力量，他的信念赋予了它生命。

rows.english: You are the Serpent.  Become the Dragon.
Face evil and defeat it, as Tarrant did.
rows.rawText: 像 塔兰特 一样直面邪恶，战胜它。
rows.current: 像 塔兰特 一样直面邪恶，战胜它。

rows.english: Why does the son of the Serpent come to this place?
rows.rawText: 灵蛇族之子为何来到这里？
rows.current: 灵蛇族之子为何来到这里？

rows.english: From the day he was born, the darkness kept him from the light.
rows.rawText: 从他出生那天起，黑暗就让他远离光明。
rows.current: 从他出生那天起，黑暗就让他远离光明。

rows.rawText: 你和他不同吗，灵蛇族之子？
rows.current: 你和他不同吗，灵蛇族之子？

rows.english: So you know what you are not.
rows.rawText: 这么说，你知道自己不是什么。
rows.current: 这么说，你知道自己不是什么。

rows.english: What you want is not what you are.
rows.rawText: 你渴望成为的，未必是真正的自己。
rows.current: 你渴望成为的，未必是真正的自己。

rows.english: First show me what you can do alone.
rows.rawText: 先让我看看你独自一人能做到什么。
rows.current: 先让我看看你独自一人能做到什么。

rows.english: Meet me at the mountaintop, and I will answer your questions.
rows.rawText: 到山顶来见我，我会回答你的问题。
rows.current: 到山顶来见我，我会回答你的问题。

rows.english: You are not the Serpent's son.
You are bound by your fears.
The Lotus are at the bridges, and they've brought the ninja with them.
rows.rawText: 莲花族到了桥头，还带来了忍者。
rows.current: 莲花族到了桥头，还带来了忍者。

rows.english: They're eager to settle old scores.
We owe you our lives, Lord Dragon.
rows.rawText: 神龙大人，我们的命是你救的。
rows.current: 神龙大人，我们的命是你救的。

rows.english: We'll have to circle back down and go through the mountains to reach them.
rows.rawText: 我们得绕回山下，再穿过群山才能到他们那里。
rows.current: 我们得绕回山下，再穿过群山才能到他们那里。

rows.english: You must not shed blood on holy ground!
We remember your father, and his father before him.
rows.rawText: 我们记得你的父亲，也记得他的父亲。
rows.current: 我们记得你的父亲，也记得他的父亲。

rows.english: Your war doesn't matter to us.
You may destroy a building, but you cannot destroy our faith.
rows.rawText: 你可以摧毁建筑，却摧毁不了我们的信念。
rows.current: 你可以摧毁建筑，却摧毁不了我们的信念。

rows.english: We use the servant against the master.
He is one with the Dragon.
That is the Orb that traps you here.
rows.rawText: 正是这颗宝珠将你困在这里。
rows.current: 正是这颗宝珠将你困在这里。

rows.english: That is the Orb that breaks the world.
rows.rawText: 正是这颗宝珠会毁掉这个世界。
rows.current: 正是这颗宝珠会毁掉这个世界。

rows.english: That is the Orb that can get you home.
rows.rawText: 也只有这颗宝珠能让你回家。
rows.current: 也只有这颗宝珠能让你回家。

rows.english: We both fight the Serpent - that is all that matters.
rows.rawText: 我们都在对抗灵蛇族，这就够了。
rows.current: 我们都在对抗灵蛇族，这就够了。

rows.english: Refuse again, and it goes to the Lotus.
rows.rawText: 再拒绝，它就归莲花族了。
rows.current: 再拒绝，它就归莲花族了。

rows.english: I don't have time to talk.
We need every man to protect the Soul Flame.
rows.rawText: 我们需要所有人来保护魂焰。
rows.current: 我们需要所有人来保护魂焰。

rows.english: If the Wolf extinguish the Flame, we will be bound to them.
rows.rawText: 如果恶狼族熄灭火焰，我们就会受他们驱使。
rows.current: 如果恶狼族熄灭火焰，我们就会受他们驱使。

rows.english: Follow me, then, but be careful.
There are some ninja who already serve the Wolf.
rows.rawText: 有些忍者已经在为恶狼族效力。
rows.current: 有些忍者已经在为恶狼族效力。

rows.english: We belong to the Wolf now.
We are betrayed - kill the Serpent!
rows.rawText: 我们被出卖了！杀了灵蛇族人！
rows.current: 我们被出卖了！杀了灵蛇族人！

rows.english: Do you pay as well as your father did?
rows.rawText: 你给的报酬跟你父亲一样丰厚吗？
rows.current: 你给的报酬跟你父亲一样丰厚吗？

rows.english: Watch where you step, noble one.
As long as the Soul Flame burns, the ninja are free to do as they will.
rows.rawText: 只要魂焰还在燃烧，忍者就能自由行动。
rows.current: 只要魂焰还在燃烧，忍者就能自由行动。

rows.english: Who am I to upset the balance?
rows.rawText: 我有什么资格打破平衡？
rows.current: 我有什么资格打破平衡？

rows.english: The souls of their victims burn deep in the swamp.
rows.rawText: 被他们杀害的人，灵魂仍在沼泽深处燃烧。
rows.current: 被他们杀害的人，灵魂仍在沼泽深处燃烧。

rows.english: He who would rule the ninja must extinguish the flame.
rows.rawText: 想统领忍者的人必须熄灭那团火焰。
rows.current: 想统领忍者的人必须熄灭那团火焰。

rows.english: I am both dark and light.
What would you have me do?
But where has all the forest gone?
Curse the miners - they'll pay for their carelessness!
rows.rawText: 该死的矿工！他们要为自己的疏忽付出代价！
rows.current: 该死的矿工！他们要为自己的疏忽付出代价！

rows.english: Send Longtooth and his army to their fortress and tear it down.
rows.rawText: 派 长牙 率军去他们的要塞，把它拆了。
rows.current: 派 长牙 率军去他们的要塞，把它拆了。

rows.english: It's time the Lotus learned what it's like to lose a home.
rows.rawText: 该让莲花族尝尝失去家园的滋味了。
rows.current: 该让莲花族尝尝失去家园的滋味了。

rows.english: We don't traffic with your kind.
rows.rawText: 我们不跟你们这种人做交易。
rows.current: 我们不跟你们这种人做交易。

rows.english: We want to leave this land, but not at your price.
rows.rawText: 我们想离开这片土地，但不会接受你的条件。
rows.current: 我们想离开这片土地，但不会接受你的条件。

rows.english: Why would you give it to us?
rows.rawText: 你为什么要把它交给我们？
rows.current: 你为什么要把它交给我们？

rows.english: I told you, we don't traffic with...
I'm not finished with you!  Come back!
The Wolf will never bow to the Serpent!
rows.rawText: 恶狼族绝不会向灵蛇族低头！
rows.current: 恶狼族绝不会向灵蛇族低头！

rows.english: The Serpent's son is driving us back, Lord Grayback.
rows.rawText: 灰背大人，灵蛇族之子正把我们逼退。
rows.current: 灰背大人，灵蛇族之子正把我们逼退。

rows.english: Zymeth threw everything he had against Serpentholm.
rows.rawText: 齐梅斯 把全部兵力都投入了对灵蛇城的进攻。
rows.current: 齐梅斯 把全部兵力都投入了对灵蛇城的进攻。

rows.english: What's left of the clan is scattered.
The dark one stole it before we could reach the keep.
rows.rawText: 那个黑暗之人在我们赶到要塞前就把它偷走了。
rows.current: 那个黑暗之人在我们赶到要塞前就把它偷走了。

rows.rawText: 是谁把那群蛇放出来的？
rows.current: 是谁把那群蛇放出来的？

rows.english: Ahh…the infidels...right where Mistress Yvaine said they would be.
rows.rawText: 啊……异教徒……果然就在 伊薇恩 女主人说的地方。
rows.current: 啊……异教徒……果然就在 伊薇恩 女主人说的地方。

rows.english: We can't let these flea-ridden rebels escape…kill them all!
rows.rawText: 不能让这群满身跳蚤的叛徒逃走……把他们全杀了！
rows.current: 不能让这群满身跳蚤的叛徒逃走……把他们全杀了！

rows.english: What? Intruders? I don't have time for this!
rows.rawText: 什么？有入侵者？我没空应付！
rows.current: 什么？有入侵者？我没空应付！

rows.english: No! My time has run out!
Raiders, eh? There's not enough space here for all of us!
rows.rawText: 劫掠者？这地方可没你们的份！
rows.current: 劫掠者？这地方可没你们的份！

rows.english: Augh! There's nowhere left to run!
It's the rebels! Lord Issyl must know!
rows.rawText: 是叛军！得告诉 伊希尔 大人！
rows.current: 是叛军！得告诉 伊希尔 大人！

rows.rawText: 救命！伊希尔 大人！入侵者来了！
rows.current: 救命！伊希尔 大人！入侵者来了！

rows.english: Lord Koril! The Wolf raiders are approaching!
rows.rawText: 科里尔 大人！恶狼族的劫掠者逼近了！
rows.current: 科里尔 大人！恶狼族的劫掠者逼近了！

rows.english: Silence! I bring you a warning from Mistress Yvaine!
rows.rawText: 住口！我替 伊薇恩 女主人来警告你们！
rows.current: 住口！我替 伊薇恩 女主人来警告你们！

rows.english: The rice you sent to her feast was riddled with disgusting worms.
rows.rawText: 你们送去宴席的稻米爬满了恶心的虫子。
rows.current: 你们送去宴席的稻米爬满了恶心的虫子。

rows.english: Insult our Mistress again, and those worms will feast on you!
rows.rawText: 再敢侮辱我们的女主人，那些虫子就会拿你们开宴！
rows.current: 再敢侮辱我们的女主人，那些虫子就会拿你们开宴！

rows.english: Lady Yvaine will not. Watch yourself, Serpent brother.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 女士可不会。小心点，灵蛇族兄弟。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 女士可不会。小心点，灵蛇族兄弟。

rows.english: We've heard enough of your excuses, slaves!
rows.rawText: 奴隶，你们的借口我们已经听够了！
rows.current: 奴隶，你们的借口我们已经听够了！

rows.english: If you can't harvest rice, then you'll harvest pain!
rows.rawText: 收不了稻米，就来尝尝痛苦吧！
rows.current: 收不了稻米，就来尝尝痛苦吧！

rows.english: We're taking you back, but not alive.
rows.rawText: 我们会带你回去，不过是带你的尸体。
rows.current: 我们会带你回去，不过是带你的尸体。

rows.english: Your mind is disobedient, but your flesh will serve us well.
rows.rawText: 你的意志再不肯屈服，肉身也得为我们所用。
rows.current: 你的意志再不肯屈服，肉身也得为我们所用。

rows.english: You filthy beasts, do you know what you've done?
rows.rawText: 肮脏的家伙，你们知道自己干了什么吗？
rows.current: 肮脏的家伙，你们知道自己干了什么吗？

rows.english: You've wrecked research that cost us hundreds of able-bodied slaves!
rows.rawText: 你们毁掉的研究，耗费了我们数百名健壮奴隶的性命！
rows.current: 你们毁掉的研究，耗费了我们数百名健壮奴隶的性命！

rows.english: Next you'll be trying to steal that Gaihla woman from me.
rows.rawText: 接下来，你们是不是还要从我手里抢走那个叫 盖拉 的女人？
rows.current: 接下来，你们是不是还要从我手里抢走那个叫 盖拉 的女人？

rows.english: I've never had the chance to take apart one of the woods-walkers…
rows.rawText: 我还没机会拆解过林中行者呢……
rows.current: 我还没机会拆解过林中行者呢……

rows.english: Yvaine is quite eager to find out how she works!
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 一直想知道她身体里的秘密！
rows.current: 伊薇恩 一直想知道她身体里的秘密！

rows.english: My precious laboratory…Zymeth will be furious!
rows.rawText: 我的实验室……齐梅斯 会气坏的！
rows.current: 我的实验室……齐梅斯 会气坏的！

rows.english: These tunnels are forbidden to everyone but Mistress Yvaine!
rows.rawText: 这些坑道是禁地！除了 伊薇恩 大人，谁也不准踏进来！
rows.current: 这些坑道是禁地！除了 伊薇恩 大人，谁也不准踏进来！

rows.english: You again? I thought I told you to stay out!
rows.rawText: 又是你？我不是叫你别进来吗！
rows.current: 又是你？我不是叫你别进来吗！

rows.english: Lord Budo's orders mean nothing to me! Our Mistress will hear about this!
rows.rawText: 武堂大人的命令对我没用！我们的女主人会知道这件事！
rows.current: 武堂大人的命令对我没用！我们的女主人会知道这件事！

rows.english: You...you've killed all of my lovely spiders!
rows.rawText: 你……你把我可爱的蜘蛛全杀了！
rows.current: 你……你把我可爱的蜘蛛全杀了！

rows.rawText: 你这个没心肝的野蛮人！
rows.current: 你这个没心肝的野蛮人！

rows.english: Ten…enough to keep my babies fed for a month.
rows.rawText: 十个……够我的小宝贝们吃一个月了。
rows.current: 十个……够我的小宝贝们吃一个月了。

rows.english: But you killed all my babies, and now you're going to kill me too!
rows.rawText: 可你杀光了我的小宝贝，现在还要杀我！
rows.current: 可你杀光了我的小宝贝，现在还要杀我！

rows.english: I bear a message from the great Mistress Yvaine.
rows.rawText: 我带来了伟大的 伊薇恩 女主人的口信。
rows.current: 我带来了伟大的 伊薇恩 女主人的口信。

rows.english: Our Mistress requires your assistance, Serpent brother.
rows.rawText: 我们的女主人需要你们帮忙，灵蛇族兄弟。
rows.current: 我们的女主人需要你们帮忙，灵蛇族兄弟。

rows.english: Her kitchens have run out of rice, and this evening's feast draws near.
rows.rawText: 她的厨房没有稻米了，今晚的宴席又快到了。
rows.current: 她的厨房没有稻米了，今晚的宴席又快到了。

rows.english: Perhaps your workers could contribute their rations…
rows.rawText: 也许你们的工人能拿出自己的口粮……
rows.current: 也许你们的工人能拿出自己的口粮……

rows.rawText: 难以置信！又来了几个探子！
rows.current: 难以置信！又来了几个探子！

rows.english: And the hairy one? What do you have to say for yourself?
rows.rawText: 还有这个毛茸茸的家伙？你有什么话可说？
rows.current: 还有这个毛茸茸的家伙？你有什么话可说？

rows.english: Bah! I should kill you for your stupidity alone!
rows.rawText: 呸！光凭你的愚蠢，我就该杀了你！
rows.current: 呸！光凭你的愚蠢，我就该杀了你！

rows.english: Then again, if I killed every stupid Wolf, I'd have these mines to myself.
rows.rawText: 不过话说回来，要是把这些蠢狼全宰了，这矿井不就归我一个人了？
rows.current: 不过话说回来，要是把这些蠢狼全宰了，这矿井不就归我一个人了？

rows.english: Do exactly as I say, and I might let you live.
rows.rawText: 照我说的做，我或许还能饶你一命。
rows.current: 照我说的做，我或许还能饶你一命。

rows.english: Welcome to the deep mines. You'll eat, sleep, and work here now.
rows.rawText: 欢迎来到深矿。从今往后，你们就在这里吃饭、睡觉、干活。
rows.current: 欢迎来到深矿。从今往后，你们就在这里吃饭、睡觉、干活。

rows.english: There's only one punishment for misbehavior down here: the Shale Spiders.
rows.rawText: 在这里不听话，只有一种惩罚：页岩蜘蛛。
rows.current: 在这里不听话，只有一种惩罚：页岩蜘蛛。

rows.english: They lay their eggs in living flesh, and they're always hungry for new friends.
rows.rawText: 它们把卵产进活人的肉里，而且总想结交新朋友。
rows.current: 它们把卵产进活人的肉里，而且总想结交新朋友。

rows.english: If that shale isn't broken when I return, you'll meet them in person!
rows.rawText: 等我回来时，要是那块页岩还没敲碎，我就让你们亲自见见它们！
rows.current: 等我回来时，要是那块页岩还没敲碎，我就让你们亲自见见它们！

rows.english: What's this? How dare you disobey my orders, slave?
rows.rawText: 这是怎么回事？奴隶，你竟敢违抗我的命令？
rows.current: 这是怎么回事？奴隶，你竟敢违抗我的命令？

rows.english: And when I'm finished with you, you'll beg for death, little wolfling!
rows.rawText: 等我收拾完你，你会求我杀了你，小狼崽！
rows.current: 等我收拾完你，你会求我杀了你，小狼崽！

rows.english: Get your filthy hands off me!

rows.rawText: 你会为这次背叛付出代价！
rows.current: 你会为这次背叛付出代价！

rows.english: Still up to your games, dear…Grayback, isn't it?
rows.rawText: 你还在玩那套把戏，亲爱的……是叫灰背，对吧？
rows.current: 你还在玩那套把戏，亲爱的……是叫灰背，对吧？

rows.english: This is the first time I've ever bothered to remember one of your primitive names.
rows.rawText: 我还是头一回费心记住你们这种原始人的名字。
rows.current: 我还是头一回费心记住你们这种原始人的名字。

rows.english: I have another honor in mind for you, troublesome wolfling.
rows.rawText: 我还为你准备了另一份「荣幸」，惹事的小狼崽。
rows.current: 我还为你准备了另一份「荣幸」，惹事的小狼崽。

rows.english: I had planned to simply feed your body to the spiders.
rows.rawText: 我本来只打算把你的尸体喂蜘蛛。
rows.current: 我本来只打算把你的尸体喂蜘蛛。

rows.english: But Grayback's corpse deserves a much more glorious tomb!
rows.rawText: 不过灰背的尸体值得一座更气派的坟墓！
rows.current: 不过灰背的尸体值得一座更气派的坟墓！

rows.english: You'll never leave this mine, slave!
rows.rawText: 你永远别想离开这座矿井，奴隶！
rows.current: 你永远别想离开这座矿井，奴隶！

rows.english: Your Clan will be frozen solid before you can even starve to death!
rows.rawText: 在你饿死之前，你的族人就会先冻成冰块！
rows.current: 在你饿死之前，你的族人就会先冻成冰块！

rows.english: Now, Grayback, this is simply intolerable.
rows.rawText: 灰背，你真是越来越不像话了。
rows.current: 灰背，你真是越来越不像话了。

rows.english: I appreciate a good jest, but you really must die now.
rows.rawText: 玩笑开得不错，但你现在非死不可。
rows.current: 玩笑开得不错，但你现在非死不可。

rows.english: Oh, I remember…I just don't care.
Such a brave jester. You'll walk into any trap, won't you, Grayback?
rows.rawText: 真是个勇敢的小丑。灰背，难道什么陷阱你都要亲自往里跳吗？
rows.current: 真是个勇敢的小丑。灰背，难道什么陷阱你都要亲自往里跳吗？

rows.english: By the way, you're not going to find your Clan's totem here.
rows.rawText: 对了，你们一族的图腾不在这里。
rows.current: 对了，你们一族的图腾不在这里。

rows.english: The Skull of the White Wolf rests safely in my citadel…
rows.rawText: 白狼头骨正安稳地放在我的堡垒里……
rows.current: 白狼头骨正安稳地放在我的堡垒里……

rows.english: …and my spells of corruption have already begun to warp its powers.
rows.rawText: ……我的腐化法术已经开始扭曲它的力量。
rows.current: ……我的腐化法术已经开始扭曲它的力量。

rows.english: Don't you feel the chill in the air, little wolfling?
rows.rawText: 小狼崽，难道你感觉不到空气里的寒意吗？
rows.current: 小狼崽，难道你感觉不到空气里的寒意吗？

rows.english: I'd love to explain, but you won't live long enough to care.
rows.rawText: 我倒想解释给你听，可惜你活不到明白的那一天。
rows.current: 我倒想解释给你听，可惜你活不到明白的那一天。

rows.english: Death is the only freedom you'll ever find.
rows.rawText: 死亡是你此生唯一能得到的自由。
rows.current: 死亡是你此生唯一能得到的自由。

rows.english: It's been a long battle, hasn't it, Grayback?
rows.rawText: 我们打了这么久，灰背，你说是不是？
rows.current: 我们打了这么久，灰背，你说是不是？

rows.english: So much killing! I think your Wolf Clan was safer in my mines.
rows.rawText: 死了这么多人！我看你们恶狼族待在我的矿井里还更安全。
rows.current: 死了这么多人！我看你们恶狼族待在我的矿井里还更安全。

rows.english: What about death? Is that what you call freedom?
rows.rawText: 那死亡呢？你把它也叫作自由吗？
rows.current: 那死亡呢？你把它也叫作自由吗？

rows.english: Your totem was more powerful than I expected.
rows.rawText: 你们的图腾比我预想的更强大。
rows.current: 你们的图腾比我预想的更强大。

rows.english: It has…changed me, as much as I've changed it.
rows.rawText: 它……改变了我，就像我改变了它。
rows.current: 它……改变了我，就像我改变了它。

rows.english: I have been reborn, Grayback! Reborn as a goddess!
rows.rawText: 我重生了，灰背！重生为女神！
rows.current: 我重生了，灰背！重生为女神！

rows.english: But madness isn't my only source of power!
rows.rawText: 可疯狂并非我唯一的力量来源！
rows.current: 可疯狂并非我唯一的力量来源！

rows.english: All the magic of the Wolf Clan is bound to me by these Orbs of Corruption.
rows.rawText: 借助这些腐化宝珠，恶狼族的法力尽归我掌控。
rows.current: 借助这些腐化宝珠，恶狼族的法力尽归我掌控。

rows.english: You'll never defeat me while I wield the power of the White Wolf!
rows.rawText: 只要我掌握白狼的力量，你就绝不可能打败我！
rows.current: 只要我掌握白狼的力量，你就绝不可能打败我！

rows.english: I don’t need your Totem's power, Grayback!
rows.rawText: 我不需要你们图腾的力量，灰背！
rows.current: 我不需要你们图腾的力量，灰背！

rows.english: If I have to, I'll kill you with my bare hands!
rows.rawText: 必要的话，我赤手空拳也能杀了你！
rows.current: 必要的话，我赤手空拳也能杀了你！

rows.english: Who let you lazy dogs into my mines?
rows.rawText: 谁让你们这些懒狗进我的矿井？
rows.current: 谁让你们这些懒狗进我的矿井？

rows.english: Oh, so the dogs are finally hungry enough to wake up?
You, with the pick-axe, head down the tunnel to your right.
rows.rawText: 你，拿镐的，沿右边的坑道往下走。
rows.current: 你，拿镐的，沿右边的坑道往下走。

rows.english: There's a pile of shale down there, just waiting to be broken up.
rows.rawText: 那里有一堆页岩，正等着你们敲碎。
rows.current: 那里有一堆页岩，正等着你们敲碎。

rows.english: Finish that task, return to me, and I'll give you both rice to share.
rows.rawText: 做完回来见我，我就给你们两个分些稻米。
rows.current: 做完回来见我，我就给你们两个分些稻米。

rows.english: Greedy, greedy…I'll send for it soon.
rows.rawText: 真贪心，真贪心……我很快就派人去取。
rows.current: 真贪心，真贪心……我很快就派人去取。

rows.english: Of course! Yvaine's slaves live only to obey her commands.
rows.rawText: 当然！伊薇恩 的奴隶活着就是为了服从她。
rows.current: 当然！伊薇恩 的奴隶活着就是为了服从她。

rows.english: You'll have none. Yvaine's desires are law on Lotus ground.
rows.rawText: 你们一粒都别想要。莲花族的地盘上，伊薇恩 的心愿就是法令。
rows.current: 你们一粒都别想要。莲花族的地盘上，伊薇恩 的心愿就是法令。

rows.rawText: 你没完没了地哀求也没用！
rows.current: 你没完没了地哀求也没用！

rows.english: A shale pile to the southwest has been blocked by a cave-in.
rows.rawText: 西南边一堆页岩被塌下的洞壁挡住了。
rows.current: 西南边一堆页岩被塌下的洞壁挡住了。

rows.english: Take your friend with the hammer -- he'll be able to break through that cave-in.
rows.rawText: 带上那个拿锤子的同伴，他能敲开塌下来的石头。
rows.current: 带上那个拿锤子的同伴，他能敲开塌下来的石头。

rows.english: Then break up the shale pile, and hurry back.
rows.rawText: 然后把页岩敲碎，赶紧回来。
rows.current: 然后把页岩敲碎，赶紧回来。

rows.english: If you produce more shale, maybe I can talk the Lotus into giving you more rice.
rows.rawText: 多产些页岩，我也许能劝莲花族再给你们点稻米。
rows.current: 多产些页岩，我也许能劝莲花族再给你们点稻米。

rows.english: Now get to work -- unless you're hungry for my whip!
rows.rawText: 快去干活，不然就尝尝我的鞭子！
rows.current: 快去干活，不然就尝尝我的鞭子！

rows.english: Impressive...I expected that to take longer.
rows.rawText: 真让我吃惊……我以为会花更久。
rows.current: 真让我吃惊……我以为会花更久。

rows.english: It seems you're not so weak from hunger, after all.
rows.rawText: 看来饥饿还没把你们弄得太虚弱。
rows.current: 看来饥饿还没把你们弄得太虚弱。

rows.english: Where it's safe. I keep my bargains, slave.
rows.rawText: 放在安全的地方。我说话算话，奴隶。
rows.current: 放在安全的地方。我说话算话，奴隶。

rows.english: Another messenger? What do you want?
rows.rawText: 又来了个传信的？你想要什么？
rows.current: 又来了个传信的？你想要什么？

rows.english: My apologies! How dare these slaves offer such horrid food to our Mistress!
rows.rawText: 请恕罪！这帮奴隶竟敢拿这种可怖的食物来招待女主人！
rows.current: 请恕罪！这帮奴隶竟敢拿这种可怖的食物来招待女主人！

rows.english: Please, accept the last of my rice and my humble apologies.
rows.rawText: 请收下我最后的稻米，原谅我的过错。
rows.current: 请收下我最后的稻米，原谅我的过错。

rows.english: I'm afraid these filthy savages will eat anything.
rows.rawText: 恐怕这些肮脏的野人什么都吃得下。
rows.current: 恐怕这些肮脏的野人什么都吃得下。

rows.english: What an unfortunate mistake you made, giving Yvaine that rotten rice.
rows.rawText: 你把坏掉的稻米送给 伊薇恩，真是犯了个大错。
rows.current: 你把坏掉的稻米送给 伊薇恩，真是犯了个大错。

rows.english: You'll have to work twice as hard to earn your dinner now.
rows.rawText: 现在你得加倍干活，才能挣到晚饭。
rows.current: 现在你得加倍干活，才能挣到晚饭。

rows.english: Disobedience, from a dirty Wolf cub? My whip might teach you some manners!
rows.rawText: 一只肮脏的恶狼族小崽子也敢不服从？我的鞭子会教你规矩！
rows.current: 一只肮脏的恶狼族小崽子也敢不服从？我的鞭子会教你规矩！

rows.rawText: 不服从，还敢威胁我？不可容忍！
rows.current: 不服从，还敢威胁我？不可容忍！

rows.english: Your friend gets thirty lashes for your loose tongue!
rows.rawText: 你这张嘴害得朋友要挨三十鞭！
rows.current: 你这张嘴害得朋友要挨三十鞭！

rows.english: Unless, perhaps, you're willing to make it up to me?
Yvaine has forbidden me from sending workers into the deep tunnels.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 不许我派人去深处的坑道。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 不许我派人去深处的坑道。

rows.english: She's hiding something down there, and I don't like secrets or surprises.
rows.rawText: 她在那里藏了东西，而我不喜欢秘密，更不喜欢意外。
rows.current: 她在那里藏了东西，而我不喜欢秘密，更不喜欢意外。

rows.english: Sneak down there, take a look for me, and I might forget to punish you.
rows.rawText: 偷偷下去替我看看，也许我就不罚你了。
rows.current: 偷偷下去替我看看，也许我就不罚你了。

rows.english: Now get moving before I change my mind!
Well, well…my little spies have turned into rebels. How precious.
rows.rawText: 哎呀，我的小探子竟成了叛军。真可爱。
rows.current: 哎呀，我的小探子竟成了叛军。真可爱。

rows.english: If these Lotus weaklings could manage their own slaves, I wouldn't be here.
rows.rawText: 要是莲花族的废物管得住自己的奴隶，我也不用来了。
rows.current: 要是莲花族的废物管得住自己的奴隶，我也不用来了。

rows.english: On your knees! Nobody defies Budo!
It's my job to keep you under control. Your business is with me…
rows.rawText: 控制你们是我的职责。你们要找的人是我……
rows.current: 控制你们是我的职责。你们要找的人是我……

rows.english: Prince Taro sent a squadron of his elite Enforcers to help keep the peace.
rows.rawText: 太郎 王子派来一队精锐 执法者，帮我维持秩序。
rows.current: 太郎 王子派来一队精锐 执法者，帮我维持秩序。

rows.english: Let's see whether a pack of hungry slaves can handle real warriors!
rows.rawText: 看看一群饿坏的奴隶能不能对付真正的战士！
rows.current: 看看一群饿坏的奴隶能不能对付真正的战士！

rows.english: I underestimated you, slave. You're not as stupid as you look.
rows.rawText: 我低估你了，奴隶。你没看上去那么蠢。
rows.current: 我低估你了，奴隶。你没看上去那么蠢。

rows.english: I didn't expect you to beat Prince Taro's favorite thugs.
rows.rawText: 没想到你打败了 太郎 王子最喜欢的打手。
rows.current: 没想到你打败了 太郎 王子最喜欢的打手。

rows.english: He won't be happy about that.
Since you're not afraid of killing Serpents, let's see if you enjoy killing your own people!
rows.rawText: 既然你不怕杀灵蛇族的人，那就试试看杀自己人！
rows.current: 既然你不怕杀灵蛇族的人，那就试试看杀自己人！

rows.english: Amazing what a few grains of rice can buy, isn't it?
rows.rawText: 一点稻米就能买到这些，真叫人吃惊，不是吗？
rows.current: 一点稻米就能买到这些，真叫人吃惊，不是吗？

rows.english: You're sure they made it this far?
rows.rawText: 你确定他们已经到了这里？
rows.current: 你确定他们已经到了这里？

rows.english: I thought our army would stop the Wolves below.
rows.rawText: 我以为我军会在下面挡住恶狼族。
rows.current: 我以为我军会在下面挡住恶狼族。

rows.english: This rebellion threatens everything that the Serpent Clan has become.
rows.rawText: 这场叛乱威胁着灵蛇族如今的一切。
rows.current: 这场叛乱威胁着灵蛇族如今的一切。

rows.english: If Taro won't kill Grayback, I'll do it myself!
rows.rawText: 太郎 不杀灰背，我就亲自动手！
rows.current: 太郎 不杀灰背，我就亲自动手！

rows.english: Oja can feed me to his hounds, as long as Grayback dies beneath my whip.
rows.rawText: 只要灰背死在我的鞭下，就算 奥贾 把我喂狗也无所谓。
rows.current: 只要灰背死在我的鞭下，就算 奥贾 把我喂狗也无所谓。

rows.english: Save it for Grayback, my charming murderess.
rows.rawText: 留给灰背吧，我迷人的女杀手。
rows.current: 留给灰背吧，我迷人的女杀手。

rows.english: Right now, it's time for us to trap a Wolf.
rows.rawText: 眼下该设圈套抓一头狼了。
rows.current: 眼下该设圈套抓一头狼了。

rows.english: I see that Budo and Utara spoke the truth…
rows.rawText: 看来武堂和 宇多罗 说的是真的……
rows.current: 看来武堂和 宇多罗 说的是真的……

rows.english: …the Wolf Clan is running rampant across the land.
rows.rawText: ……恶狼族正在这片土地上横行。
rows.current: ……恶狼族正在这片土地上横行。

rows.english: I am Prince Taro, heir to the Serpent throne.
rows.rawText: 我是 太郎 王子，灵蛇族王位的继承人。
rows.current: 我是 太郎 王子，灵蛇族王位的继承人。

rows.english: My father sent me to restore order and end this winter.
rows.rawText: 父亲派我来恢复秩序，结束这场寒冬。
rows.current: 父亲派我来恢复秩序，结束这场寒冬。

rows.english: Your savage witchcraft is starving our peasants!
rows.rawText: 你们的野蛮巫术正让我们的农民挨饿！
rows.current: 你们的野蛮巫术正让我们的农民挨饿！

rows.english: Don't try to confuse me with your silly lies!
rows.rawText: 别想用那些荒唐谎话糊弄我！
rows.current: 别想用那些荒唐谎话糊弄我！

rows.english: You will address me by my proper title!
rows.rawText: 你得用我的正式头衔称呼我！
rows.current: 你得用我的正式头衔称呼我！

rows.english: How dare you attempt to turn me against my friends?
rows.rawText: 你竟敢挑拨我和朋友的关系？
rows.current: 你竟敢挑拨我和朋友的关系？

rows.english: I'm warning you -- leave now, or face my wrath!
rows.rawText: 我警告你们，立刻离开，否则就承受我的怒火！
rows.current: 我警告你们，立刻离开，否则就承受我的怒火！

rows.english: You filthy bandits, you've slain my bodyguards!
rows.rawText: 你们这群肮脏匪徒，竟杀了我的护卫！
rows.current: 你们这群肮脏匪徒，竟杀了我的护卫！

rows.english: Don't touch me -- my father will avenge my death!
rows.rawText: 别碰我！我父亲会替我报仇的！
rows.current: 别碰我！我父亲会替我报仇的！

rows.english: I'll not tell your lies to Lord Oja…my failure will be punished harshly enough!
rows.rawText: 我不会把你的谎话转告 奥贾 大人……我的失败已经够我受罚了！
rows.current: 我不会把你的谎话转告 奥贾 大人……我的失败已经够我受罚了！

rows.english: And if Mistress Yvaine kills you all?
rows.rawText: 要是 伊薇恩 女主人把你们全杀了呢？
rows.current: 要是 伊薇恩 女主人把你们全杀了呢？

rows.english: So quick-witted…you remind me of my brother.
rows.rawText: 你们反应真快……让我想起了我的兄弟。
rows.current: 你们反应真快……让我想起了我的兄弟。

rows.english: Very well…the Prince of the Serpent Empire allows you to pass.
rows.rawText: 好吧……灵蛇帝国的王子准你们通行。
rows.current: 好吧……灵蛇帝国的王子准你们通行。

rows.rawText: 好好享受你们的毁灭吧，奴隶们！
rows.current: 好好享受你们的毁灭吧，奴隶们！

rows.english: My…you're a big, strong one, aren't you?
rows.rawText: 哎呀……你可真高大强壮，不是吗？
rows.current: 哎呀……你可真高大强壮，不是吗？

rows.english: I never knew dirt could be such a fashionable accessory!
rows.rawText: 什么时候满身泥巴也成时髦了？
rows.current: 什么时候满身泥巴也成时髦了？

rows.english: And you must be the new Wolf chieftain that Yvaine's so angry about.
rows.rawText: 你一定就是那个让 伊薇恩 恼火的新任恶狼族首领。
rows.current: 你一定就是那个让 伊薇恩 恼火的新任恶狼族首领。

rows.english: She hates you as much as I hate that prissy little Gaihla!
rows.rawText: 她恨你，就像我恨那个装腔作势的小 盖拉！
rows.current: 她恨你，就像我恨那个装腔作势的小 盖拉！

rows.english: I'll kill anyone for enough gold -- that's why Yvaine and I get along so well.
rows.rawText: 只要金子给得够，我谁都肯杀。所以我和 伊薇恩 才这么合得来。
rows.current: 只要金子给得够，我谁都肯杀。所以我和 伊薇恩 才这么合得来。

rows.english: I can't believe she demanded Gaihla alive! I had to double my usual fee!
rows.rawText: 真不敢相信她非要活捉 盖拉！我只好把惯常的价钱翻了一倍！
rows.current: 真不敢相信她非要活捉 盖拉！我只好把惯常的价钱翻了一倍！

rows.english: Where you'll never, ever, ever find her.
rows.rawText: 在一个你永远、永远也找不到她的地方。
rows.current: 在一个你永远、永远也找不到她的地方。

rows.english: You know, Yvaine offered to double my fee again if I brought back Grayback's severed head.
rows.rawText: 你知道吗，伊薇恩 说如果我带回灰背的人头，就再给我双倍酬金。
rows.current: 你知道吗，伊薇恩 说如果我带回灰背的人头，就再给我双倍酬金。

rows.english: It's time for you and I to play rough!
rows.rawText: 该让你我好好较量一场了！
rows.current: 该让你我好好较量一场了！

rows.english: Oooh…I like a man who isn't afraid to beat up a lady.
rows.rawText: 哦……我喜欢敢对女人动手的男人。
rows.current: 哦……我喜欢敢对女人动手的男人。

rows.english: If you don't kill me now, it'll be the last mistake you make.
rows.rawText: 现在不杀我，你就再也没有机会了。
rows.current: 现在不杀我，你就再也没有机会了。

rows.english: If you want Gaihla, you can find what's left of her in Lord Soban's laboratory.
rows.rawText: 想找 盖拉？去 索班 大人的实验室，看看她还剩下些什么吧。
rows.current: 想找 盖拉？去 索班 大人的实验室，看看她还剩下些什么吧。

rows.english: I bet Soban is already cutting her open to see how she works!
rows.rawText: 我敢打赌， 索班 早把她开膛破肚，研究个明白了！
rows.current: 我敢打赌， 索班 早把她开膛破肚，研究个明白了！

rows.english: She'll probably end up as one of his abominations -- that would be delightful…
rows.rawText: 她最后恐怕会变成他的怪物之一……那可真有趣。
rows.current: 她最后恐怕会变成他的怪物之一……那可真有趣。

rows.english: We'll play together again, Grayback -- and next time, I'll be playing for keeps!
rows.rawText: 我们还会再一起玩，灰背。下次我可要玩真的！
rows.current: 我们还会再一起玩，灰背。下次我可要玩真的！

rows.english: Still wandering around in the cold, Grayback?
rows.rawText: 灰背，还在寒风里游荡呢？
rows.current: 灰背，还在寒风里游荡呢？

rows.english: You should let me warm you up.
rows.rawText: 让我来替你暖暖身子吧。
rows.current: 让我来替你暖暖身子吧。

rows.english: Ambush? I don't know what you're talking about.
rows.rawText: 埋伏？我不知道你在说什么。
rows.current: 埋伏？我不知道你在说什么。

rows.english: My friends and I just want to throw you a party.
rows.rawText: 我和朋友们只是想为你办场宴会。
rows.current: 我和朋友们只是想为你办场宴会。

rows.english: A celebration of Lord Grayback and his amazing victories!
rows.rawText: 庆祝灰背大人取得的辉煌胜利！
rows.current: 庆祝灰背大人取得的辉煌胜利！

rows.english: Oh, they're all locked up -- it seemed a waste to kill such promising slaves.
rows.rawText: 哦，他们都被关起来了。这么有潜力的奴隶，杀了太可惜。
rows.current: 哦，他们都被关起来了。这么有潜力的奴隶，杀了太可惜。

rows.english: That weak-hearted Prince Taro allowed them to pass.
rows.rawText: 心肠软弱的 太郎 王子放他们过去了。
rows.current: 心肠软弱的 太郎 王子放他们过去了。

rows.english: Sometimes I think he's more a woman than I am…
rows.rawText: 有时候我觉得他比我更像个女人……
rows.current: 有时候我觉得他比我更像个女人……

rows.english: Even if it means disobeying Lord Oja's firstborn son?
rows.rawText: 哪怕要违抗 奥贾 大人的长子？
rows.current: 哪怕要违抗 奥贾 大人的长子？

rows.english: Mmm…you and I enjoy the same hobbies, Budo.
rows.rawText: 啊……武堂，你我有相同的爱好。
rows.current: 啊……武堂，你我有相同的爱好。

rows.english: We could play delightful games together if you weren't so revolting…
rows.rawText: 要不是你这么恶心，我们本可以一起玩些有趣的游戏……
rows.current: 要不是你这么恶心，我们本可以一起玩些有趣的游戏……

rows.english: High Druidess Gaihla has been kidnapped, and the Forest Temple is under attack!
rows.rawText: 大祭师 盖拉 被抓走了，森林神殿正遭受攻击！
rows.current: 大祭师 盖拉 被抓走了，森林神殿正遭受攻击！

rows.english: The Lotus aren't attacking us -- Utara and her Witches are behind this.
rows.rawText: 袭击我们的不是莲花族，是 宇多罗 和她的女巫！
rows.current: 袭击我们的不是莲花族，是 宇多罗 和她的女巫！

rows.english: Sometimes they raid our forests, looking for valuable herbs and spell components.
rows.rawText: 她们时常闯入我们的森林，搜寻珍贵药草和施法材料。
rows.current: 她们时常闯入我们的森林，搜寻珍贵药草和施法材料。

rows.english: But they've never attacked us so savagely before!
rows.rawText: 可她们从未如此凶狠地袭击过我们！
rows.current: 可她们从未如此凶狠地袭击过我们！

rows.english: We drove back their first assault, but Gaihla disappeared in the confusion.
rows.rawText: 我们击退了她们的第一波进攻，但 盖拉 在混乱中失踪了。
rows.current: 我们击退了她们的第一波进攻，但 盖拉 在混乱中失踪了。

rows.english: If they succeed in destroying the Forest Temple, all will be lost!
rows.rawText: 要是森林神殿被毁，一切就全完了！
rows.current: 要是森林神殿被毁，一切就全完了！

rows.english: I will be. Thank you for rescuing me.
rows.rawText: 我会照顾好自己。谢谢你救了我。
rows.current: 我会照顾好自己。谢谢你救了我。

rows.english: You have come to ask for my help against Yvaine.
rows.rawText: 你来找我，是想请我帮忙对付 伊薇恩。
rows.current: 你来找我，是想请我帮忙对付 伊薇恩。

rows.english: You are courageous and strong...I will do what I can.
rows.rawText: 你勇敢又坚强……我会尽我所能。
rows.current: 你勇敢又坚强……我会尽我所能。

rows.english: I'm so cold…maybe we should rest here…
rows.rawText: 好冷……也许我们该在这里休息……
rows.current: 好冷……也许我们该在这里休息……

rows.english: This snow is killing me, Grayback.
rows.rawText: 这场雪快要了我的命，灰背。
rows.current: 这场雪快要了我的命，灰背。

rows.english: I can't go on any longer…
I can feel the natural balance returning...Yvaine is gone.
rows.rawText: 我感觉到了……自然正在重归平衡。伊薇恩 死了。
rows.current: 我感觉到了……自然正在重归平衡。伊薇恩 死了。

rows.english: The White Wolf himself must have protected you.
rows.rawText: 一定是白狼亲自护佑了你。
rows.current: 一定是白狼亲自护佑了你。

rows.english: This is a great victory, but we will face new challenges someday.
rows.rawText: 这是一次伟大的胜利，但总有一天，我们会迎来新的挑战。
rows.current: 这是一次伟大的胜利，但总有一天，我们会迎来新的挑战。

rows.english: Yvaine was Lord Zymeth's mistress…someday, they might have ruled the Clan together.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 是 齐梅斯 领主的情人……有朝一日，他们可能会共同统治全族。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 是 齐梅斯 领主的情人……有朝一日，他们可能会共同统治全族。

rows.english: I'm sure Zymeth will try to avenge her death.
rows.rawText: 我相信 齐梅斯 会设法为她复仇。
rows.current: 我相信 齐梅斯 会设法为她复仇。

rows.english: Soban called him the Shale Lord…he doesn't speak often.
rows.rawText: 索班 叫他页岩领主……他很少说话。
rows.current: 索班 叫他页岩领主……他很少说话。

rows.english: I believe he used to be a Wolf slave.
rows.rawText: 我想他以前也是个被奴役的恶狼族人。
rows.current: 我想他以前也是个被奴役的恶狼族人。

rows.english: All things are part of the natural order -- even this strange being.
rows.rawText: 万物都属于自然秩序的一部分，连这个奇异的生灵也不例外。
rows.current: 万物都属于自然秩序的一部分，连这个奇异的生灵也不例外。

rows.english: No…I could not even protect my own Sanctuary.
rows.rawText: 不……我连自己的圣所都没能守住。
rows.current: 不……我连自己的圣所都没能守住。

rows.english: As long as Yvaine is using our own Clan's magic, I am powerless.
rows.rawText: 只要 伊薇恩 还在使用我们族的法术，我就无能为力。
rows.current: 只要 伊薇恩 还在使用我们族的法术，我就无能为力。

rows.english: You will need my help to keep Yvaine from freezing the land to death.
rows.rawText: 你需要我的帮助，才能阻止 伊薇恩 把这片土地冻死。
rows.current: 你需要我的帮助，才能阻止 伊薇恩 把这片土地冻死。

rows.english: I can lead you to her mountain fortress…I have seen the way in my dreams.
rows.rawText: 我可以带你去她的山中堡垒……我在梦里见过那条路。
rows.current: 我可以带你去她的山中堡垒……我在梦里见过那条路。

rows.english: But you are the Lord of the Wolves.
What else would you expect from a greedy Serpent taskmaster?
rows.rawText: 贪婪的灵蛇族监工还能指望他做什么？
rows.current: 贪婪的灵蛇族监工还能指望他做什么？

rows.english: Still, I'm glad Yvaine and her Lotus goons have stopped watching us so closely.
rows.rawText: 不过，伊薇恩 和她的莲花族走狗不再盯我们那么紧，我倒很高兴。
rows.current: 不过，伊薇恩 和她的莲花族走狗不再盯我们那么紧，我倒很高兴。

rows.english: The Lotus are our true enemies.
rows.rawText: 莲花族才是我们真正的敌人。
rows.current: 莲花族才是我们真正的敌人。

rows.english: No, but she's stopped fearing us.
rows.rawText: 不，但她已经不再怕我们了。
rows.current: 不，但她已经不再怕我们了。

rows.english: Yvaine seems to think that we've lost the strength to fight.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 似乎以为我们失去了反抗的力量。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 似乎以为我们失去了反抗的力量。

rows.english: Be patient…the day of our rebellion is coming.
rows.rawText: 耐心点……起义的日子快到了。
rows.current: 耐心点……起义的日子快到了。

rows.english: We can't work without food, Budo.
rows.rawText: 没有米，我们就干不了活，武堂。
rows.current: 没有米，我们就干不了活，武堂。

rows.english: Better head back to Budo and claim our rice...
rows.rawText: 还是回去找武堂领我们的米吧……
rows.current: 还是回去找武堂领我们的米吧……

rows.english: The shale is broken. Where's our rice?
rows.rawText: 页岩已经敲碎了。我们的米呢？
rows.current: 页岩已经敲碎了。我们的米呢？

rows.english: But laws alone won't keep us from starving.
rows.rawText: 但光靠法规也无法让我们活下去。
rows.current: 但光靠法规也无法让我们活下去。

rows.english: Budo's tasks just get harder…let's head back.
rows.rawText: 武堂派的活越来越难了……回去吧。
rows.current: 武堂派的活越来越难了……回去吧。

rows.english: A Wolf's hunger gives him strength, not weakness. Where's our rice?
rows.rawText: 恶狼族越饿越有力气，而非越弱。我们的米在哪里？
rows.current: 恶狼族越饿越有力气，而非越弱。我们的米在哪里？

rows.english: Yvaine won't be too happy if you beat her starving slaves to death.
rows.rawText: 你若把 伊薇恩 的奴隶打死，她可不会高兴。
rows.current: 你若把 伊薇恩 的奴隶打死，她可不会高兴。

rows.english: Budo ordered us to search these tunnels for new shale to mine…
rows.rawText: 武堂命令我们到这些地道里寻找可开采的新页岩……
rows.current: 武堂命令我们到这些地道里寻找可开采的新页岩……

rows.english: I thought the Skull of the White Wolf had been lost forever!
rows.rawText: 我以为白狼之颅早就永远遗失了！
rows.current: 我以为白狼之颅早就永远遗失了！

rows.english: It's the last remnant of a forgotten spirit, and the greatest treasure of our Clan.
rows.rawText: 它是远古神灵留下的最后遗物，也是我们一族最珍贵的宝物。
rows.current: 它是远古神灵留下的最后遗物，也是我们一族最珍贵的宝物。

rows.english: The Skull Totem has incredible powers, especially over weather and nature.
rows.rawText: 颅骨图腾威力无穷，能呼风唤雨，移山填海。
rows.current: 颅骨图腾威力无穷，能呼风唤雨，移山填海。

rows.english: Long ago, our Druidess Order used its magic to bring our ancestors to these lands.
rows.rawText: 很久以前，德鲁伊教团用它的魔法将我们的祖先带到这片土地。
rows.current: 很久以前，德鲁伊教团用它的魔法将我们的祖先带到这片土地。

rows.english: What could Yvaine be planning to use this for…?
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 打算拿它做什么……？
rows.current: 伊薇恩 打算拿它做什么……？

rows.english: I'm just following Budo's orders…is something wrong?
rows.rawText: 我只是按武堂的命令办事……有什么不对吗？
rows.current: 我只是按武堂的命令办事……有什么不对吗？

rows.english: I must not die...my Clan still needs me…!
rows.rawText: 我不能死……族人还需要我！
rows.current: 我不能死……族人还需要我！

rows.english: If I can't protect my Clan brothers, the rebellion is doomed…
rows.rawText: 连族中兄弟都护不住，这场起义就没希望了……
rows.current: 连族中兄弟都护不住，这场起义就没希望了……

rows.english: She's probably just waiting for a chance to kill us quietly.
rows.rawText: 她大概只是在等机会悄悄杀掉我们。
rows.current: 她大概只是在等机会悄悄杀掉我们。

rows.english: We've got to warn the other miners that we've been captured.
rows.rawText: 我们得通知其他矿工，我们已经被俘。
rows.current: 我们得通知其他矿工，我们已经被俘。

rows.english: If we don't fight Yvaine now, we might not live to see another chance!
rows.rawText: 现在不反抗 伊薇恩，恐怕就等不到下一次机会了！
rows.current: 现在不反抗 伊薇恩，恐怕就等不到下一次机会了！

rows.english: Let's break this shale pile so that Yvaine doesn't become suspicious.
rows.rawText: 先砸开这堆页岩，免得 伊薇恩 起疑。
rows.current: 先砸开这堆页岩，免得 伊薇恩 起疑。

rows.english: We'll smuggle a warning to our allies afterwards.
rows.rawText: 之后再偷偷给盟友送信。
rows.current: 之后再偷偷给盟友送信。

rows.english: I expected Yvaine to be more subtle than this.
rows.rawText: 我以为 伊薇恩 会耍得更隐蔽些。
rows.current: 我以为 伊薇恩 会耍得更隐蔽些。

rows.english: Obviously, she's no longer satisfied with simply working us to death.
rows.rawText: 显然，光把我们累死已经不能让她满足了。
rows.current: 显然，光把我们累死已经不能让她满足了。

rows.english: We must free our fellow prisoners and escape to the upper levels!
rows.rawText: 必须救出其他囚徒，逃到矿坑上层！
rows.current: 必须救出其他囚徒，逃到矿坑上层！

rows.english: The time to seize our freedom is now!
Sounds like someone's in trouble to the north -- let's move!
rows.rawText: 北边好像有人遇险，快走！
rows.current: 北边好像有人遇险，快走！

rows.english: Longtooth! I didn't expect to find you here!
rows.rawText: 长牙！没想到会在这里找到你！
rows.current: 长牙！没想到会在这里找到你！

rows.english: You're free now -- and I need your help, old friend.
rows.rawText: 你自由了，老朋友，我需要你的帮助。
rows.current: 你自由了，老朋友，我需要你的帮助。

rows.english: It's time to show the Lotus what we're made of.
rows.rawText: 该让莲花族见识我们的厉害了。
rows.current: 该让莲花族见识我们的厉害了。

rows.english: Are you ready to fight by my side?
rows.rawText: 你准备好与我并肩作战了吗？
rows.current: 你准备好与我并肩作战了吗？

rows.english: I am Grayback, leader of the Wolf Clan. Call me 'slave' again, and you'll have death as your answer!
rows.rawText: 我是灰背，恶狼族的首领。再敢叫我一声“奴隶”，我就要你的命！
rows.current: 我是灰背，恶狼族的首领。再敢叫我一声“奴隶”，我就要你的命！

rows.english: She's going to fetch her warriors.
We must rally our comrades in the upper mines. Follow me!
rows.rawText: 我们必须召集上层矿坑的伙伴。跟我来！
rows.current: 我们必须召集上层矿坑的伙伴。跟我来！

rows.english: What are you doing down here?
Stop babbling. How many slaves are imprisoned down here?
rows.rawText: 别胡说八道。这里关了多少奴隶？
rows.current: 别胡说八道。这里关了多少奴隶？

rows.english: You're too pathetic to kill. Get out of here.
rows.rawText: 你可怜得让我不屑杀你。滚吧。
rows.current: 你可怜得让我不屑杀你。滚吧。

rows.english: Did you hear that? We've got to rescue all ten slaves before we escape…
rows.rawText: 听到了吗？逃出去之前，我们得救出全部十名奴隶……
rows.current: 听到了吗？逃出去之前，我们得救出全部十名奴隶……

rows.english: Two warriors freed, eight to go…
rows.rawText: 救出两名战士，还剩八名……
rows.current: 救出两名战士，还剩八名……

rows.english: That's half of them…we must keep searching!
Just three more Wolf Clansmen to find, and we can leave this pit…
rows.rawText: 再找到三名族人，我们就能离开这座矿坑……
rows.current: 再找到三名族人，我们就能离开这座矿坑……

rows.english: There's only one prisoner left -- now where is he?
rows.rawText: 只剩最后一名囚徒了，他在哪儿？
rows.current: 只剩最后一名囚徒了，他在哪儿？

rows.english: That's the last of our captive brothers -- let's head for the upper mines.
rows.rawText: 被俘的兄弟都救出来了，去上层矿坑吧。
rows.current: 被俘的兄弟都救出来了，去上层矿坑吧。

rows.english: Stay alert. Yvaine won't let us escape these depths without a fight!
rows.rawText: 保持警惕。伊薇恩 不会轻易让我们逃出深处！
rows.current: 保持警惕。伊薇恩 不会轻易让我们逃出深处！

rows.english: Longtooth has fallen! Our cause seems hopeless now...
rows.rawText: 长牙 倒下了！这下我们怕是没指望了……
rows.current: 长牙 倒下了！这下我们怕是没指望了……

rows.english: To bring the Lotus down, we'll need the strength of every last Wolf Clansman.
rows.rawText: 要推翻莲花族，我们需要每一位族人的力量。
rows.current: 要推翻莲花族，我们需要每一位族人的力量。

rows.english: We must break their chains before Yvaine's troops arrive!
rows.rawText: 必须赶在 伊薇恩 的部队到来前为他们挣断锁链！
rows.current: 必须赶在 伊薇恩 的部队到来前为他们挣断锁链！

rows.english: Yes, we'll need a Pitch Slinger to burn it away from a safe distance.
rows.rawText: 没错，需要沥青投手在安全距离外把它烧掉。
rows.current: 没错，需要沥青投手在安全距离外把它烧掉。

rows.english: I'm surprised there aren't any Pitch Slingers locked up nearby...
rows.rawText: 附近居然没关着沥青投手，真奇怪……
rows.current: 附近居然没关着沥青投手，真奇怪……

rows.english: Strike that lever, and we'll find out.
rows.rawText: 打一下那根拉杆就知道了。
rows.current: 打一下那根拉杆就知道了。

rows.english: It's locked…maybe a Sledger could break down the door.
rows.rawText: 锁住了……也许巨槌工能砸开门。
rows.current: 锁住了……也许巨槌工能砸开门。

rows.english: Our Pitch Slingers should be able to burn that gas away from a distance.
rows.rawText: 沥青投手应该能在远处把那团气体烧掉。
rows.current: 沥青投手应该能在远处把那团气体烧掉。

rows.english: Out of the way. Our business is with the Lotus.
rows.rawText: 让开。我们要找的是莲花族。
rows.current: 让开。我们要找的是莲花族。

rows.english: Too many of the Wolf Clan are still in chains.
rows.rawText: 还有太多族人戴着锁链。
rows.current: 还有太多族人戴着锁链。

rows.english: As long as they remain here, so must I.
rows.rawText: 只要他们还在这里，我就不会离开。
rows.current: 只要他们还在这里，我就不会离开。

rows.english: But there are other mines, and other slaves. We'll need their help, too.
rows.rawText: 但还有其他矿场和奴隶。我们也需要他们帮忙。
rows.current: 但还有其他矿场和奴隶。我们也需要他们帮忙。

rows.english: You must reach the other mines and rally them to war, Longtooth.
rows.rawText: 长牙，你必须赶到其他矿场，号召他们参战。
rows.current: 长牙，你必须赶到其他矿场，号召他们参战。

rows.english: I'll stay behind and free the others.
That's why you must spread word of our rebellion.
rows.rawText: 所以你必须把起义的消息传出去。
rows.current: 所以你必须把起义的消息传出去。

rows.english: We'll need all of the Wolf Clan's strength to win.
rows.rawText: 我们需要全族之力才能赢。
rows.current: 我们需要全族之力才能赢。

rows.english: Then I'll die as a warrior.
rows.rawText: 那我也要像战士一样死去。
rows.current: 那我也要像战士一样死去。

rows.english: And you're as fat as ever.
Throw off your chains, brothers! Your Clan is at war!
rows.rawText: 弟兄们，挣脱锁链！全族已经开战了！
rows.current: 弟兄们，挣脱锁链！全族已经开战了！

rows.english: Budo, you swine! You'll pay for this!
rows.rawText: 武堂，你这恶徒！你会付出代价的！
rows.current: 武堂，你这恶徒！你会付出代价的！

rows.rawText: 我可怜又愚昧的兄弟们……
rows.current: 我可怜又愚昧的兄弟们……

rows.english: I'm sorry I couldn't save you.
rows.rawText: 对不起，我没能救下你们。
rows.current: 对不起，我没能救下你们。

rows.english: Another wall of magic -- but there's no lever!
rows.rawText: 又是一道魔法墙，可这里没有拉杆！
rows.current: 又是一道魔法墙，可这里没有拉杆！

rows.english: It must be on the other side…
Maybe a Digger could tunnel beneath this barrier and find the controls.
rows.rawText: 也许掘地者能挖地道穿过这道屏障，找到控制机关。
rows.current: 也许掘地者能挖地道穿过这道屏障，找到控制机关。

rows.english: We've rescued a Digger! We'll be able to tunnel under obstacles now…
rows.rawText: 我们救出了一名掘地者！现在能从障碍物下挖过去了……
rows.current: 我们救出了一名掘地者！现在能从障碍物下挖过去了……

rows.english: A Sledger could break open this cell in no time…
rows.rawText: 巨槌工很快就能砸开这间牢房……
rows.current: 巨槌工很快就能砸开这间牢房……

rows.english: Everyone, run for the exit! We can't let the Lotus trap us here!
rows.rawText: 所有人，快跑向出口！不能让莲花族把我们困在这里！
rows.current: 所有人，快跑向出口！不能让莲花族把我们困在这里！

rows.english: Honor, from a Lotus? That would be a first.
rows.rawText: 莲花族也讲荣誉？这倒是头一回。
rows.current: 莲花族也讲荣誉？这倒是头一回。

rows.english: She's planning something. I must find another way out!
rows.rawText: 她在谋划什么。我得另找出口！
rows.current: 她在谋划什么。我得另找出口！

rows.english: It looks like this old air-shaft could be opened again.
rows.rawText: 这条旧通风井似乎还能重新打开。
rows.current: 这条旧通风井似乎还能重新打开。

rows.english: If only the Sledgers were at my side!
rows.rawText: 要是巨槌工们在我身边就好了！
rows.current: 要是巨槌工们在我身边就好了！

rows.english: I've never seen this part of the mine before…
rows.rawText: 这片矿坑我以前从没见过……
rows.current: 这片矿坑我以前从没见过……

rows.english: It's a hidden Shalery and some workers! Hail, Wolf brothers!
rows.rawText: 一间隐蔽的页岩工坊，还有工人！族中兄弟，你们好！
rows.current: 一间隐蔽的页岩工坊，还有工人！族中兄弟，你们好！

rows.english: This is a wonderful discovery -- I'll be able to forge armor with these tools.
rows.rawText: 发现得好！我可以用这些工具打造护甲。
rows.current: 发现得好！我可以用这些工具打造护甲。

rows.english: Excellent! With protection like this, I could take on the whole Lotus army!
rows.rawText: 好极了！有这身防护，我能对付整支莲花族军队！
rows.current: 好极了！有这身防护，我能对付整支莲花族军队！

rows.english: But we'll need to find more food in order to forge more armor.
rows.rawText: 但要打造更多护甲，还得找到更多食物。
rows.current: 但要打造更多护甲，还得找到更多食物。

rows.english: Damn, it's more of that noxious gas…we'll need to blaze a trail with fire.
rows.rawText: 该死，又是那种毒气……得用火烧出一条路。
rows.current: 该死，又是那种毒气……得用火烧出一条路。

rows.english: I don't see a lever anywhere…we'll need a Digger to tunnel under this barrier.
rows.rawText: 到处找不到拉杆……需要掘地者从屏障下面挖过去。
rows.current: 到处找不到拉杆……需要掘地者从屏障下面挖过去。

rows.english: We've spent seven years in these mines.
rows.rawText: 我们在这些矿坑里熬了七年。
rows.current: 我们在这些矿坑里熬了七年。

rows.english: No matter what happens, we will never wear chains again!
rows.rawText: 无论发生什么，我们再也不会戴上锁链！
rows.current: 无论发生什么，我们再也不会戴上锁链！

rows.english: We shouldn't give our Diggers Shale Armor…they'll be too bulky to dig!
rows.rawText: 别给掘地者穿页岩护甲……太笨重，挖不了地道！
rows.current: 别给掘地者穿页岩护甲……太笨重，挖不了地道！

rows.english: Not yet, but we have little time…
rows.rawText: 还没有，但我们没多少时间了……
rows.current: 还没有，但我们没多少时间了……

rows.english: Even now, Yvaine must be gathering her forces to wipe us out.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 现在肯定正集结部队，要消灭我们。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 现在肯定正集结部队，要消灭我们。

rows.english: Longtooth will bring reinforcements from the other shale mines.
rows.rawText: 长牙 会从其他页岩矿场带来援军。
rows.current: 长牙 会从其他页岩矿场带来援军。

rows.english: We must reach the signal tower above us.
rows.rawText: 我们必须赶到头顶的信号塔。
rows.current: 我们必须赶到头顶的信号塔。

rows.english: If our Pitch Slinger climbs that tower, Longtooth will see his flames and head straight for us.
rows.rawText: 让沥青投手爬上塔，长牙 就能看到火光，径直来找我们。
rows.current: 让沥青投手爬上塔，长牙 就能看到火光，径直来找我们。

rows.english: Be careful! We don't have any other way to light the signal fires.
rows.rawText: 小心！我们没别的办法点燃信号火。
rows.current: 小心！我们没别的办法点燃信号火。

rows.english: If you're killed by the Lotus, Longtooth will never reach us in time!
rows.rawText: 你若被莲花族杀了，长牙 就来不及救我们！
rows.current: 你若被莲花族杀了，长牙 就来不及救我们！

rows.english: That flame should be visible for miles around. Any sign of our allies?
rows.rawText: 几里外应该都看得见那团火。看见盟友了吗？
rows.current: 几里外应该都看得见那团火。看见盟友了吗？

rows.english: Longtooth has great courage...I knew he wouldn't fail us.
rows.rawText: 长牙 勇气过人……我就知道他不会让我们失望。
rows.current: 长牙 勇气过人……我就知道他不会让我们失望。

rows.english: Can you see anything else? We must know what Yvaine is planning.
rows.rawText: 还能看到什么？我们得弄清 伊薇恩 的打算。
rows.current: 还能看到什么？我们得弄清 伊薇恩 的打算。

rows.english: That's where Yvaine will be…and perhaps our sacred totem, as well.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 就在那里……也许我们的圣物图腾也在。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 就在那里……也许我们的圣物图腾也在。

rows.english: First we'll head southwest and free the slaves in the town.
rows.rawText: 先往西南走，救出镇里的奴隶。
rows.current: 先往西南走，救出镇里的奴隶。

rows.english: The Lotus will seek revenge for our victories -- nobody must be left behind.
rows.rawText: 莲花族会为我们的胜利报复，不能留下任何人。
rows.current: 莲花族会为我们的胜利报复，不能留下任何人。

rows.english: Then we'll tear into that fortress and get some answers from Yvaine!
rows.rawText: 接着攻进那座堡垒，找 伊薇恩 问个明白！
rows.current: 接着攻进那座堡垒，找 伊薇恩 问个明白！

rows.english: I haven't seen you in the mines, Wolf brother.
rows.rawText: 我在矿坑里没见过你，族中兄弟。
rows.current: 我在矿坑里没见过你，族中兄弟。

rows.english: You've been hunting the Lotus for all this time? Amazing!
rows.rawText: 你一直在猎杀莲花族？真了不起！
rows.current: 你一直在猎杀莲花族？真了不起！

rows.english: Will you fight with us, and help us restore the Wolf Clan's freedom?
rows.rawText: 你愿意与我们并肩作战，帮恶狼族重获自由吗？
rows.current: 你愿意与我们并肩作战，帮恶狼族重获自由吗？

rows.english: Then you're welcome at my side, friend Wildeye.
rows.rawText: 那就欢迎你加入我们，狂眼 朋友。
rows.current: 那就欢迎你加入我们，狂眼 朋友。

rows.english: Together, we'll show Yvaine the Wolf's vengeance!
rows.rawText: 让我们一起叫 伊薇恩 领教恶狼族的复仇！
rows.current: 让我们一起叫 伊薇恩 领教恶狼族的复仇！

rows.english: I can see the control lever from here, but only Longtooth could hit it from this distance!
rows.rawText: 我从这里看得见控制拉杆，可只有 长牙 能在这么远的地方打中它！
rows.current: 我从这里看得见控制拉杆，可只有 长牙 能在这么远的地方打中它！

rows.english: Yvaine has sealed the mountain pass to slow us down…we'll need blunt weapons to break through.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 封住了山口，想拖住我们……需要钝器才能破开。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 封住了山口，想拖住我们……需要钝器才能破开。

rows.english: With blunt weapons, we could shatter this rockfall and take Yvaine by surprise!
rows.rawText: 有了钝器，就能砸碎这堆落石，打 伊薇恩 一个措手不及！
rows.current: 有了钝器，就能砸碎这堆落石，打 伊薇恩 一个措手不及！

rows.rawText: 够了。你的恶行到此为止。
rows.current: 够了。你的恶行到此为止。

rows.english: No more riddles! What are you doing with the Skull?
rows.rawText: 别再打哑谜！你拿白狼之颅做什么？
rows.current: 别再打哑谜！你拿白狼之颅做什么？

rows.english: Our Pitch Slinger should climb this tower and signal to Longtooth…
rows.rawText: 该让沥青投手爬上塔，向 长牙 发信号……
rows.current: 该让沥青投手爬上塔，向 长牙 发信号……

rows.english: Without the Pitch Slinger's fires, we can't give Longtooth the signal!
rows.rawText: 没有沥青投手点火，就无法向 长牙 发信号！
rows.current: 没有沥青投手点火，就无法向 长牙 发信号！

rows.english: We'll defeat these murderous Witches and rescue Gaihla!
rows.rawText: 我们会击败那些杀人的女巫，救出 盖拉！
rows.current: 我们会击败那些杀人的女巫，救出 盖拉！

rows.english: Gaihla's still alive? Where are you keeping her?
rows.rawText: 盖拉 还活着？你们把她关在哪儿？
rows.current: 盖拉 还活着？你们把她关在哪儿？

rows.english: I'll ask you one more time -- where is Gaihla imprisoned?
rows.rawText: 我再问你一次——盖拉 被囚在哪里？
rows.current: 我再问你一次——盖拉 被囚在哪里？

rows.english: If you help us find her, I'll let you go.
rows.rawText: 帮我们找到她，我就放你走。
rows.current: 帮我们找到她，我就放你走。

rows.english: You disgust me. Get out of my sight.
rows.rawText: 你让我恶心。滚出我的视线。
rows.current: 你让我恶心。滚出我的视线。

rows.english: Wildeye, can you find this laboratory?
rows.rawText: 狂眼，你能找到那间实验室吗？
rows.current: 狂眼，你能找到那间实验室吗？

rows.english: The Forest Temple has been destroyed…we've failed to protect the Druidess Order.
rows.rawText: 森林神殿毁了……我们没能保护德鲁伊教团。
rows.current: 森林神殿毁了……我们没能保护德鲁伊教团。

rows.english: What? I didn't understand a word of that!
rows.rawText: 什么？我一个字也没听懂！
rows.current: 什么？我一个字也没听懂！

rows.english: Do you think she's been murdered?
rows.rawText: 你觉得她已经被杀了吗？
rows.current: 你觉得她已经被杀了吗？

rows.english: Then we've got to keep searching.
I'll head this way…you two keep scouting in the other direction.
rows.rawText: 我往这边走……你们俩去另一个方向侦察。
rows.current: 我往这边走……你们俩去另一个方向侦察。

rows.english: You weren't going to run from those things, were you?
rows.rawText: 你该不会想从那些东西面前逃跑吧？
rows.current: 你该不会想从那些东西面前逃跑吧？

rows.english: Let's get to a safer place. We have much to discuss.
rows.rawText: 找个安全点的地方。我们有很多事要谈。
rows.current: 找个安全点的地方。我们有很多事要谈。

rows.english: That monster sacrificed himself for us…
rows.rawText: 那个怪物为我们牺牲了……
rows.current: 那个怪物为我们牺牲了……

rows.english: We'll take him to our Keep, and try to revive him.
rows.rawText: 把他带回堡垒，试着救活他。
rows.current: 把他带回堡垒，试着救活他。

rows.english: The lake shore is just a little farther. Wildeye's meeting us there.
rows.rawText: 湖岸就在前面不远。狂眼 在那里等我们。
rows.current: 湖岸就在前面不远。狂眼 在那里等我们。

rows.english: Yvaine's blizzard is killing the land. As the land dies, so does Gaihla.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 的暴风雪正杀死这片土地。土地死去，盖拉 也会死。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 的暴风雪正杀死这片土地。土地死去，盖拉 也会死。

rows.english: Have you found any shelter nearby?
In other words, it's a trap.
We don't have much of a choice…let's check it out.
rows.rawText: 我们没多少选择……去看看吧。
rows.current: 我们没多少选择……去看看吧。

rows.english: Wildeye, take Gaihla around the south side of the lake, where it's safer.
rows.rawText: 狂眼，你带 盖拉 沿湖的南岸走，那边安全些。
rows.current: 狂眼，你带 盖拉 沿湖的南岸走，那边安全些。

rows.english: I'll scout out the main road and meet you at the Monastery.
rows.rawText: 我去侦察大路，在禅院与你们会合。
rows.current: 我去侦察大路，在禅院与你们会合。

rows.english: So you're behind this silly ambush.
rows.rawText: 原来这场拙劣的伏击是你安排的。
rows.current: 原来这场拙劣的伏击是你安排的。

rows.english: Who are you? You're not dressed like a Monk.
rows.rawText: 你是谁？你的衣着可不像僧侣。
rows.current: 你是谁？你的衣着可不像僧侣。

rows.english: Tao, will you help us destroy Yvaine?
rows.rawText: 道，你愿意帮我们除掉 伊薇恩 吗？
rows.current: 道，你愿意帮我们除掉 伊薇恩 吗？

rows.english: We've opened the gates! Rally to me, Wolves!
rows.rawText: 门打开了！恶狼族战士，到我身边集结！
rows.current: 门打开了！恶狼族战士，到我身边集结！

rows.english: That should take care of one of the barriers…
rows.rawText: 这样应该能除掉一道屏障……
rows.current: 这样应该能除掉一道屏障……

rows.english: The last barrier should be down -- let's move!
rows.rawText: 最后一道屏障也该消失了，前进！
rows.current: 最后一道屏障也该消失了，前进！

rows.english: Taro, this blizzard is Yvaine's sorcery -- we're also here to stop it.
rows.rawText: 太郎，这场暴风雪是 伊薇恩 的法术，我们也是来阻止它的。
rows.current: 太郎，这场暴风雪是 伊薇恩 的法术，我们也是来阻止它的。

rows.english: He's a pompous brat, but we shouldn't kill him -- his father is too powerful.
rows.rawText: 他是个自大的小鬼，但不能杀他，他父亲权势太大。
rows.current: 他是个自大的小鬼，但不能杀他，他父亲权势太大。

rows.english: I suppose there's no other way around the fool.
rows.rawText: 看来只有先对付这个蠢货了。
rows.current: 看来只有先对付这个蠢货了。

rows.english: When we've dealt with his Guardians, the Prince will listen more carefully!
rows.rawText: 收拾掉他的守卫后，王子就会认真听我们说话！
rows.current: 收拾掉他的守卫后，王子就会认真听我们说话！

rows.english: Go home to your father. Tell him the Wolf Clan didn't cause this blizzard.
rows.rawText: 回去见你父亲。告诉他这场暴风雪不是恶狼族造成的。
rows.current: 回去见你父亲。告诉他这场暴风雪不是恶狼族造成的。

rows.english: Let me put it this way: if I wanted war with the Serpent Empire, I'd kill you now.
rows.rawText: 这么说吧：我要是想和灵蛇族帝国开战，现在就会杀了你。
rows.current: 这么说吧：我要是想和灵蛇族帝国开战，现在就会杀了你。

rows.english: All I want is to settle our business with Yvaine before we all freeze to death.
rows.rawText: 我只想在大家冻死前了结和 伊薇恩 的恩怨。
rows.current: 我只想在大家冻死前了结和 伊薇恩 的恩怨。

rows.english: Why not let us pass, and tell your father that you stopped the blizzard yourself?
rows.rawText: 何不放我们过去，再告诉你父亲是你亲手止住了暴风雪？
rows.current: 何不放我们过去，再告诉你父亲是你亲手止住了暴风雪？

rows.english: Then you can tell Lord Oja that you slew the evil Wolf rebels single-handedly.
rows.rawText: 你还可以告诉 奥贾 领主，说你独自杀光了邪恶的恶狼族叛军。
rows.current: 你还可以告诉 奥贾 领主，说你独自杀光了邪恶的恶狼族叛军。

rows.english: If your brother has any wits at all, he'll outlive you, little Prince.
rows.rawText: 小王子，只要你弟弟还有点脑子，他就会比你活得久。
rows.current: 小王子，只要你弟弟还有点脑子，他就会比你活得久。

rows.english: That's one less den of snakes to trouble us.
rows.rawText: 又少了一个找我们麻烦的蛇窝。
rows.current: 又少了一个找我们麻烦的蛇窝。

rows.english: We'd better find the last Academy…Taro will discover our handiwork soon.
rows.rawText: 最好快找最后一座学院……太郎 很快会发现是我们干的。
rows.current: 最好快找最后一座学院……太郎 很快会发现是我们干的。

rows.english: I'm sure Yvaine knows that we've beaten Issyl, Koril and Taro.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 一定知道我们击败了 伊希尔、科里尔 和 太郎。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 一定知道我们击败了 伊希尔、科里尔 和 太郎。

rows.english: She'll be gathering her powers for the final battle.
rows.rawText: 她会积蓄力量，准备最后一战。
rows.current: 她会积蓄力量，准备最后一战。

rows.english: Either Yvaine or the Lord of the Wolves must die today.
rows.rawText: 今天，不是 伊薇恩 死，就是恶狼之主死。
rows.current: 今天，不是 伊薇恩 死，就是恶狼之主死。

rows.english: They'll fall when her towns are destroyed. She can't power them alone.
rows.rawText: 只要毁掉她的城镇，屏障就会倒下。她一个人供不了魔力。
rows.current: 只要毁掉她的城镇，屏障就会倒下。她一个人供不了魔力。

rows.english: Not if she intends to keep up this storm, as well.
rows.rawText: 更何况她还得维持这场暴风雪。
rows.current: 更何况她还得维持这场暴风雪。

rows.english: Even gods can die. Come on, we have work to do.
rows.rawText: 神也会死。走吧，还有事要做。
rows.current: 神也会死。走吧，还有事要做。

rows.english: You are...I'm going down there alone.
rows.rawText: 你们会……我要一个人下去。
rows.current: 你们会……我要一个人下去。

rows.english: I don't know if we can beat Yvaine -- not when she's using that totem.
rows.rawText: 她掌握着那个图腾，我不知道我们能不能打败 伊薇恩。
rows.current: 她掌握着那个图腾，我不知道我们能不能打败 伊薇恩。

rows.english: If I can win this fight, I will.
rows.rawText: 如果能赢，我会赢下这一战。
rows.current: 如果能赢，我会赢下这一战。

rows.english: If I am fated to die, you two must survive to rule the Wolves.
rows.rawText: 如果我命中注定要死，你们俩必须活下来，统领恶狼族。
rows.current: 如果我命中注定要死，你们俩必须活下来，统领恶狼族。

rows.english: Between your instincts and Longtooth's wits, I'm sure our Clan will survive.
rows.rawText: 靠你的直觉和 长牙 的头脑，我们一族一定能存续。
rows.current: 靠你的直觉和 长牙 的头脑，我们一族一定能存续。

rows.english: We've disabled the first set of barriers…
We must press our attack to the towns above!
rows.rawText: 必须继续进攻上方的城镇！
rows.current: 必须继续进攻上方的城镇！

rows.english: Another of Yvaine's barriers has fallen.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 的又一道屏障倒下了。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 的又一道屏障倒下了。

rows.english: That should take care of another barrier.
rows.rawText: 这样又能除掉一道屏障。
rows.current: 这样又能除掉一道屏障。

rows.english: We've opened a path to Yvaine's fortress! We must hurry!
rows.rawText: 通往 伊薇恩 堡垒的路打开了！快走！
rows.current: 通往 伊薇恩 堡垒的路打开了！快走！

rows.english: All right, Yvaine…where are you hiding?
rows.rawText: 好了，伊薇恩……你躲在哪儿？
rows.current: 好了，伊薇恩……你躲在哪儿？

rows.english: The enslavement, the war, the winter…all of your evils are about to end.
rows.rawText: 奴役、战争、严冬……你的所有恶行就要结束了。
rows.current: 奴役、战争、严冬……你的所有恶行就要结束了。

rows.english: The White Wolf's Skull has destroyed your mind, Yvaine.
rows.rawText: 白狼之颅毁掉了你的心智，伊薇恩。
rows.current: 白狼之颅毁掉了你的心智，伊薇恩。

rows.english: Killing you will be an act of mercy.
rows.rawText: 杀了你，也是对你的仁慈。
rows.current: 杀了你，也是对你的仁慈。

rows.english: You still have a lot to learn, my friend!
rows.rawText: 朋友，你要学的还多着呢！
rows.current: 朋友，你要学的还多着呢！

rows.english: Thank you for believing in me.
When Yvaine died, she unleashed the full power of the White Wolf's Skull.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 死时，释放了白狼之颅的全部力量。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 死时，释放了白狼之颅的全部力量。

rows.english: I thought the explosion would destroy us both, but I didn't feel any pain at all.
rows.rawText: 我以为爆炸会把我们俩都毁掉，可我一点也没觉得疼。
rows.current: 我以为爆炸会把我们俩都毁掉，可我一点也没觉得疼。

rows.english: Yvaine and the corrupted totem are nothing but ashes now.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 和被腐化的图腾如今只剩灰烬。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 和被腐化的图腾如今只剩灰烬。

rows.english: It was not my destiny to die today.
rows.rawText: 今天还不是我命尽之时。
rows.current: 今天还不是我命尽之时。

rows.english: When he does, the Wolves will be ready for him.
rows.rawText: 等他真来了，恶狼族已做好准备。
rows.current: 等他真来了，恶狼族已做好准备。

rows.english: Long ago, life was better for the Wolf Clan.
rows.rawText: 很久以前，恶狼族过着更好的生活。
rows.current: 很久以前，恶狼族过着更好的生活。

rows.english: Our ancestors lived on a faraway island, in peace and harmony.
rows.rawText: 我们的祖先住在遥远的岛上，安宁和睦。
rows.current: 我们的祖先住在遥远的岛上，安宁和睦。

rows.english: They took care of the land, and the land gave them everything they needed.
rows.rawText: 他们照料土地，土地也供给他们所需的一切。
rows.current: 他们照料土地，土地也供给他们所需的一切。

rows.english: …until the storms came, and drowned our paradise.
rows.rawText: ……直到风暴到来，淹没了我们的家园。
rows.current: ……直到风暴到来，淹没了我们的家园。

rows.english: Our ancestors' simple magic was powerless to stop the destruction.
rows.rawText: 祖先那点简单的法术，根本无法阻止灾难。
rows.current: 祖先那点简单的法术，根本无法阻止灾难。

rows.english: They knew only that they had to flee…or perish.
rows.rawText: 他们只知道必须逃走……否则就会灭亡。
rows.current: 他们只知道必须逃走……否则就会灭亡。

rows.english: They never understood the disaster that almost destroyed them.
rows.rawText: 他们始终不明白，那场几乎灭绝全族的灾难从何而来。
rows.current: 他们始终不明白，那场几乎灭绝全族的灾难从何而来。

rows.english: Half a world away, the Serpent Clan's founder used his Orb to reshape the world.
rows.rawText: 在世界的另一端，灵蛇族的创始人用宝珠重塑了世界。
rows.current: 在世界的另一端，灵蛇族的创始人用宝珠重塑了世界。

rows.english: That act of desperation disrupted the balance of nature, and doomed our home.
rows.rawText: 那绝望的一举打乱了自然平衡，也注定让我们的家园覆灭。
rows.current: 那绝望的一举打乱了自然平衡，也注定让我们的家园覆灭。

rows.english: But how could our forefathers have imagined the source of their troubles?
rows.rawText: 可祖先怎么可能想得到，祸端竟在那里？
rows.current: 可祖先怎么可能想得到，祸端竟在那里？

rows.english: And how could they guess where their desperate prayers would take them?
rows.rawText: 他们又怎能料到，走投无路时的祈祷会把自己带向何方？
rows.current: 他们又怎能料到，走投无路时的祈祷会把自己带向何方？

rows.english: Using our clan's most sacred totem, the White Wolf's Skull, our Druidess Order rescued us from death.
rows.rawText: 德鲁伊教团借助族中最神圣的图腾——白狼之颅，将我们从死亡边缘救了回来。
rows.current: 德鲁伊教团借助族中最神圣的图腾——白狼之颅，将我们从死亡边缘救了回来。

rows.english: The totem brought us here, to the lands of the Serpent Empire.
rows.rawText: 图腾把我们带到了这里，带到了灵蛇帝国的土地上。
rows.current: 图腾把我们带到了这里，带到了灵蛇帝国的土地上。

rows.english: Thankful for our salvation, we rebuilt our towns and our lives.
rows.rawText: 劫后余生，我们满怀感激，重建城镇，重新安顿生活。
rows.current: 劫后余生，我们满怀感激，重建城镇，重新安顿生活。

rows.english: Our new neighbors, the devious Serpent and cold-hearted Lotus, welcomed us as allies and promised us safety.
rows.rawText: 新邻居——狡诈的灵蛇族与冷酷的莲花族——欢迎我们结盟，并许诺庇护。
rows.current: 新邻居——狡诈的灵蛇族与冷酷的莲花族——欢迎我们结盟，并许诺庇护。

rows.english: For generations, our Clan tried to return to the simple life it left behind.
rows.rawText: 几代人以来，族人一直想找回昔日那种简单的生活。
rows.current: 几代人以来，族人一直想找回昔日那种简单的生活。

rows.english: Our numbers slowly recovered, and our villages grew and thrived.
rows.rawText: 人口慢慢恢复，村庄也日渐繁盛。
rows.current: 人口慢慢恢复，村庄也日渐繁盛。

rows.english: Everything seemed simple and good again…
rows.rawText: 一切仿佛又简单而美好……
rows.current: 一切仿佛又简单而美好……

rows.english: Until a new disaster broke over our people -- a disaster of betrayal and fire.
rows.rawText: 直到另一场灾难降临族人：背叛与烈火。
rows.current: 直到另一场灾难降临族人：背叛与烈火。

rows.english: Lord Zymeth of the Lotus Clan made a deal with the treacherous Serpent emperor, and attacked us by surprise.
rows.rawText: 莲花族的 齐梅斯 领主与背信弃义的灵蛇族皇帝勾结，突然向我们发起进攻。
rows.current: 莲花族的 齐梅斯 领主与背信弃义的灵蛇族皇帝勾结，突然向我们发起进攻。

rows.english: The Serpent looked the other way as the Lotus slaughtered our farmers and burned our homes.
rows.rawText: 灵蛇族袖手旁观，任凭莲花族屠杀农夫、焚烧家园。
rows.current: 灵蛇族袖手旁观，任凭莲花族屠杀农夫、焚烧家园。

rows.english: Like the rest of my brothers, I fought to save our Clan, and I could not.
rows.rawText: 我和所有兄弟一样，为拯救族人而战，却没能做到。
rows.current: 我和所有兄弟一样，为拯救族人而战，却没能做到。

rows.english: The survivors of that battle have been slaves in the Lotus shale mines ever since.
rows.rawText: 那一战的幸存者从此沦为奴隶，被关进莲花族的页岩矿场。
rows.current: 那一战的幸存者从此沦为奴隶，被关进莲花族的页岩矿场。

rows.english: For seven years, we've worked and died to make the Lotus wealthy.
rows.rawText: 七年来，我们拼命劳作、接连死去，只为让莲花族富有。
rows.current: 七年来，我们拼命劳作、接连死去，只为让莲花族富有。

rows.english: The Lotus slavemaster, Mistress Yvaine, rules our Clan through fear.
rows.rawText: 奴隶主 伊薇恩 女主人靠恐惧统治我们一族。
rows.current: 奴隶主 伊薇恩 女主人靠恐惧统治我们一族。

rows.english: She believes we have lost the ability to dream of freedom.
rows.rawText: 她以为我们连向往自由的念头都失去了。
rows.current: 她以为我们连向往自由的念头都失去了。

rows.english: I am Grayback, last heir to the Wolf Clan's throne.
rows.rawText: 我是灰背，恶狼族王位最后的继承人。
rows.current: 我是灰背，恶狼族王位最后的继承人。

rows.english: For seven years, I've trained my fellow miners in the arts of war.
rows.rawText: 七年来，我一直训练矿工同伴，教他们战斗。
rows.current: 七年来，我一直训练矿工同伴，教他们战斗。

rows.english: Hammers, picks and stones are our weapons…those, and our unending anger.
rows.rawText: 锤子、镐头和石块就是我们的武器……还有永不止息的怒火。
rows.current: 锤子、镐头和石块就是我们的武器……还有永不止息的怒火。

rows.english: A third disaster is coming -- a disaster for the murderers who dared to cross us.
rows.rawText: 第三场灾难即将来临，这一次，灾难要落在胆敢迫害我们的凶手头上。
rows.current: 第三场灾难即将来临，这一次，灾难要落在胆敢迫害我们的凶手头上。

rows.english: Soon, the Wolf Clan will rise again.
rows.rawText: 恶狼族很快就会再度崛起。
rows.current: 恶狼族很快就会再度崛起。

rows.english: It is the Skull of the White Wolf -- a relic of our clan's guardian spirit.
rows.rawText: 那是白狼之颅，是我们一族守护神灵的遗物。
rows.current: 那是白狼之颅，是我们一族守护神灵的遗物。

rows.english: Until our war against the Lotus, it was our greatest treasure.
rows.rawText: 在与莲花族开战之前，它一直是我们最珍贵的宝物。
rows.current: 在与莲花族开战之前，它一直是我们最珍贵的宝物。

rows.english: Only Gaihla and her Druidess Order knew how to harness its powers.
rows.rawText: 只有 盖拉 和她的德鲁伊教团懂得驾驭它的力量。
rows.current: 只有 盖拉 和她的德鲁伊教团懂得驾驭它的力量。

rows.english: If they were alive, maybe they could tell us how to stop the Totem.
rows.rawText: 如果她们还活着，或许能告诉我们如何阻止图腾。
rows.current: 如果她们还活着，或许能告诉我们如何阻止图腾。

rows.english: But they died in the final battle.
rows.rawText: 可她们死在最后一战了。
rows.current: 可她们死在最后一战了。

rows.english: Gather the troops -- we're leaving at once.

rows.rawText: 你说得对……最好继续赶路。
rows.current: 你说得对……最好继续赶路。

rows.english: Any enemy of the Lotus is welcome in my camp.
rows.rawText: 任何莲花族的敌人都可以来我的营地。
rows.current: 任何莲花族的敌人都可以来我的营地。

rows.english: The Shale Lord fights with us.
rows.rawText: 页岩领主与我们并肩作战。
rows.current: 页岩领主与我们并肩作战。

rows.english: Then I'll take the Skull of the White Wolf from her.
rows.rawText: 那我就从她手里夺回白狼之颅。
rows.current: 那我就从她手里夺回白狼之颅。

rows.english: Yvaine will expect me…I won't ask any of you to follow me into her traps.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 会料到我来……我不会要求你们跟我走进她的陷阱。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 会料到我来……我不会要求你们跟我走进她的陷阱。

rows.english: You don't have to call me that…
Yvaine's had me locked in this stinking cell for days.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 把我关在这间臭牢房里好几天了。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 把我关在这间臭牢房里好几天了。

rows.english: A few more seconds and I would've been torn to shreds!
rows.rawText: 再晚几秒，我就要被撕成碎片了！
rows.current: 再晚几秒，我就要被撕成碎片了！

rows.english: You can count on me always, my Lord!
rows.rawText: 我永远听您差遣，领主大人！
rows.current: 我永远听您差遣，领主大人！

rows.rawText: 我们打败她了，领主大人！
rows.current: 我们打败她了，领主大人！

rows.english: We've almost reached the main tunnels, Grayback.
rows.rawText: 灰背，我们快到主隧道了。
rows.current: 灰背，我们快到主隧道了。

rows.english: Watch out -- I've seen that gas before.
rows.rawText: 小心，我以前见过那种气体。
rows.current: 小心，我以前见过那种气体。

rows.english: It seeps up from the rocks, and can kill a man in seconds.
rows.rawText: 它从岩缝里渗出来，几秒钟就能要人命。
rows.current: 它从岩缝里渗出来，几秒钟就能要人命。

rows.english: We can't give up…there must be a way around this barrier.
rows.rawText: 不能放弃……总有办法绕过这道屏障。
rows.current: 不能放弃……总有办法绕过这道屏障。

rows.english: You'll never beat Yvaine by yourself!
rows.rawText: 你一个人绝打不过 伊薇恩！
rows.current: 你一个人绝打不过 伊薇恩！

rows.english: And if we return to find you dead…
rows.rawText: 要是我们回来时发现你已经死了……
rows.current: 要是我们回来时发现你已经死了……

rows.english: The other mines will be free before the Lotus know what hit them.
rows.rawText: 等莲花族反应过来，其他矿场早就重获自由了。
rows.current: 等莲花族反应过来，其他矿场早就重获自由了。

rows.english: Looks like there's some kind of commotion in the town…
rows.rawText: 镇上好像出了什么乱子……
rows.current: 镇上好像出了什么乱子……

rows.english: The Serpent Witches are famous practitioners of black magic.
rows.rawText: 灵蛇族女巫以黑魔法闻名。
rows.current: 灵蛇族女巫以黑魔法闻名。

rows.english: I'm not surprised they're doing Yvaine's dirty work.
rows.rawText: 她们替 伊薇恩 干脏活，我一点也不意外。
rows.current: 她们替 伊薇恩 干脏活，我一点也不意外。

rows.english: Looks like the end of the road.
Looks like she's set up plenty of those magic walls to slow us down.
rows.rawText: 看来她设了不少魔法墙来拖住我们。
rows.current: 看来她设了不少魔法墙来拖住我们。

rows.english: She wields the powers of a god…I don't think it'll be that easy.
rows.rawText: 她掌握着神一般的力量……我看没那么容易。
rows.current: 她掌握着神一般的力量……我看没那么容易。

rows.english: I thought I was finished with filthy, Lotus-smelling caves.
rows.rawText: 我还以为再也不用钻进这种满是莲花族臭味的洞穴了。
rows.current: 我还以为再也不用钻进这种满是莲花族臭味的洞穴了。

rows.english: You want me to share a throne with this maniac?
rows.rawText: 你要我和这个疯子共享王位？
rows.current: 你要我和这个疯子共享王位？

rows.english: You'd better come back alive, Grayback.
Wait…are those Serpent troops at the bottom of the mountain?
rows.rawText: 等等……山脚下那些是灵蛇族部队吗？
rows.current: 等等……山脚下那些是灵蛇族部队吗？

rows.english: More Serpent troops are climbing the mountain! We must reach Yvaine!
rows.rawText: 更多灵蛇族部队正在上山！我们必须赶到 伊薇恩 那里！
rows.current: 更多灵蛇族部队正在上山！我们必须赶到 伊薇恩 那里！

rows.english: I'm telling you, Grayback's in trouble!
rows.rawText: 我告诉你们，灰背有麻烦了！
rows.current: 我告诉你们，灰背有麻烦了！

rows.english: We've got to go after him!
But he can't do this alone! He needs us!
rows.rawText: 可他不能独自应付！他需要我们！
rows.current: 可他不能独自应付！他需要我们！

rows.english: They don't have to be his last orders!
…I guess he didn't need us after all…
I should have gone after him…
I knew you'd make it, Lord!
rows.rawText: 我就知道您能做到，领主大人！
rows.current: 我就知道您能做到，领主大人！

rows.english: He won't try soon! We must have slain half his army on this mountain.
rows.rawText: 他短时间内不敢再来！我们在这座山上杀了他半支军队。
rows.current: 他短时间内不敢再来！我们在这座山上杀了他半支军队。

rows.english: The Totem must be very powerful to create such a storm.
rows.rawText: 图腾一定极其强大，才能引发这样的暴风雪。
rows.current: 图腾一定极其强大，才能引发这样的暴风雪。

rows.english: Do you think Gaihla could help us, Wildeye?
rows.rawText: 狂眼，你觉得 盖拉 能帮我们吗？
rows.current: 狂眼，你觉得 盖拉 能帮我们吗？

rows.english: If Gaihla can't stop this storm, we'll join him soon enough.
rows.rawText: 如果 盖拉 也止不住这场风雪，我们很快就会去陪他。
rows.current: 如果 盖拉 也止不住这场风雪，我们很快就会去陪他。

rows.english: Yes, but can we trust what he's become?
rows.rawText: 是啊，但我们还能相信现在的他吗？
rows.current: 是啊，但我们还能相信现在的他吗？

rows.english: Gaihla, the weather is getting worse.
Can you help us stop Yvaine's winter?
rows.rawText: 你能帮我们阻止 伊薇恩 带来的严冬吗？
rows.current: 你能帮我们阻止 伊薇恩 带来的严冬吗？

rows.english: Why would any of us abandon you now, Lord Grayback?
rows.rawText: 灰背领主，我们怎么会在这时候弃您而去？
rows.current: 灰背领主，我们怎么会在这时候弃您而去？

rows.english: There's no way we can fight off an army!
rows.rawText: 我们根本挡不住一支大军！
rows.current: 我们根本挡不住一支大军！

rows.english: But how will he find us?
I'm sorry, Grayback, but you'll never win against the Lotus.
rows.rawText: 灰背，恕我直言，你斗不过莲花族。
rows.current: 灰背，恕我直言，你斗不过莲花族。

rows.english: You offer us nothing but death…and Budo offered us food.
rows.rawText: 你给我们的只有死路……武堂至少给我们米。
rows.current: 你给我们的只有死路……武堂至少给我们米。

rows.english: Please don't take me back to the cage!

rows.rawText: 我们的首领来了！谢谢你，灰背！
rows.current: 我们的首领来了！谢谢你，灰背！

rows.english: Grayback, we thought you were dead!
rows.rawText: 灰背，我们还以为你死了！
rows.current: 灰背，我们还以为你死了！

rows.english: Wait…there's someone approaching from the East…
rows.rawText: 等等……有人正从东边过来……
rows.current: 等等……有人正从东边过来……

rows.english: Yes, it's Longtooth! And there's a whole army of Wolves behind him!
rows.rawText: 对，是 长牙！他身后还有一整支恶狼族大军！
rows.current: 对，是 长牙！他身后还有一整支恶狼族大军！

rows.english: There's a small town in the southwest…I see slaves in the fields.
rows.rawText: 西南边有座小镇……我看到奴隶在田里干活。
rows.current: 西南边有座小镇……我看到奴隶在田里干活。

rows.english: And there's a great fortress in the southeast, blocking a pass through the mountains.
rows.rawText: 东南边还有一座大堡垒，堵住了穿过群山的隘口。
rows.current: 东南边还有一座大堡垒，堵住了穿过群山的隘口。

rows.english: Since Budo started ordering us around, I've hardly eaten a thing!
rows.rawText: 武堂开始使唤我们以后，我都没能好好进食！
rows.current: 武堂开始使唤我们以后，我都没能好好进食！

rows.english: Do you think Mistress Yvaine is starting to trust us, Grayback?
rows.rawText: 你觉得 伊薇恩 女主人开始信任我们了吗，灰背？
rows.current: 你觉得 伊薇恩 女主人开始信任我们了吗，灰背？

rows.english: Ha! Fighting's the easiest thing in the world!
rows.rawText: 哈！打仗是世上最容易的事！
rows.current: 哈！打仗是世上最容易的事！

rows.english: It's pretending to be weak that's driving me crazy!
rows.rawText: 装作软弱才快把我逼疯了！
rows.current: 装作软弱才快把我逼疯了！

rows.english: Yeah, but what about our dinner?
rows.rawText: 是啊，可我们的晚饭怎么办？
rows.current: 是啊，可我们的晚饭怎么办？

rows.english: I can't! I'm so hungry, I'm about to fall over!
rows.rawText: 不行！我饿得快要倒下了！
rows.current: 不行！我饿得快要倒下了！

rows.english: Look at this, Grayback! It's amazing!

rows.rawText: 是 伊薇恩 女主人！
rows.current: 是 伊薇恩 女主人！

rows.english: Don't hurt us! Budo told us there was shale down here!
rows.rawText: 别伤害我们！武堂说这里有页岩！
rows.current: 别伤害我们！武堂说这里有页岩！

rows.english: We didn't touch your magic stuff...promise!
rows.rawText: 我们没碰你那些魔法玩意儿……我保证！
rows.current: 我们没碰你那些魔法玩意儿……我保证！

rows.english: This isn't an ordinary punishment, Grayback!
rows.rawText: 灰背，这可不是普通的惩罚！
rows.current: 灰背，这可不是普通的惩罚！

rows.english: I have a bad feeling about this…
We heard fighting, but we couldn't open the gate!
rows.rawText: 我们听见打斗声，可打不开大门！
rows.current: 我们听见打斗声，可打不开大门！

rows.english: The Lotus have a bunch of these rice bins stashed down here.
rows.rawText: 莲花族在下面藏了好多这样的米仓。
rows.current: 莲花族在下面藏了好多这样的米仓。

rows.english: Free us, and we'll bust 'em open for you!
rows.rawText: 放我们出去，我们就替你把它们砸开！
rows.current: 放我们出去，我们就替你把它们砸开！

rows.english: So the trappers were trapped, and the murderers slain!
rows.rawText: 捕人的落了陷阱，杀人的也被杀了！
rows.current: 捕人的落了陷阱，杀人的也被杀了！

rows.english: Congratulations, Grayback, on a battle well fought!
I am both Monk and Ninja. Half Light, half Darkness.
rows.rawText: 我既是武僧，也是忍者；一半是光，一半是暗。
rows.current: 我既是武僧，也是忍者；一半是光，一半是暗。

rows.english: I serve Yin and Yang, and the Balance of all things.
rows.rawText: 我侍奉阴阳，也守护万物的平衡。
rows.current: 我侍奉阴阳，也守护万物的平衡。

rows.english: At the moment, the Yin of the Lotus is very strong -- it threatens the land itself.
rows.rawText: 如今莲花族的阴气过盛，连这片土地都受到威胁。
rows.current: 如今莲花族的阴气过盛，连这片土地都受到威胁。

rows.english: By protecting this Monastery, I strengthen the Yang and serve the Balance.
rows.rawText: 守住这座禅院，就能增强阳气，维系平衡。
rows.current: 守住这座禅院，就能增强阳气，维系平衡。

rows.english: The Monks were not harmed, and Grayback's heroes arrived safely.
rows.rawText: 僧侣们毫发无伤，灰背的英雄也平安抵达。
rows.current: 僧侣们毫发无伤，灰背的英雄也平安抵达。

rows.english: I think I protected them very well!
Yvaine owes her blood to the Lord of the Wolves. It is not mine to spill.
rows.rawText: 伊薇恩 该向恶狼之主偿命。这血不该由我来索取。
rows.current: 伊薇恩 该向恶狼之主偿命。这血不该由我来索取。

rows.english: But I am a master of roads and journeys, and I can help you reach your goal.
rows.rawText: 不过，我精通行路之道，能助你抵达目的地。
rows.current: 不过，我精通行路之道，能助你抵达目的地。

rows.english: Listen closely, and I will give you the secrets you need…
rows.rawText: 听好了，我这就把其中的诀窍传授给你……
rows.current: 听好了，我这就把其中的诀窍传授给你……

rows.english: The road to Yvaine is blocked by two magical gateways.
rows.rawText: 通往 伊薇恩 的路被两道魔法门挡住了。
rows.current: 通往 伊薇恩 的路被两道魔法门挡住了。

rows.english: These are maintained by a pair of rival archmages, Issyl and Koril.
rows.rawText: 维持它们的是一对相互敌视的大法师：伊希尔 和 科里尔。
rows.current: 维持它们的是一对相互敌视的大法师：伊希尔 和 科里尔。

rows.english: Issyl and Koril despise each other. They never cooperate on anything.
rows.rawText: 伊希尔 和 科里尔 彼此憎恨，从不联手。
rows.current: 伊希尔 和 科里尔 彼此憎恨，从不联手。

rows.english: If you defeat them both quickly, you'll slip right through their gates.
rows.rawText: 只要迅速击败两人，你就能穿过他们的门。
rows.current: 只要迅速击败两人，你就能穿过他们的门。

rows.english: But beware! If you kill only Issyl, then Koril will take control of his armies.
rows.rawText: 但要小心！如果只杀了 伊希尔，科里尔 就会接管他的军队。
rows.current: 但要小心！如果只杀了 伊希尔，科里尔 就会接管他的军队。
