rows.english: Likewise, Issyl would be quick to take advantage of Koril's demise.
rows.rawText: 反过来，伊希尔 也会趁 科里尔 死后夺取他的势力。
rows.current: 反过来，伊希尔 也会趁 科里尔 死后夺取他的势力。

rows.english: Either way, if you let them combine their forces, you're in for a tough fight!
rows.rawText: 无论哪边，只要让他们合兵，你就有一场硬仗要打！
rows.current: 无论哪边，只要让他们合兵，你就有一场硬仗要打！

rows.english: Now, I must depart. The Balance calls me to other lands.
rows.rawText: 现在我得走了。平衡召唤我前往别处。
rows.current: 现在我得走了。平衡召唤我前往别处。

rows.english: Fight well, Grayback! We both have unfinished duties in this world!
rows.rawText: 好好战斗，灰背！我们在这世上都还有使命未竟！
rows.current: 好好战斗，灰背！我们在这世上都还有使命未竟！

rows.english: Now I'll never avenge my murdered family…
rows.rawText: 现在我永远无法替惨死的家人报仇了……
rows.current: 现在我永远无法替惨死的家人报仇了……

rows.english: Pain, eh? I could show you a thing or two about that…
rows.rawText: 疼，是吗？我倒可以让你见识见识什么叫疼……
rows.current: 疼，是吗？我倒可以让你见识见识什么叫疼……

rows.english: Aye, it's good to see a friendly face around here.
rows.rawText: 哈，总算在这儿遇上个友善的人了。
rows.current: 哈，总算在这儿遇上个友善的人了。

rows.english: I'm a Wolf, all right, but I've never been in those stinking mines.
rows.rawText: 我当然是恶狼族的人，可我从没进过那些臭矿坑。
rows.current: 我当然是恶狼族的人，可我从没进过那些臭矿坑。

rows.english: My allies in the forest kept me well-hidden after the war.
rows.rawText: 战后，我在森林里的盟友一直把我藏得很好。
rows.current: 战后，我在森林里的盟友一直把我藏得很好。

rows.english: The Lotus destroyed my family and my home, but they couldn't catch Wildeye!
rows.rawText: 莲花族毁了我的家和家人，却没抓住 狂眼！
rows.current: 莲花族毁了我的家和家人，却没抓住 狂眼！

rows.english: I've been stalking and killing those devils ever since.
rows.rawText: 从那时起，我就在追杀那些恶魔。
rows.current: 从那时起，我就在追杀那些恶魔。

rows.english: Are you kidding? I've waited seven years to hear those words!
rows.rawText: 你开玩笑吧？我等这句话等了七年！
rows.current: 你开玩笑吧？我等这句话等了七年！

rows.english: You're the one who's dying today, witch!
Seven years ago, you murdered my mate and my cubs.
rows.rawText: 七年前，你杀了我的伴侣和孩子。
rows.current: 七年前，你杀了我的伴侣和孩子。

rows.english: But you wouldn't remember that, would you?
rows.rawText: 不过你想必不记得了，对吧？
rows.current: 不过你想必不记得了，对吧？

rows.english: We're too late! How could the Lotus have beaten us here?
rows.rawText: 我们来晚了！莲花族怎么会抢在我们前面？
rows.current: 我们来晚了！莲花族怎么会抢在我们前面？

rows.english: What? Gaihla's Sanctuary has frozen over?
rows.rawText: 什么？盖拉 的圣所被冻住了？
rows.current: 什么？盖拉 的圣所被冻住了？

rows.english: But Gaihla's magic has always protected her lands from the winter…
rows.rawText: 可 盖拉 的法术一直保护着她的领地，不受严冬侵袭……
rows.current: 可 盖拉 的法术一直保护着她的领地，不受严冬侵袭……

rows.english: Kill you? We thought we'd turn you over to the Dryads.
rows.rawText: 杀你？我们打算把你交给树妖。
rows.current: 杀你？我们打算把你交给树妖。

rows.english: They're sure they can talk you into changing your evil ways.
rows.rawText: 她们很有把握劝你改邪归正。
rows.current: 她们很有把握劝你改邪归正。

rows.english: And they're willing to spend a long, long time doing it…
rows.rawText: 而且她们愿意花很久、很久来劝……
rows.current: 而且她们愿意花很久、很久来劝……

rows.english: My wolves can find anything. Let's go!
rows.rawText: 我的狼什么都找得到。走吧！
rows.current: 我的狼什么都找得到。走吧！

rows.rawText: ……不知道 宇多罗 说的“畸形怪物”是什么意思……
rows.current: ……不知道 宇多罗 说的“畸形怪物”是什么意思……

rows.english: He's saying the same thing my wolves tell me…that Gaihla's trail ends here.
rows.rawText: 他说的和我的狼告诉我的一样……盖拉 的踪迹到这里就断了。
rows.current: 他说的和我的狼告诉我的一样……盖拉 的踪迹到这里就断了。

rows.english: No, the wolves would smell her blood.
rows.rawText: 不会，狼会闻到她的血味。
rows.current: 不会，狼会闻到她的血味。

rows.english: Huh? Where did this Wolf Clansman come from?
rows.rawText: 咦？这个恶狼族人是从哪儿冒出来的？
rows.current: 咦？这个恶狼族人是从哪儿冒出来的？

rows.english: I'd better stalk these two and see if they lead me to Gaihla.
rows.rawText: 我得跟着这两个人，看看他们会不会带我找到 盖拉。
rows.current: 我得跟着这两个人，看看他们会不会带我找到 盖拉。

rows.english: Can't let them see me, or I'll never find out where they're heading!
rows.rawText: 不能让他们发现我，不然我就查不出他们要去哪儿了！
rows.current: 不能让他们发现我，不然我就查不出他们要去哪儿了！

rows.english: Curses…we've lost them! Now we'll never find Gaihla!
rows.rawText: 该死……跟丢了！这下永远找不到 盖拉 了！
rows.current: 该死……跟丢了！这下永远找不到 盖拉 了！

rows.english: There's nothing here. Are they mad?
rows.rawText: 这里什么都没有。他们疯了吗？
rows.current: 这里什么都没有。他们疯了吗？

rows.english: Unbelievable! The Lotus have built themselves an invisible town!
rows.rawText: 不可思议！莲花族竟然建了一座隐形城镇！
rows.current: 不可思议！莲花族竟然建了一座隐形城镇！

rows.english: I'll bet my mustache that Gaihla's down there somewhere.
rows.rawText: 我敢拿胡子打赌，盖拉 就在下面某处。
rows.current: 我敢拿胡子打赌，盖拉 就在下面某处。

rows.english: You're right...what if this place disappears again?
rows.rawText: 你说得对……要是这地方又消失了呢？
rows.current: 你说得对……要是这地方又消失了呢？

rows.english: I bet that magic tower is what makes this town invisible.
rows.rawText: 我猜是那座魔法塔让镇子隐形的。
rows.current: 我猜是那座魔法塔让镇子隐形的。

rows.english: If only we could destroy it before the Lotus can use it again…
rows.rawText: 要是能赶在莲花族再次启动它之前毁掉它就好了……
rows.current: 要是能赶在莲花族再次启动它之前毁掉它就好了……

rows.english: Good idea! If we roll boulders onto their buildings, they'll panic for sure!
rows.rawText: 好主意！把巨石滚到他们的房子上，他们准会慌了手脚！
rows.current: 好主意！把巨石滚到他们的房子上，他们准会慌了手脚！

rows.english: That'll buy enough time for Grayback to hear the commotion and find us.
rows.rawText: 这样灰背就有时间听见动静，找到我们。
rows.current: 这样灰背就有时间听见动静，找到我们。

rows.english: What in the world is that thing? It's monstrous!
rows.rawText: 那到底是什么东西？简直是怪物！
rows.current: 那到底是什么东西？简直是怪物！

rows.english: Gah! We've been surrounded by more of those disgusting monsters!
rows.rawText: 啊！更多恶心的怪物把我们包围了！
rows.current: 啊！更多恶心的怪物把我们包围了！

rows.english: We can't let them stop us…it's time to roll some rocks!
rows.rawText: 别让它们拦住我们……该滚石头了！
rows.current: 别让它们拦住我们……该滚石头了！

rows.english: Hey, it seems to be attacking that magic tower!
rows.rawText: 嘿，它好像在攻击那座魔法塔！
rows.current: 嘿，它好像在攻击那座魔法塔！

rows.english: What a way to go…ripped apart by a pack of midgets.
rows.rawText: 死得真惨……被一群小矮子撕碎了。
rows.current: 死得真惨……被一群小矮子撕碎了。

rows.english: Lady Gaihla? Are you all right?
rows.rawText: 盖拉 女士？您还好吗？
rows.current: 盖拉 女士？您还好吗？

rows.english: We've lost them…now we'll never find Gaihla!
rows.rawText: 跟丢了……现在永远找不到 盖拉 了！
rows.current: 跟丢了……现在永远找不到 盖拉 了！

rows.english: A glorious battle, but there's nobody left to follow…we'll never find Gaihla now!
rows.rawText: 这一仗打得痛快，可已经没人可追了……现在找不到 盖拉 了！
rows.current: 这一仗打得痛快，可已经没人可追了……现在找不到 盖拉 了！

rows.english: The town vanished again! We've lost our chance to save Gaihla!
rows.rawText: 镇子又消失了！我们失去了救 盖拉 的机会！
rows.current: 镇子又消失了！我们失去了救 盖拉 的机会！

rows.english: Shouldn't get too close until Grayback arrives…I'd better just keep pushing boulders.
rows.rawText: 灰背来之前不能靠得太近……还是继续推巨石吧。
rows.current: 灰背来之前不能靠得太近……还是继续推巨石吧。

rows.rawText: 盖拉 女士！您看起来糟透了！
rows.current: 盖拉 女士！您看起来糟透了！

rows.english: There's an abandoned monastery, but I have a bad feeling about that…
rows.rawText: 有一座废弃的禅院，可我对那里有种不祥的预感……
rows.current: 有一座废弃的禅院，可我对那里有种不祥的预感……

rows.english: There's not a soul in sight, but the gardens are well-tended.
rows.rawText: 四周不见人影，花园却有人精心打理。
rows.current: 四周不见人影，花园却有人精心打理。

rows.english: Yeah, and it's also the only shelter for miles around.
rows.rawText: 是啊，方圆几里也只有那里能避风雪。
rows.current: 是啊，方圆几里也只有那里能避风雪。

rows.english: Follow me, milady…we're almost to safety.
rows.rawText: 跟我来，女士……马上就安全了。
rows.current: 跟我来，女士……马上就安全了。

rows.english: What happened to the monks who lived here?
rows.rawText: 以前住在这里的僧侣去哪儿了？
rows.current: 以前住在这里的僧侣去哪儿了？

rows.english: Gaihla is resting in the Monastery -- the Monks have promised to heal her.
rows.rawText: 盖拉 正在禅院休息，僧侣们答应治好她。
rows.current: 盖拉 正在禅院休息，僧侣们答应治好她。

rows.english: But this odd fellow won't leave me alone…
rows.rawText: 可这个怪人一直缠着我……
rows.current: 可这个怪人一直缠着我……

rows.english: But you couldn't even protect the Monks from Utara's mercenaries!
rows.rawText: 可你连僧侣们都没能从 宇多罗 的佣兵手里救下来！
rows.current: 可你连僧侣们都没能从 宇多罗 的佣兵手里救下来！

rows.english: And I think you're completely mad!
rows.rawText: 而且我觉得你彻底疯了！
rows.current: 而且我觉得你彻底疯了！

rows.english: Our witchcraft? This is Yvaine's work, you dunce!
rows.rawText: 我们的巫术？这是 伊薇恩 干的，蠢货！
rows.current: 我们的巫术？这是 伊薇恩 干的，蠢货！

rows.english: I bet that pansy would run screaming from a real fight.
rows.rawText: 我赌那个娘娘腔一遇上真刀真枪就会尖叫着逃跑。
rows.current: 我赌那个娘娘腔一遇上真刀真枪就会尖叫着逃跑。

rows.english: Let's tear down his Royal Academies…he won't be so tough without his bodyguards.
rows.rawText: 拆掉他的皇家学院……没了护卫，看他还能有多厉害。
rows.current: 拆掉他的皇家学院……没了护卫，看他还能有多厉害。

rows.english: The Academies will be lightly defended, as long as we steer clear of Taro's main forces.
rows.rawText: 只要避开 太郎 的主力，学院的防守就不会太严。
rows.current: 只要避开 太郎 的主力，学院的防守就不会太严。

rows.english: If we destroy all three Academies, Taro will know we mean business.
rows.rawText: 毁掉三座学院，太郎 就知道我们是认真的了。
rows.current: 毁掉三座学院，太郎 就知道我们是认真的了。

rows.english: Are you stupid? Look at us! We're freezing out here!
rows.rawText: 你傻吗？看看我们，都快冻僵了！
rows.current: 你傻吗？看看我们，都快冻僵了！

rows.english: Do you really think dirty savages like us know such powerful spells?
rows.rawText: 你真以为我们这群脏兮兮的野人会这么强的法术？
rows.current: 你真以为我们这群脏兮兮的野人会这么强的法术？

rows.english: We're not magicians, we're miners, you dolt!
rows.rawText: 我们是矿工，不是法师，笨蛋！
rows.current: 我们是矿工，不是法师，笨蛋！

rows.english: By all the gods, it's cold! I can't even feel my mustache!
rows.rawText: 天上诸神啊，太冷了！我连胡子都感觉不到了！
rows.current: 天上诸神啊，太冷了！我连胡子都感觉不到了！

rows.english: What happens when we reach Yvaine? Do we just kill her?
rows.rawText: 找到 伊薇恩 之后怎么办？直接杀了她？
rows.current: 找到 伊薇恩 之后怎么办？直接杀了她？

rows.english: We are not leaving you now!
Hope he knows what he's doing…
rows.rawText: 希望他知道自己在做什么……
rows.current: 希望他知道自己在做什么……

rows.rawText: 盖拉 说得对，我的朋友。
rows.current: 盖拉 说得对，我的朋友。

rows.english: We must not dishonor Grayback's last orders.
rows.rawText: 我们不能违背灰背最后的命令。
rows.current: 我们不能违背灰背最后的命令。

rows.english: What was that blast? We thought you were a goner!
rows.rawText: 那阵爆炸是怎么回事？我们还以为你完了！
rows.current: 那阵爆炸是怎么回事？我们还以为你完了！

rows.english: And the other half can wait until Spring!
rows.rawText: 剩下那一半就等到春天再说吧！
rows.current: 剩下那一半就等到春天再说吧！

rows.english: All hail the Lord of the Wolves!
In all my years, I've never seen a blizzard like this.
rows.rawText: 活了这么多年，我从没见过这样的暴风雪。
rows.current: 活了这么多年，我从没见过这样的暴风雪。

rows.english: I don't mind a little snow, but this stuff is cold as death!
rows.rawText: 我不怕下点雪，可这雪冷得要命！
rows.current: 我不怕下点雪，可这雪冷得要命！

rows.english: Ha ha! You're not the first to think so!
rows.rawText: 哈哈！你可不是第一个这么想的人！
rows.current: 哈哈！你可不是第一个这么想的人！

rows.english: Not everyone who disappeared in that battle was lost, Grayback.
rows.rawText: 灰背，并非所有在那场战斗中消失的人都死了。
rows.current: 灰背，并非所有在那场战斗中消失的人都死了。

rows.english: Gaihla is alive, and her Druidesses, too!
rows.rawText: 盖拉 还活着，她的德鲁伊们也在！
rows.current: 盖拉 还活着，她的德鲁伊们也在！

rows.english: The woods-walkers have ways of hiding from their enemies.
rows.rawText: 林间行者自有躲避敌人的办法。
rows.current: 林间行者自有躲避敌人的办法。

rows.english: They're still living in the old swamps, waiting for us to return.
rows.rawText: 她们仍住在旧沼泽里，等我们回来。
rows.current: 她们仍住在旧沼泽里，等我们回来。

rows.english: She knows more of the ancient ways than any living Wolf.
rows.rawText: 活着的恶狼族人里，她最熟悉古老之道。
rows.current: 活着的恶狼族人里，她最熟悉古老之道。

rows.english: If Gaihla can't figure out how to stop this nasty weather, nobody can.
rows.rawText: 如果 盖拉 都找不到办法止住这鬼天气，就没人能了。
rows.current: 如果 盖拉 都找不到办法止住这鬼天气，就没人能了。

rows.english: He fights like a behemoth! I say we're lucky he's on our side.
rows.rawText: 他打起仗来像头巨兽！我看他站在我们这边真是万幸。
rows.current: 他打起仗来像头巨兽！我看他站在我们这边真是万幸。

rows.english: That black-hearted sorceress still owes me a debt of blood. I'm coming.
rows.rawText: 那个黑心女巫还欠我一笔血债。我也去。
rows.current: 那个黑心女巫还欠我一笔血债。我也去。

rows.rawText: 盖拉 说得对。我们是你的狼群。
rows.current: 盖拉 说得对。我们是你的狼群。

rows.english: And we'll fight by your side until the end.
rows.rawText: 我们会与你并肩战斗到底。
rows.current: 我们会与你并肩战斗到底。
